Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). * Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.

* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.

description:
**FIELD SERVICE TECHNICIAN**

**JOB DETAILS**

**Position: Field Service Technician**

**Department:** Service \& Customer Support

**Location:** Coimbatore

**Travel:** Entire Tamil Nadu

**Reporting To:** Service Manager / Head – Customer Support

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Experience:** Freshers – 5 Years

**Qualification;** ITI / Diploma – Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics or related technical discipline

**JOB SUMMARY**

The **Field Service Technician** will be responsible for **installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and customer support** for company products at customer locations. The role requires strong technical and problem\-solving skills, customer\-service orientation, safety awareness, and willingness to travel extensively. The technician will represent the company at customer sites and ensure **timely service, equipment reliability, minimum downtime, and high customer satisfaction**.

**ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Installation \& Commissioning:** Install and commission products according to company standards; perform operational testing, safety checks, and customer demonstrations before final handover.
* **Preventive Maintenance:** Conduct scheduled maintenance, inspect equipment for potential failures, replace minor components/consumables, maintain service schedules, and recommend corrective actions.
* **Breakdown \& Troubleshooting:** Attend customer complaints promptly and diagnose **mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, or electronic faults**; repair/replace defective components and restore equipment with minimum downtime.
* **Customer Support:** Respond professionally to customer queries, provide product\-operation and basic maintenance training, explain best practices, and maintain strong customer relationships.
* **Service Documentation:** Prepare service reports after every visit, record spare parts used, update **ERP/CRM/service software**, maintain installation records, and submit travel/expense reports on time.
* **Spare Parts \& Tools:** Maintain service tools and commonly required spare parts, coordinate with stores for availability, ensure proper use of company assets, and report defective tools/instruments.
* **Quality \& Safety:** Follow company SOPs, safety procedures, electrical/mechanical standards, PPE requirements, and maintain professional cleanliness at customer sites.
* **Travel \& Field Support:** Travel extensively across Tamil Nadu and neighboring states, stay at customer locations when required, respond to emergency service calls, and provide support beyond normal hours during critical breakdowns.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify recurring technical issues, provide feedback for product/service improvements, continuously upgrade technical knowledge, and take ownership of assigned service regions.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

**Technical Skills:** Strong understanding of **mechanical assembly, electrical wiring, basic electronics, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, hand tools, measuring instruments, and technical drawings**.

**Equipment Maintenance:** Ability to diagnose and repair mechanical/electrical/electronic equipment and perform installation, commissioning, servicing, and preventive maintenance independently.

**Problem Solving:** Strong diagnostic and analytical abilities with a practical approach to identifying root causes and resolving equipment failures quickly.

**Customer Handling:** Good communication, customer\-service orientation, professional conduct, ability to explain technical information clearly, and capability to build positive customer relationships.

**Documentation \& Technology:** Basic computer skills with the ability to use **ERP/CRM systems, mobile service applications, digital reporting tools, MS Office, and online communication platforms**.

**Educational Qualification:** **ITI – Fitter/Electrician/Mechanic/Electronics** or **Diploma in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics Engineering**. Industrial maintenance/vocational certification is an advantage.

**Experience:** Freshers with strong technical aptitude may apply; **1–5 years of field service, maintenance, installation, or manufacturing experience** is preferred.

**Mobility \& Work Style:** Willingness to **travel extensively, work independently, stay at customer locations, attend emergency calls, and work flexible hours when required**.

**Key Attributes:** **Technical Aptitude \| Troubleshooting \| Customer Focus \| Safety Consciousness \| Ownership \| Reliability \| Adaptability \| Communication \| Teamwork \| Willingness to Travel**

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

title: Recruiter
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

As a Recruiter, you will be the strategic engine behind our engineering growth. This isn't just about managing a funnel; it’s about acting as a talent advisor to our Engineering leadership, helping them navigate a competitive landscape to find the builders of our future. You’ll own the full lifecycle—from deep\-dive calibration sessions with Hiring Managers to crafting high\-touch candidate experiences that reflect our culture of innovation. Whether you are hunting for niche Backend experts or scaling our Frontend teams, you’ll use your deep understanding of the tech stack and the talent market to close the best in the business. If you are passionate about the "art of the close" and thrive in a data\-informed, high\-growth environment, we want you on our team  

  



This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the TA Manager, India.  

  



**Responsibility**


* Drive process improvements to help make the hiring process more effective, efficient and positive for both hiring managers and candidates
* Own the full candidate lifecycle for a variety of roles
* Source candidates from relevant networks, online and internal databases, employee referrals and passive candidates through networking and research
* Cultivate strong partnerships with hiring managers and key collaborators, providing strategic guidance on talent acquisition and workforce planning
* Collaborate with the wider HR team to enhance recruitment processes, ensuring efficiency, consistency, and a positive candidate experience
* Utilise market insights to tailor recruitment strategies, ensuring our approach remains competitive and aligned with the evolving needs of our organisation
* Track and report on key recruitment metrics, including time\-to\-fill, pass through rates \& offer acceptance rates

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  

  

  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)  

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.  

  

**What you bring**
------------------

  

  

  

**Basic**

* 4\+ years of full\-lifecycle recruiting experience, with at least 3 years dedicated specifically to core technical roles (e.g., Backend, Frontend, Mobile, DevOps, or Data Engineering)
* Experience in partnering with Engineering leadership to define technical candidate personas, calibrate search parameters, and drive strategic alignment throughout the hiring lifecycle
* Hands\-on experience with Enterprise Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g.,Smart recruiters Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, or Workday)
* Proven track record of sourcing passive technical talent using LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Stack Overflow, and X\-ray search string
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)

**Preferred**


* Experience recruiting for high\-growth product companies or top\-tier tech firms
* Ability to use recruiting metrics (e.g., pass\-through rates, time\-to\-fill, and source\-of\-hire) to influence hiring decisions and forecast pipeline needs
* Proven ability to enhance the recruitment lifecycle by optimizing interview loops, elevating the candidate experience, and implementing scalable process improvements to drive hiring efficiency
* Expertise in local and global tech talent markets, with a proven ability to translate market intelligence, salary benchmarks, and competitor mapping into actionable hiring strategies

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  

  

  

**Working here**
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.  

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.  

**Accommodation**
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.  

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

**Travel:** Willingness to travel to project sites across India whenever required

About the Role

Source Integreta Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a proactive, organized, and detail\-oriented **Project Coordinator – Fresher** with an **Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE)** background to support the planning, coordination, documentation, and execution of IT and Systems Integration projects.

The selected candidate will work closely with Project Managers, engineering teams, software teams, vendors, clients, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ECE fresher who wants to build a career in **Project Coordination, Project Management, IT Infrastructure, Airport Systems, and Technology Operations**.

The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, basic technical knowledge, strong organizational abilities, and a willingness to learn and travel to project locations whenever required.

Key Responsibilities

* Support Project Managers in day\-to\-day project coordination and execution.
* Assist in project planning, scheduling, execution, and monitoring.
* Coordinate with engineering, software, networking, operations, and support teams.
* Follow up with internal teams to ensure timely completion of assigned activities.
* Assist in preparing project plans, trackers, MIS reports, status reports, and progress updates.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, checklists, trackers, and records.
* Prepare **Minutes of Meeting (MOM)** and follow up on action items.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding materials, deliveries, installations, testing, and project requirements.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, pending activities, and deadlines.
* Maintain regular communication with Project Managers, engineers, vendors, clients, and internal stakeholders.
* Assist in identifying project risks, issues, dependencies, and delays.
* Escalate project\-related issues to the Project Manager when required.
* Support site surveys, inspections, testing, commissioning, and implementation activities.
* Assist in monitoring material movement and availability of project resources.
* Maintain accurate project trackers and provide regular updates to the Project Manager.
* Support project documentation, handover, closure, and client sign\-off activities.
* Assist in coordinating client meetings and project review meetings.
* Travel to project locations for project coordination, implementation, inspections, testing, commissioning, and client meetings whenever required.

Requirements

* Bachelor's Degree in **Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE)**.
* **Freshers are welcome to apply.**
* Basic understanding of electronics, IT systems, networking, or infrastructure.
* Basic understanding of project planning and execution.
* Good knowledge of **Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint**.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple teams.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Strong willingness to learn new technologies and project management processes.
* Willingness to travel to project locations across India whenever required.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Preferred Skills

* Basic knowledge of **IT Infrastructure, Networking, Electronics, or Systems Integration**.
* Basic understanding of databases, APIs, and enterprise IT systems.
* Knowledge of **Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall** methodologies is an advantage.
* Familiarity with **Jira, Trello, Asana, MS Project, or similar project management tools** is an advantage.
* Academic/project experience in **IoT, Embedded Systems, Networking, Electronics, Automation, Robotics, or IT Systems** is preferred.
* Good documentation and reporting skills.
* Basic knowledge of Excel formulas, data tracking, and reporting.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.

Technical Exposure

The selected candidate may get exposure to:

* Airport IT Systems
* Systems Integration
* IT Infrastructure
* Networking
* ELV Systems
* Enterprise IT Systems
* Software and Hardware Integration
* Testing and Commissioning
* Site Surveys and Inspections
* Vendor Coordination
* Client Coordination
* Project Documentation
* Project Planning and Tracking

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on large\-scale **Airport IT and Systems Integration Projects**.
* Practical exposure to enterprise technology and mission\-critical infrastructure.
* Training and mentorship from experienced project and technical teams.
* Career growth opportunities in **Project Coordination, Project Management, and Technology Operations**.
* Exposure to client coordination and vendor management.
* Exposure to project implementation, testing, commissioning, and site activities.
* Professional development and learning opportunities.
* Performance\-based career growth.
* Opportunity to work with cross\-functional technical teams.

Salary

**₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month**

Salary will depend on the candidate's technical knowledge, communication skills, academic background, project exposure, and interview performance.

Benefits

* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Performance\-based incentives
* Professional development opportunities
* Travel allowance for official site visits, as applicable

Work Location

**Chennai, Tamil Nadu – Hybrid**

The candidate should be willing to travel to project sites across India whenever required.

Application Questions

* Do you have a Bachelor's degree in **Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE)**?
* Are you a fresher or do you have up to 1 year of experience?
* Are you willing to travel to project sites across India whenever required?
* Are you comfortable working in a project coordination role involving technical and engineering teams?
* What is your expected monthly salary?
* What is your current location?
* Are you comfortable working from the Chennai office on a hybrid basis?
* What is your notice period / joining availability?
* Do you have knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint?
* Do you have any academic or personal projects related to Electronics, IoT, Networking, Embedded Systems, Robotics, or IT?

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an **ECE fresher with strong communication, coordination, documentation, and problem\-solving skills** who is interested in building a career in project management and technology operations.

The candidate should be willing to learn, take ownership of assigned tasks, coordinate effectively with different teams, and travel to project locations whenever required.

title: Talent Acquisition Executive (Entry-Level)
description:
**Own the hiring engine that gets Biotastic's best people in the door — fast, right, every time.**

Biotastic builds and sells premium wellness equipment — ice baths, cold plunges, saunas, red light therapy and HBOT — trusted by JW Marriott, Shangri\-La, FC Goa and 200\+ HNI homes. As we scale across every department, every open role deserves a fast, sharp hiring process, not a bottleneck.

We're looking for the person who runs that process end to end — sourcing candidates, screening every CV against a real bar, and handing hiring managers a ranked shortlist they can trust — so the right person gets hired before a competitor gets to them first.

**What you'll own**

* Build and continuously refill a pool of **40–50 qualified candidates a week** across Naukri, LinkedIn, referrals and other channels — for every open Biotastic role
* Draft and post job adverts (not generic JDs) from an approved Role Scorecard, live within 48 hours of sign\-off
* Screen every CV against a structured, weighted rubric; deliver a ranked, branded shortlist to the hiring manager within **2 days** of closing the pool
* Schedule interviews within 24–48 hours of shortlist approval and keep every candidate's status current in the pipeline tracker — nothing goes stale
* Publish a weekly funnel report — pool size, drop\-off by stage, time\-to\-fill — and flag the weakest link before being asked
* Run knockout filters honestly and reject fast and kind, so no candidate is left hanging on a "maybe"
* Direct and quality\-check the work of any HR interns assigned to you — delegate sourcing and screening tasks and make sure their output meets the same bar as yours before it reaches a hiring manager

**You're a fit if you have**

* Some exposure to recruiting, sourcing or HR coordination — an internship, a prior TA role, or campus placement\-cell experience counts (under 2 years total experience)
* Strong written English — your adverts and candidate messages represent the Biotastic brand
* Comfort with Excel/Google Sheets and job portals like Naukri, Indeed, Apna and LinkedIn from day one
* High organization — you can run 3–5 hiring pipelines at once without dropping a candidate
* Genuine fluency with AI tools to speed up sourcing, screening and drafting
* Comfortable directing, delegating to and quality\-checking the work of HR interns — even if you've never formally "managed" anyone before.

**Bonus**

* Hands\-on with an ATS or a structured candidate tracker, not just email and Excel
* Experience sourcing across more than one function or department
* LinkedIn Recruiter or Boolean search experience
* Exposure to structured interviewing or scorecard\-based screening
* A background in HR, psychology or business with a real interest in People work
* Prior experience mentoring, training or team\-leading juniors/interns

**You'll thrive** here if you treat every requisition like it's urgent, take pride in handing over a shortlist no one has to second\-guess, and want real ownership this early in your career. You'll struggle here if you need heavy supervision, let CVs sit unscreened, or think recruiting is just forwarding resumes.

What we offer

* **CTC:** ₹2\.5–4 LPA fixed (based on experience)
* Real ownership of requisitions from day one — not admin, not just coordination
* **Growth path:** Talent Acquisition Executive → Senior Talent Acquisition Executive → Talent Acquisition Lead. Promotion is earned, not timed — hit your numbers consistently (pool, shortlist turnaround, intern quality) for about a year and take on more ownership as Biotastic's hiring volume grows

**How to apply**

Apply with your CV and answer these three questions in your application — **applications that skip any of them won't be reviewed:**

* Tell us about a time you sourced or shortlisted candidates, even informally — what did you do, and what happened?
* You have 5 open roles to source for this week, and only enough time for 3\. How do you decide where to spend your time?
* Name one AI tool you already use to speed up your own work, and how you use it.

Pay: ₹250,000\.00 \- ₹400,000\.00 per year

Overview:

At PepsiCo, we’re redefining what it means to be a consumer products company with a digital\-first mindset, and our ServiceNow Platform C4E team is leading that charge. C4E is a cultural model, as it brings a “service mindset” to the organization’s work. It focuses on designing and delivering services that generate measurable value and provide a consumer\-grade experience to the business and the end users.


By definition, C4E applies to all functions and domains providing services (e.g. IT). But it’s logically hosted in the “Centre 4 Enablement” organization. Our technology teams unlock digital capabilities, enhance cybersecurity safeguards, deliver data\-driven insights, and create unmatched consumer and customer experiences.  

  

Our culture is guided by the PepsiCo Way, a set of values that define our mission to win with purpose in the marketplace and act with integrity in everything we do. We’re creating smiles with every sip and every bite while advancing a sustainable, socially impactful agenda that promotes our goal of Winning with Purpose.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**


You’ll be part of a tight\-knit team in a growing Global Business Solutions area. It’s a high\-profile role in which you’ll have plenty of opportunities to showcase your ability to not only lead a team but establish and maintain new customer relationships. As you do, you’ll be expected to showcase your technical, analytical, and consultancy skills – along with relationships that could define your career in a Product centric organization. We’ll support you in developing deep subject matter expertise so you can deliver on and exceed client expectations.

Platform customization governance, in coordination with business stakeholders and the technology platform team to define and own the business roadmap of the platform, aligned to and consistent development practice with the ServiceNow technology capabilities roadmap.

* Build on current platform knowledge by learning new modules and broadening skillset
* Continue learning service delivery solutions, technologies, and methodologies
* Maintain professionalism and an uninterrupted work environment during all client meetings and interactions
* Uphold excellent time management and organizational skills with an aptitude for creative problem\-solving.
* Remain innovative, creative, self\-directed…a great leader and team player with a record of accomplishment in managing multiple complex tasks
* Utilize strong communication, presentation, and writing skills
* Maintain current certifications, keep up to date on all Delta releases

**MEASURES OF SUCCESS:**

* Experience with Web Technologies (XML, HTML/CSS, AJAX, JavaScript, Web Services, etc.).
* Experience and deep understanding of ServiceNow Workflows and Flow Designer tools.
* Deep knowledge of KM, Portal, Content, Now Assist, AI Control Tower, A2A, MCP Server, HRSD, ITSM, ITOM, DevOps, and SecOps.

title: Director, Human Resources
description:
**Job Title:** Director, HR


**Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka, India


**About the Role:**  

Eltropy is seeking a strategic and operationally excellent Director of Human Resources to lead the HR function for our India operations. This role serves as a key business partner to executive leadership while building and developing a dedicated HR team. The Director will oversee all aspects of human resources including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits strategy, employee relations, compliance, and strategic HR initiatives aligned with global organizational objectives. This person will be a hands\-on leader who can roll up their sleeves and drive execution. We are looking for someone who will personally get into the details, solve problems, and move things forward


**Responsibilities:**


**Executive Level Business Partnership:**


* + Serve as a strategic HR business partner to the India business leadership team and executive management
	+ Provide counsel on organizational strategy, workforce planning, and talent management initiatives
	+ Align HR strategy with business objectives and cascading goals across the India operations
	+ Support executive onboarding and development programs

**Regional Compliance \& Regulatory:**


* + Ensure all HR policies and practices comply with Indian labor laws and regulations (Labor Code, Shops and Establishments Act, etc.)
	+ Maintain POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) compliance including policy implementation, awareness training, and complaint resolution
	+ Stay current on regulatory changes and implement necessary policy updates
	+ Serve as primary point of contact for regulatory audits and compliance inquiries
	+ Maintain required documentation and record\-keeping in accordance with local requirements
* **Compensation, Benefits \& Planning:**
* + Conduct regular compensation benchmarking against market data and industry standards
	+ Develop and maintain competitive compensation philosophy and pay banding frameworks
	+ Lead annual compensation review cycles and provide recommendations on salary adjustments
	+ Design and administer benefits programs including health insurance, retirement plans, and wellness initiatives
	+ Analyze total rewards and prepare cost projections for budgeting
	+ Manage relationships with benefits vendors and insurance partners
* **Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment:**
* + Oversee regional recruitment strategy and operations
	+ Partner with Global HR leader on Recruiting initiatives
	+ Build and manage recruitment pipeline in collaboration with hiring managers
	+ Manage employer branding and talent attraction initiatives
	+ Review and approve recruitment metrics, hiring plans, and workforce forecasts
	+ Ensure consistent hiring practices and interview processes across all levels
	+ Supervise recruitment team member and provide performance feedback and coaching
* **Employee Relations \& Escalations:**
* + Handle escalated employee relations issues and workplace disputes
	+ Lead investigations into formal complaints and grievances
	+ Develop and implement corrective action and performance management plans
	+ Provide guidance on terminations and separations in compliance with local law
	+ Foster a positive workplace culture and employee engagement
	+ Support global HR initiatives that drive employee engagement, recognition, and retention.
	+ Support employee communication initiatives and change management
* **Team Leadership \& Development:**
* + Recruit, hire, develop, and retain high\-performing HR team members
	+ Provide coaching, mentoring, and professional development opportunities
	+ Conduct regular performance reviews and manage accountability
	+ Foster knowledge sharing and collaboration within the HR function

**Strategic Initiatives:**


* + Execute strategic assignments and projects as assigned by the Global HR Director
	+ Contribute to global HR initiatives and policy development
	+ Drive continuous improvement in HR processes and systems
	+ Lead HR\-related transformation and modernization efforts

**Qualifications:**


* Advanced degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
* Minimum 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3 years in an HR management or director\-level role
* Deep knowledge of Indian labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance requirements
* Proven experience with POSH implementation and employee relations in the Indian context
* Experience with compensation and benefits strategy, benchmarking, and planning
* Demonstrated experience in talent acquisition, recruitment strategy, and team leadership
* Experience managing and developing HR teams
* Proficiency with HRIS systems and HR analytics
* Strong communication skills with ability to interact effectively at all organizational levels


**Why Join Us?**


* Be part of a dynamic, high\-growth tech company with an exciting future.
* Work in a collaborative and supportive environment that values innovation and employee experience.
* Competitive compensation and benefits, including healthcare, 401(k), and professional development opportunities.
* An opportunity to make a direct impact in shaping HR processes and initiatives.


If you're an HR professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and enjoys supporting employees in all aspects of the HR function, we'd love to hear from you! Apply today to join our team.


**About Eltropy (www.eltropy.com)**



Eltropy is on a mission to disrupt the way people access financial services. Eltropy enables financial institutions to digitally engage in a secure and compliant way. Using our world\-class digital communications platform, community financial institutions can improve operations, engagement and productivity. CFIs (Community Banks and Credit Unions) use Eltropy to communicate with consumers via Text, Video, Secure Chat, co\-browsing, screen sharing and chatbot technology — all integrated in a single platform bolstered by AI, skill\-based routing and other contact center capabilities.


**Eltropy Values:**


* Customers are our North Star
* No Fear \- Tell the truth
* Team of Owners


Eltropy is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**  

At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast\-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.  

  

As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future\-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting\-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.  

  

  

**About The Team**  

The Workday Analyst serves as a functional and technical expert for Workday HCM and related modules. This role partners closely with HR, Finance, and IT to optimize system functionality, configure enhancements, troubleshoot issues, and drive Workday best practices. The ideal candidate has deep Workday knowledge, strong analytical skills, and the ability to translate business needs into scalable system solutions. **Position Purpose**  

Reporting to the People system Manager, based in Sydney, the Senior/ People system analyst is needed to provide expert systems support with Workday and other integrated systems as needed.
One component of this role is to help optimize the Workday system by streamlining business processes and enabling enhancements such as reporting automation and dashboards, providing coaching and guidance to the broader team, training and presenting to business and People \& Culture stakeholders and ticket resolution.
The Senior /People Systems Analyst will also be required to support across other People related systems and tools including survey tool, recruitment, remuneration and consolidate and provide reporting and key People \& Culture metrics. **What we 'll do** **System Administration \& Configuration**  

* Lead configuration, testing, and deployment of Workday modules such as HCM, Talent, Absence, and Compensation.
* Manage Workday security, business processes and reporting.
* Evaluate existing configurations and recommend optimizations aligned with business strategy and Workday best practices.
 **Support \& Troubleshooting**  

* Serve as the primary escalation point for Workday issues and inquiries.
* Diagnose root causes, resolve system errors, and coordinate fixes with IT or internal teams.
* Maintain data integrity through audits, validation, and quality checks.
 **Enhancements \& Projects**  

* Lead Workday enhancement cycles, including requirements gathering, solution design, testing, and deployment.
* Manage semi\-annual Workday releases, assess tenant impacts, and communicate changes to stakeholders.
* Support system\-related HR initiatives such as process improvements, workflow automation, and new module implementations.
 **Reporting \& Analytics**  

* Build advanced custom reports, dashboards, metrics, and scorecards using Workday Reporting.
* Provide actionable analytics and insights to HR leadership and business stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with data governance and confidentiality standards.
 **Stakeholder Collaboration**  

* Partner with HR, Finance, Payroll, and business leaders to understand operational needs and deliver effective Workday solutions.
* Train end users, develop documentation, and enhance Workday adoption across the organization.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance the employee experience using Workday tools
 **Unleash your potential**  

To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:  

* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Workday experience, including configuration and administration.
* Expertise in at least two Workday modules (e.g., HCM Core, Compensation, Absence, Payroll and Talent).
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Experience with Workday report writing and complex calculated fields.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

  


Core Competencies  

* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadline
* Strong business acumen
* Collaborative and proactive partnership mindset
* Continuous improvement mentality
  

Preferred* Workday Pro or Workday certification(s).
* Experience with Workday integrations (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio).
* Familiarity with release management processes and Workday tenants (sandbox, preview, production).
* Prior experience in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
 **Working at Bravura**  

Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.  

  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme
* 2 paid volunteering days and a range of community\-based initiatives to get involved in
* Parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Free meals/free transport/cab service
 **So, what’s next?**  

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.  

  

Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.  

  

All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

description:

**Job Title:**

Lead Program Manager, Talent Management

  

**Business Unit:**

  

Global

  

  

**Office location:**

  

Mumbai / Hybrid

  

**Department:**

  

Talent, Learning and Culture

  

  

**Grade:**

  

P4

  

**Job Type (perm/FTC)**

  

Permanent

  

  

  

**Context \& Job Purpose**

  

  

We are seeking an experienced **Lead Program Manager, Talent Management** to lead the deployment and execution of global talent management programs, including performance management, succession planning, talent reviews, and compliance learning initiatives.
This role is responsible for ensuring the successful delivery of annual talent and learning cycles, system readiness, stakeholder engagement, reporting, and governance. The ideal candidate will combine strong program management expertise with HR process knowledge and the ability to collaborate across global teams to drive operational excellence and an exceptional employee experience.  

  

**Key responsibilities**

  

  

**Program Management \& Process Execution**
* Lead the deployment and execution of global performance management, talent review, succession planning, and compliance learning programs.
* Manage annual program cycles, ensuring timelines, milestones, and deliverables are achieved.
* Ensure processes and workflows are executed consistently and in alignment with global standards.
  

**Systems \& Process Enablement**
* Partner with HR Product and Digital HR teams to define business requirements and support system configuration.
* Coordinate testing, launch readiness activities, troubleshooting, and ongoing support for talent and learning systems.
* Ensure effective system functionality and user experience across global populations.
  

**Stakeholder Training \& Communications**
* Develop and deliver guidance materials, toolkits, communications, and training resources for managers and HR teams.
* Drive awareness, understanding, and adoption of talent and learning processes globally.
* Support change management efforts associated with program rollouts and enhancements.
  

**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Monitor program completion and participation metrics across regions and functions.
* Collaborate with Workforce Analytics and HR Product teams to develop dashboards, reports, and performance insights.
* Prepare high\-quality materials and executive reporting for talent and performance review discussions.
  

**Governance, Compliance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Partner with HR, Legal, Ethics \& Compliance, Analytics, and business leaders to ensure regulatory compliance and governance.
* Support SOX controls, audit readiness, and risk mitigation activities.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve reporting, and enhance the employee and manager experience.
  
  

**Education \& Certifications required:**

  

  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience managing enterprise\-wide or global HR programs.
* Strong knowledge of talent management, performance management, succession planning, learning, or compliance processes.
* Experience coordinating annual HR cycles and large\-scale process deployments.
* Demonstrated experience working with HR systems and technology platforms.
* Strong project/program management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.

title: HR Executive
description:
**Job Title**: HR Executive

**Location**: \[Mohali]  
**Industry**: Nutraceutical Manufacturing  
**Working Days**: 6 Days a Week (Monday to Saturday)  
**Working Hours**: 10:00 AM \- 7:00 PM

**Position Overview**:

We are seeking a qualified and experienced HR Executive with an MBA in Human Resources to oversee all aspects of human resources and administrative functions at our nutraceutical manufacturing plant. The HR Executive will play a pivotal role in developing and implementing HR strategies, ensuring compliance with labor laws, handling employee relations, enforcing HR policies, and managing administrative tasks to streamline operations within the facility. This position requires excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills.

**Key Responsibilities**:**HR Functions**:

* **Recruitment \& Staffing**: Manage recruitment processes including job postings, interviewing, and selecting qualified candidates for various plant positions.
* **Employee Relations**: Serve as the main point of contact for all employee\-related issues, resolving conflicts, addressing grievances, and ensuring a positive work environment.
* **Onboarding \& Training**: Coordinate onboarding for new hires, including orientation, job training, and ensuring smooth integration into the team.
* **Performance Management**: Support managers in the implementation of performance appraisal systems, setting goals, and conducting performance reviews.
* **Compliance \& Legal**: Ensure all HR practices comply with local labor laws and industry regulations, including workplace safety and employee welfare standards.
* **Compensation \& Benefits**: Oversee payroll processing, employee benefits administration, and manage compensation strategies in alignment with industry standards.
* **HR Policies**: Develop, implement, and monitor HR policies and procedures that align with company objectives, legal requirements, and best practices. Ensure all employees are familiar with and adhere to these policies.
* **NDA Agreements**: Ensure that all employees sign Non\-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) upon hire and regularly review and update these agreements to maintain confidentiality regarding proprietary information, formulas, and processes specific to the nutraceutical industry.

**Administrative Duties**:

* **Documentation \& Recordkeeping**: Maintain up\-to\-date employee records, contracts, HR documents, and signed NDA agreements in both electronic and paper formats.
* **Reporting**: Prepare and submit regular reports on HR metrics such as turnover rates, absenteeism, employee satisfaction, etc.
* **Inventory Management**: Oversee office supplies and other administrative resources to ensure the smooth operation of daily activities.
* **Communication**: Act as a liaison between upper management and staff, communicating policy changes and ensuring that all employees are informed about company updates.

**General Responsibilities**:

* **Workforce Planning**: Analyze staffing needs and make recommendations for improvements or adjustments to optimize workforce productivity.
* **Health \& Safety**: Promote a safe and healthy work environment by ensuring compliance with safety regulations and conducting regular safety audits.
* **Team Collaboration**: Work closely with other departments to foster collaboration and ensure HR policies support company goals.
* **Other Duties**: Perform any other related administrative duties as required by management to ensure smooth operations.

**Qualifications**:

* **MBA in Human Resources** or related field.
* Proven experience as an HR Manager, ideally in a manufacturing or nutraceutical setting.
* Strong knowledge of HR practices, labor laws, employee relations, and confidentiality agreements.
* Experience in developing and implementing HR policies, procedures, and NDAs.
* In\-depth knowledge of **Employee State Insurance (ESI)** and **Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)**, and experience in managing statutory compliances related to these schemes.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to multitask and manage time efficiently.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

**Skills**:

* Leadership and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in **Google Workplace (formerly G Suite)**, **ERP systems**, or similar HR software platforms.
* Problem\-solving abilities with a proactive approach.
* Knowledge of safety and health regulations in manufacturing environments.
* Experience in managing a team and working with cross\-functional teams.

**Physical Requirements**:

* Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods.
* Ability to use a computer and telephone.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

title: Sr. Manager Enterprise BI & Analytics
description:
This is a rare ground\-floor opportunity to build our global, finance\-led business intelligence function and the data infrastructure behind it from scratch. As one of the first members of a brand\-new team, you won’t just run an existing operation; you’ll shape the practice, standards, and platform — anchored in Finance and extending across Operations, Sales, and HR — that the entire company, including our regional subsidiaries, will depend on, with your ideas feeding directly into our BI roadmap. Partnering with US\-based leadership across time zones, you’ll drive reporting from intake to production, grow a small analytics team, and set the standard for what “great” looks like — a player\-coach who stays hands\-on in the data models and DAX while bringing the curiosity and creative problem\-solving to build things that don’t exist here yet.**What you’ll do**

* Help build the finance\-led BI \& Analytics practice from the ground up — its team, standards, and data infrastructure, with your ideas feeding directly into the BI roadmap.
* Make the foundational architecture and tooling choices for a greenfield reporting platform the function will scale on for years.
* Drive day\-to\-day delivery of the dashboard and reporting queue — from intake to production — across project profitability, utilization, pipeline, and FP\&A.
* Manage and develop the analytics team, setting expectations, reviewing work, and coaching.
* Own production quality and reliability — make sure dashboards and reports are accurate, refresh dependably, and ship on schedule.
* Run intake and delivery: scope incoming requests, sequence the work against leadership’s priorities, and manage stakeholder expectations on timelines and trade\-offs.
* Enforce data modeling standards (star schema design, naming conventions, DAX patterns) and data quality practices across the team’s reporting.
* Drive data quality at the source by working with owners of CRM, project/time\-tracking, finance/ERP, and resourcing systems on issues like ownership gaps, duplicate records, and date integrity.

**What success looks like in 12 months**

* The BI platform is the company’s trusted single source of truth.
* Standards are documented and delivery runs on a steady cadence.
* The team has grown and levels up under your coaching.
* Your roadmap shapes decisions across Finance, Operations, Sales, and HR.

**Required qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in BI, analytics, or data\-driven reporting, including 3\+ years leading teams or owning end\-to\-end delivery.
* Deep expertise in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, and Power Query (M), with the ability to review, coach, and elevate technical work.
* Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of modern data platforms, including cloud data warehouses and ELT tooling.
* Proven success managing development roadmaps and reporting pipelines, balancing stakeholder priorities while delivering accurate, timely outputs.
* Strong understanding of financial and operational metrics, including project profitability, utilization and capacity, pipeline performance, revenue forecasting, and FP\&A.
* Experience integrating data across multiple systems, business units, legal entities, or regions into a consistent enterprise reporting framework.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex findings into actionable business insights.
* Experience leveraging AI tools to improve analytics, reporting, or BI development workflows.
* Curious, creative, and comfortable operating in ambiguity, with a track record of building scalable solutions rather than simply maintaining existing processes.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in a project\-based / professional\-services environment (project accounting, revenue recognition, margin, utilization).
* Familiarity with CRM (HubSpot or similar) and Workday (project/time\-tracking, and finance/ERP data).
* Familiarity with the modern data stack (warehouse, dbt, ELT) and data governance practices.
* Python for reconciliation and validation.

title: HR Director
description:
About the Position  

WatchGuard is seeking a hands\-on regional HR leader to lead the Human Resources function across APAC. Reporting to the VP of HR, the Director of Human Resources – APAC will set and execute the regional people strategy across Southeast Asia, India, China, Japan, and Australia/New Zealand, spanning talent, compensation, employee relations, compliance, and organizational effectiveness.  

This is a fast\-paced, high\-visibility role leading a geographically dispersed HR team and partnering closely with regional business leaders and global HR counterparts. You will drive people strategy and operational excellence across APAC, ensuring HR practices are locally compliant, culturally relevant, and aligned with WatchGuard's global objectives.  

Key Responsibilities  

Strategic HR Leadership \& Business Partnership  

* Serve as a strategic advisor to regional VPs, Directors, and country managers, providing counsel on workforce strategy, organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, and complex people matters.
* Partner with global HR leadership to adapt and roll out worldwide HR strategies across APAC, ensuring they are locally contextualized and effectively implemented.
* Translate regional employee and business insights into actionable guidance for senior leadership, ensuring global decisions account for APAC cultural, legal, and operational realities.


Talent Acquisition \& Performance Management  

* Lead APAC talent acquisition strategy and execution, partnering with business leaders and recruiting resources to attract, assess, and close high\-caliber talent across the region.
* Lead scalable, effective onboarding and early employee integration programs that align with WatchGuard’s global standards and regional business needs.
* Partner with leaders to define critical talent needs, uphold a high hiring bar, and ensure a strong candidate experience across APAC.
* Lead APAC performance and talent processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, development planning, manager coaching, and succession planning for key talent.


Employee Relations \& Compliance  

* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex employee relations issues, providing sound, legally\-informed guidance to managers and senior leaders.
* Interpret and apply local labor laws across APAC markets (China, India, Japan, Singapore, Australia, and others), ensuring compliance and minimizing legal exposure.
* Partner with external employment counsel in each jurisdiction to manage risk, conduct investigations, and resolve disputes.
* Ensure regional HR policies, employment documentation, and local practices remain compliant, current, and aligned with global standards.


Compensation, Benefits \& HR Operations  

* Partner with global compensation and business leadership to deliver competitive, equitable, and market\-relevant rewards programs across APAC.
* Lead APAC compensation review processes and market benchmarking, ensuring pay decisions are data\-driven, equitable, and aligned with talent attraction and retention priorities.
* Oversee benefits administration and payroll coordination, balancing strong employee service with cost efficiency.
* Oversee regional HR operations, systems, compliance reporting, and HR workstreams for regional M\&A activity, ensuring effective execution, risk management, and employee communication.


Team Leadership \& Continuous Improvement  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of HR professionals across multiple APAC countries, ensuring consistent, high\-quality HR service delivery.
* Use people analytics to identify trends, improve regional HR processes, and provide actionable insights that inform business and workforce decisions.
* Drive regional HR projects such as system implementations, policy harmonization, and cross\-country process standardization, plus special projects as assigned by global HR leadership.


Skills and Qualifications  

* 10\+ years of progressively responsible HR experience, including at least 5 years in a senior HR leadership role (Director or above), preferably within a technology or global matrixed environment.
* Proven experience managing HR operations across multiple APAC countries, with strong knowledge of labor laws and employment practices in India and at least 3 of: China, Japan, Singapore, Australia, and Southeast Asia.
* Demonstrated expertise in talent management, employee relations, compensation \& benefits, performance management, and organizational development.
* Strong business acumen, with the ability to partner effectively with and influence senior and executive leaders.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to navigate cross\-cultural differences and build trust across a globally diverse workforce.
* Hands\-on and self\-motivated, comfortable operating in a fast\-paced environment with competing priorities.
* Experience using HR systems and reporting tools to support data\-driven decision\-making, operational discipline, and scalable HR service delivery.
* Fluent English communication skills, written and verbal, are required.

title: Quality Management System & Training Mananager
description:
**Job Description**


**Role –** **QMS \& Training Manager / Lead**


The QMS \& Training Manager/Lead is responsible for leading and maintaining the organization's Quality Management System (QMS) and Training Management Program to ensure compliance with global regulatory and quality standards. The role oversees quality processes, document control, training governance, audit readiness, quality metrics, and continuous improvement initiatives.


The individual will act as the subject matter expert for QMS and training compliance, partnering with cross\-functional teams to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements including ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, EU MDR, and applicable international standards.

  


**Key Responsibilities:**


**Quality Management System Leadership**


* Lead the development, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulations and standards, including:

* EN ISO 13485


* IMDR


* FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / QMSR


* EU MDR 2017/745


* Other applicable global regulations \& Standards


* Establish and maintain QMS governance, procedures, and quality policies.
Drive quality culture and operational excellence across the organization.  
* 

**QMS Process Ownership**


* Oversee key quality system processes including:

* Document Control


* Change Control


* Quality Manual / Quality Plans


* Internal and External Audits / Inspections


* Management Review


* Training Management


Ensure processes remain compliant, efficient, and inspection\-ready.  

* 

**Training Program Management**


* Own the corporate training compliance program.
* Develop and maintain role\-based training matrices.
* Ensure regulatory, quality, and job\-specific training requirements are assigned and completed on time.
* Manage Learning Management Systems (LMS) and electronic training records.
* Monitor training effectiveness and identify competency gaps.
* Collaborate with functional leaders to establish learning and development plans.

**Audit \& Inspection Readiness**


* Lead internal audit programs and quality compliance assessments.
* Support and host external audits conducted by:

* Notified Bodies


* Certification Bodies


* Customers


* Regulatory Agencies


* Drive audit observation remediation and effectiveness verification.
Ensure inspection readiness across all QMS and training processes.  
* 

**Metrics, Analytics \& Reporting**


* Develop and monitor QMS and Training KPIs.
* Prepare quality and compliance reports for management review.
* Analyze trends related to training effectiveness, audit findings, and quality compliance.
Present quality system performance metrics to senior leadership.  
* 

**Continuous Improvement**


* Identify opportunities for process simplification and automation.
* Lead quality improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and risk\-based approaches.
* Drive harmonization of quality processes across business functions and global sites.
Promote best practices and compliance awareness throughout the organization.  
* 

**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**


* Provide leadership, coaching, and development to QMS and Training Processes.
* Partner with Regulatory Affairs, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Clinical Affairs, and HR teams.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on quality system and training\-related matters.
Lead cross\-functional quality projects and strategic initiatives.  
* 

**Education \& Qualifications**


**Required**


* Bachelor's Degree in B\-Tech , Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Quality Management, or related field.

**Preferred**


* Master's Degree in Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, or Science
Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, or equivalent certifications.  
* 

**Experience Required**


* 10\+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, QMS Management, or Compliance within a regulated industry.
* Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485, FDA QSR/QMSR, EU MDR requirements.
* Experience managing electronic QMS (eQMS) and Learning Management Systems (LMS).
Proven success in supporting regulatory inspections and external audits.  
* 

**Technical Competencies**


* Quality Management Systems (QMS)
* ISO 13485 \& Medical Device Regulations
* Document Control \& Change Control
* Internal Auditing \& Inspection Readiness
* Training Program Administration
* Learning Management Systems (LMS)
* eQMS Platforms
Quality Metrics \& Data Analytics  
* 

**Leadership Competencies**


* Strategic Leadership
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Stakeholder Management
* Problem Solving \& Decision Making
* Program \& Project Management
Continuous Improvement Mindset  
* 

**Career Level : Quality Management Systems \& Training Manager**


Ideal Candidate Profile: A seasoned quality professional with 10\+ years of experience managing QMS and training programs in a regulated environment, capable of driving compliance excellence, leading audits and inspections, and building a strong quality culture across the organization.

 Founder \& CEO

 Human Resources

* machine safety,
* POSH,
* behavioural skills,
* leadership development,

title: Associate Vice President – Global Field HR / HRBP Delivery, GCoE
description:
**Introduction**  


Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.
  

**Overview**  

The Associate Vice President – Global Field HR / HRBP Delivery, GCoE will lead the Field HR / HRBP Delivery vertical within Global HR Shared Services (GHRSS). The role partners with Divisional Field HR / HRBP leaders and staff to develop the strategy, roadmap, and operating model for delivering Field HR / HRBP services within GHRSS. Additionally, this role bears responsibility for identifying opportunities to enhance the service portfolio, drive adoption, and deliver operational excellence. The role serves as the primary liaison between GHRSS and business\-facing HR teams, fostering alignment, continuous improvement, and long\-term growth  


  

**How you'll make an impact** **Responsibilities:*** Define and drive the strategic vision for evolving HRBP and Field HR support capabilities, enabling the team to deliver high\-value advisory and business partner services.
* Lead the strategy, transition, standardization, and ongoing delivery of Field HR / HRBP services within the GHRSS model, including identification of opportunities to broaden support capabilities.
* Partner with Field HR / HRBP leaders and staff to define service strategies, evaluate transition and expansion opportunities, and establish scalable operating models that support business and talent priorities.
* Develop and maintain the Field HR / HRBP Support Service Roadmap, partnering with senior HR leaders to identify, prioritize, and implement delivery of Field HR / HRBP services within the GHRSS model.
* Oversee delivery of HRBP and Field HR services to ensure quality, service\-level achievement, operational effectiveness, and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Lead and develop a high\-performing HRBP and Field HR Support organization through hiring, coaching, succession planning, capability building, and performance management; Establish team goals, service standards, and performance expectations aligned to business priorities.
* Lead change management activities supporting the transition, adoption, and evolution of Field HR / HRBP services being delivered via GHRSS.
* Partner with GHRSS leadership on organizational design, staffing strategies, and capacity planning to support future Field HR / HRBP service expansion.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, customer service, and operational excellence.
* Oversee workforce planning, talent review, succession planning, and workforce analytics processes, ensuring leaders have actionable insights to support business and talent decisions.
* Oversee the development and implementation of governance standards for SOPs, process documentation, and knowledge management to ensure alignment with organizational goals and operational excellence.
* Define and oversee key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and communicate the value created by GCoE services, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
* Use feedback from onshore Field HR / HRBP teams and stakeholders to improve processes, documentation, dashboard adoption, and operating effectiveness.
* Support policy/process governance, audit readiness, data access controls and confidentiality expectations in partnership with HR Operations, HRIS, Compliance, Employee Relations or Legal, as appropriate.

  


  

**About you** **Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s degree required; MBA / master’s degree in HR, Business, Organizational Psychology, Analytics or related field preferred.

**Certifications:*** HR certification such as SHRM, CIPD, HRCI or equivalent preferred

**Experience:*** 15\+ years of progressive HR experience supporting global organizations within shared services, Centre of Excellence, Business HR/HR Generalist, or matrixed environments, with experience partnering with HR and business leaders to drive people, talent, and organizational priorities. Demonstrated success leading teams, scaling HR service delivery capabilities, transitioning services into shared services environments, and partnering with senior HR and business leaders to support operating model and HR transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of HRBP operating models, people strategy execution, workforce planning, talent management and HR policy implementation.
* Prior experience supporting or partnering with global HRBPs, HR Generalists, HR Transformation, HR Target Operating Model (TOM) implementation, or HR service delivery transitions.
* Candidates with existing US/UK business visas will be preferred

**Behaviors**:* Above average verbal and written communication skills necessary.
* Good interpersonal skills required.

  


  

**Additional Information**  

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people\-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Hiring HR Generalist for a Printing company in Surat, Gujarat
description:
Job Description: HR Generalist (Printing Industry)
   

 Position Title: HR Generalist
   

 Experience: 2 to 4 Years
   

 Location: Surat, Gujarat
   

 Industry: Printing / Packaging / Manufacturing
   

 Reports To: Directore
   

  

 Job Overview
   

 We are seeking a dynamic and hands\-on HR Generalist with 2 to 4 years of experience to manage our human resources operations at our printing facility in Surat. The ideal candidate will be responsible for end\-to\-end HR functions, focusing heavily on factory floor management, blue\-collar workforce operations, and supporting business units that cater to diverse client segments, including stationery and commercial print clients.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

 1\. Factory \& Blue\-Collar Workforce Management
   

 Labor \& Worker Relations: Act as the primary point of contact for factory workmen (blue\-collar employees) to resolve grievances, maintain discipline, and ensure a harmonious working environment.
   

  

 Attendance \& Shift Management: Oversee daily attendance, overtime calculations, and shift scheduling for production workers in coordination with floor supervisors.
   

  

 Contract Labor Management: Manage third\-party contractors and temporary staffing requirements during peak production cycles.
   

  

 2\. Statutory Compliance \& Safety
   

 Legal Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to the Factories Act, Payment of Wages Act, Minimum Wages Act, PF, ESIC, and other local labor laws applicable in Gujarat.
   

  

 Health \& Safety: Coordinate with the plant safety officer to ensure workplace safety protocols, PPE usage, and regular health check\-ups for factory workers.
   

  

 3\. Recruitment \& Client\-Centric Staffing
   

 Guiding the HR recruiters
   

  

 Client Alignment Support: Understand the staffing and agility requirements driven by our diverse B2B client portfolio (e.g., fast turnaround times required for major stationery and commercial brands).
   

  

 4\. Core HR Operations
   

 Onboarding \& Exit: Handle seamless induction for new hires and manage full and final settlements for exiting employees.
   

  

 Payroll Input Management: Prepare monthly inputs for payroll processing, including attendance records, leaves, bonuses, and statutory deductions.
   

  

 Employee Engagement: Organize workplace initiatives and festival celebrations to boost morale across both office staff and factory workers.
   

  

 Required Skills and Qualifications
   

  

 Education: MBA in HR or a Bachelor's degree with a PG Diploma in HR/Labor Laws.
   

  

 Experience: 2–4 years of core HR experience in a manufacturing unit, ideally within the printing, packaging, or closely related sectors.
   

  

 Language: Fluency in Gujarati and Hindi is mandatory to effectively communicate with the blue\-collar workforce.
   

  

 Skills: Strong understanding of labor laws, excellent conflict\-resolution skills, and proficiency in MS Excel/HRMS software.
   

  

  

  

 Intrested one can share their resume at neha@educohire.com

description:
**About the program**

**NestorBird** is selecting 4 **exceptional graduates** for its **Career Launch Program** — a structured, 90\-day accelerator that takes you from campus to client\-facing professional. This is not a passive internship. You will learn to sell, scope, and deliver digital transformation projects for real clients across retail, wellness, and compliance sectors.

NestorBird builds vertical SaaS platforms — **GETPOS** (retail), **SWANITY** (wellness), and **VERIXOR** (compliance) — deployed across India and through a growing global partner network.

**Program structure — 90 days, 3 phases**

**Weeks 1–4 (Foundation)** Product mastery, demo skills, business communication, AI \& automation tools

**Weeks 5–8 (Application)** Requirements gathering, SOW creation, effort estimation, negotiation, shadow client calls

**Weeks 9–12 (Proving ground)** Live project work, independent client interactions, capstone presentation to leadership

**What you will be able to do after 90 days**

* Deliver tailored product demos of GETPOS, SWANITY, and VERIXOR to prospective clients
* Conduct structured discovery calls and convert client needs into clear requirement documents
* Build complete Scope of Work documents with deliverables, assumptions, and acceptance criteria
* Estimate effort and create realistic delivery plans with milestones
* Negotiate confidently — defend scope, handle pushback, and preserve client relationships
* Use AI and automation tools to draft proposals, analyse data, and automate repetitive work
* Manage live client interactions independently — from discovery through delivery

**Who we are looking for**

* **Eligibility:** Final\-year students or 2024/2025/2026 graduates from any discipline. No prior work experience required.
* **Communication:** Strong spoken and written English. Comfortable presenting and holding your own in professional conversations.
* **Tech fluency:** Comfortable with AI tools, automation workflows, and learning new software rapidly (ChatGPT, Notion, CRMs, spreadsheets).
* **Mindset:** High curiosity, comfortable with ambiguity, not intimidated by unfamiliar domains.
* **Negotiation instinct:** Naturally comfortable advocating a position, even when the answer is no.

**Compensation \& growth path**

**Months 1–3 Training period \- No stipend** — NestorBird invests ₹1,50,000 in your training

**Months 4–6 ₹15,000 / month \- Stipend period** — live projects with increasing autonomy

**Month 7 onwards₹25,000–₹30,000 / month** \- Full\-time salary \+ performance incentives (Sales track)

Successful graduates are placed into either a **Sales track** (client acquisition, demos, deal management — base \+ uncapped incentives) or a **Production track** (project delivery, client success — structured salary growth).

How to apply

* Submit your resume and a short note (max 200 words) on why you want to build a career at a SaaS company
* Complete an online assessment covering logical reasoning, communication, and situational judgement
* Final conversation with NestorBird leadership — we want to understand how you think, not what you have memorised

Apply now — only 4 seats available, Batch: August 2026

title: Application Engineer / Technical Sales
description:
**About us**

Divide By Zero Technologies builds industrial 3D printers in Navi Mumbai. Not imports, not rebadged machines — we design the motion system, the extruder, the firmware and the control electronics ourselves, and we manufacture them here.

Twelve years in. Over 1,300 machines installed across defence, aerospace, automotive, medical and education customers. Our AFPM (Adaptive Flow\-Pressure Modulation) technology is patented in India and the USA, and it produces interlayer bond strength that measures well above published industry ceilings for FFF printing. We also run our own print services bureau, so we make parts for customers as well as sell them the machines to make their own.

**What the role actually is**

A customer sends you a part. Maybe it is a checking fixture they machine from aluminium for ₹18,000 a piece with a four\-week lead time. Your job is to open that file, understand what the part actually has to do, and work out whether we can print it for ₹2,000 in two days without losing anything that matters.

Then you prove it. You redesign it for additive, you print it on a Quantum Pro 500, you put the real part in the customer's hands, and you show them the cost sheet that backs up the claim.

That is the job. Half engineering, half commercial, and the two are not separable. You will spend your week between CAD, the print floor, and customer sites across Mumbai, Pune and the wider West India belt.

We are being direct about one thing: this is not an order\-taking sales job with a price list. If you do not enjoy pulling a part apart to find out where its cost is hiding, you will not enjoy this.

**What you will do**

* Qualify incoming enquiries — understand the application, the part, the material requirement, the volume and what it costs them today
* Analyse customer parts in CAD and recommend design changes for additive: wall thickness, ribbing, orientation, support strategy, part consolidation
* Build the cost comparison — their current route versus ours, across material, machine time, tooling, labour and lead time — and defend the number
* Print benchmark samples on our machines and get them into the customer's hands inside five working days
* Run machine demonstrations at our Navi Mumbai facility and at customer sites
* Prepare technical quotations for machines and for print services
* Handle the hard technical questions — layer strength, dimensional accuracy, material certification, how we compare to imported machines
* Support installation, first\-print handover and operator training
* Go back to installed accounts and find the next application
* Keep the CRM honest and the weekly funnel accurate

***What we need from you***

**Must have**

* B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, Mechatronics or Automobile Engineering
* 1–2 years in application engineering, technical sales, pre\-sales, design engineering or manufacturing engineering
* Working proficiency in a parametric CAD package — SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Creo, CATIA, Inventor or NX. You should be able to model, edit and repair geometry, not just view it
* Ability to read a 2D manufacturing drawing properly — GD\&T, tolerances, surface finish, datums
* Value engineering instinct. You understand what makes a part expensive — material, machine hours, labour, post\-processing, scrap — and you can separate the function a part must deliver from the way it happens to be made today
* Comfortable in English, Hindi and Marathi with shop\-floor engineers and purchase managers alike
* Based in or willing to relocate to Navi Mumbai, and able to travel to customer sites

**Nice to have**

* Hands\-on with an FFF slicer — Simplify3D, Cura, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio
* Familiarity with engineering polymers and composites — PLA\-CF, PETG, ABS, ASA, PA6\-CF, PC, PEEK, ULTEM
* Exposure to jigs, fixtures, gauges, EOAT or low\-volume production parts
* Experience at a 3D printing bureau, CAD/CAM reseller, tooling supplier or a manufacturing job shop

If you are a fresher with a genuinely strong additive manufacturing project portfolio and a commercial head on your shoulders, apply anyway and tell us why.

Why this is a good place to do this work

* You are selling a machine your own colleagues designed and built two rooms away. When a customer asks a hard question, you can walk over and get the real answer
* Patented technology with published tensile data behind it, so your technical claims are defensible rather than marketing copy
* Direct access to the founder and the engineering team. Small company, short decision chains, no layers to push an idea through
* Every application you solve becomes part of our library — your work compounds
* Real career path into senior applications, key account management or product management as the company scales

Compensation and details

* ₹30,000 – ₹35,000 per month, depending on experience and CAD depth
* Performance incentive on closed business From 3rd Month
* Day shift, Monday to Saturday
* In person at Nerul West, Navi Mumbai, with customer travel

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

**Location:** Aluva, Kochi

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated and technically inclined **IT Support Fresher** to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for providing basic technical support to employees and assisting with hardware, software, networking, and day\-to\-day IT requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide first\-level IT support to employees for hardware and software issues.
* Install, configure, and maintain computers, laptops, printers, and other IT equipment.
* Troubleshoot basic Windows, application, and connectivity issues.
* Assist with LAN, Wi\-Fi, internet, and basic network troubleshooting.
* Set up user accounts, email accounts, and system access.
* Maintain IT assets, inventory, and related documentation.
* Assist with antivirus installation, system updates, and basic cybersecurity practices.
* Coordinate with external IT vendors when required.
* Maintain records of IT issues and resolutions.
* Assist the IT team with routine maintenance and other technical requirements.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of **Windows OS, computer hardware, and networking**.
* Basic understanding of LAN, Wi\-Fi, TCP/IP, and troubleshooting.
* Good problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Preferred Skills

* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365\.
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware installation and troubleshooting.
* Basic understanding of networking and internet connectivity.
* Familiarity with IT support or helpdesk systems is an advantage.
