title: Solar technician
description:
**1\. Job Purpose**

The Solar Technician will be responsible for the installation, testing, commissioning, operation, inspection, troubleshooting and preventive maintenance of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems. The role requires safe and efficient execution of technical activities at project sites while maintaining quality, productivity and compliance with company and site safety standards.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

· Install and assemble solar PV modules, mounting structures, DC/AC cabling, junction boxes, combiner boxes and related equipment.

· Carry out electrical and mechanical installation work as per approved drawings, specifications and site instructions.

· Perform testing, commissioning and basic configuration of solar PV systems and associated electrical equipment.

· Inspect solar panels, cables, connectors, earthing systems, inverters and other components for defects or abnormal conditions.

· Identify and troubleshoot common electrical, mechanical and performance\-related issues in solar installations.

· Conduct preventive and corrective maintenance, including cleaning, tightening, visual inspection and replacement of faulty components where authorized.

· Use electrical testing instruments such as multimeters, clamp meters, insulation testers and other approved tools correctly.

· Maintain proper cable routing, termination, labeling, earthing and housekeeping at the work site.

· Record maintenance activities, faults, readings, material usage and work completion details in required formats.

· Coordinate with Site Engineers, Supervisors, subcontractors and other technicians to complete work within project schedules.

· Follow electrical safety procedures, permit\-to\-work requirements, PPE requirements and work\-at\-height practices.

· Report unsafe conditions, equipment faults, material shortages and major technical issues promptly to the reporting supervisor.

· Support site inspections, performance checks and handover activities as required.

· Carry out any other technical duties assigned by the Project Manager / Site Engineer.

**3\. Required Qualifications**

· ITI / Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Solar, Renewable Energy or a related technical trade preferred.

· Relevant certification or vocational training in solar PV installation/maintenance will be an advantage.

· Freshers with suitable technical training may be considered; relevant experience in solar installation or electrical maintenance is preferred.

**4\. Experience**

· 1–2 years of relevant experience in solar PV installation, electrical work, maintenance or renewable\-energy projects preferred.

· Experience with rooftop, ground\-mounted or commercial/industrial solar projects will be an advantage.

**5\. Technical Skills**

· Basic knowledge of solar PV system components and electrical circuits.

· Understanding of DC and AC electrical systems, cable termination, earthing and protection devices.

· Ability to read basic electrical drawings, wiring diagrams and installation layouts.

· Ability to use hand tools and electrical testing instruments safely.

· Basic fault\-finding and troubleshooting skills.

· Basic computer/mobile reporting skills for maintenance records and site updates.

**6\. Safety \& Compliance**

· Strictly follow company HSE policies, electrical safety procedures and project\-specific safety requirements.

· Use appropriate PPE including safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, eye protection and fall\-protection equipment where applicable.

· Follow safe isolation/lockout procedures and never work on energized equipment unless specifically authorized under approved procedures.

· Maintain clean and organized work areas and immediately report hazards, near misses and incidents.

**7\. Key Competencies**

· Technical aptitude and problem\-solving ability

· Attention to detail and quality consciousness

· Teamwork and coordination

· Time management and discipline

· Physical fitness for site\-based work

· Willingness to travel or work at project locations

· Good communication and reporting skills

· Commitment to safety and professional conduct

**8\. Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

· Quality and accuracy of solar installation and maintenance work

· Timely completion of assigned technical activities

· Reduction in repeat faults and avoidable breakdowns

· Compliance with safety procedures and PPE requirements

· Accuracy and completeness of site reports and maintenance records

· Proper handling and utilization of tools, equipment and materials

**9\. Working Conditions**

This is primarily a field/site\-based position. The technician may be required to work outdoors, at heights and in varying weather conditions, depending on the project. The role may involve travel to different project locations and flexible working hours based on site requirements.

 We are always looking upward. And that starts with finding the right talent to help us get there.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 As the Technology and Operations Privacy, Information Protection (IP) Analyst, you will serve our customers and clients with excellence by accurately and efficiently managing system access requests on behalf of management. You will build, promote and protect our brand by working closely with business partners to deliver results that support quality and accuracy, ensuring behaviors, technologies, and business practices do not put Cigna at risk due to Privacy/IP issues or business disruptions. Additionally, you will simplify the customer experience by ensuring interactions and solutions make it easy for our business partners while zealously protecting the information our customers entrust to us.

* Strong Interpersonal/relationship skills

* Engage and participate in conversations to remove barriers in support of continuous improvement, provide innovative solutions for the business while driving out complexity, reducing cost and improving service for customers and clients.

title: Desktop Support Engineer
description:
**Job description:**

**Job Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced Desktop Support Engineer with a proven track record of providing technical support for hardware, software, and network\-related issues. The ideal candidate will have 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in troubleshooting IT problems, configuring systems, and managing the day\-to\-day operations of an organization’s IT infrastructure. This role requires the ability to work in a fast\-paced, night\-shift environment while ensuring the smooth functioning of IT systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide expert\-level technical support for desktops, laptops, printers, and other end\-user devices.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows/macOS operating systems, software applications, and related IT services.
* Manage and maintain user accounts, email configurations, and access permissions using Active Directory and M365\.
* Resolve network\-related issues, including LAN/WAN, Wi\-Fi, and basic network connectivity problems.
* Support printers, scanners, VoIP phones, and other peripheral devices to ensure continuous service.
* Ensure that anti\-virus, patch management, and security policies are up\-to\-date on all systems.
* Efficiently log, track, and resolve incidents through the IT ticketing system.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware repairs and manage warranty claims.
* Maintain inventory of IT assets and ensure proper documentation of IT configurations and changes.
* Assist with IT infrastructure projects, upgrades, and office relocations as required.

**Key Skills \& Competencies:**

* Advanced knowledge of Windows 10/11, macOS, and Microsoft Office 365\.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VPN).
* Hands\-on experience with Active Directory, user profile management, and group policies.
* Proficiency with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, ManageEngine).
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to resolve issues independently.
* Excellent communication skills to work effectively with internal teams and end\-users.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities and work efficiently under pressure in a night\-shift role.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2\+ years of experience in Desktop Support or IT Support.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA A\+, MCSA, ITIL) would be a plus.

**Role:** Associate, Business Journalism, Content \& Financial Analysis  
**Experience:** 1–2 years, Fresher's can also apply  
**Location:** Gurgaon  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

About the Role

We are looking for an **Associate, Business Journalism \& Financial Research** who can track the fast\-moving startup and investment ecosystem and turn raw information into **sharp, credible and analytical content**.

The role will involve researching companies, tracking funding and corporate developments, analysing financial statements and writing newsroom\-ready articles, company profiles and financial insights.

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable **reading a balance sheet, tracking a funding round and writing a compelling business story**.

Key ResponsibilitiesBusiness \& Startup Research

* Track daily developments across **startups, VC, PE, fintech, consumer brands, SaaS, D2C, e\-commerce and emerging businesses**.
* Monitor funding rounds, acquisitions, strategic investments, IPO developments, leadership changes and major business announcements.
* Identify important stories and developments that merit deeper analysis.
* Research founders, investors, competitors, business models and industry trends.

Financial Analysis

* Analyse **P\&L statements, balance sheets and cash\-flow statements** of startups and new\-age companies.
* Track revenue growth, gross margins, EBITDA, EBITDA margins, losses, cash burn and other key operating metrics.
* Analyse changes in expenses, profitability and unit economics where relevant.
* Evaluate funding rounds, valuations, dilution, shareholding structures and investor participation.
* Develop meaningful insights from financial statements rather than simply reporting numbers.

Content Creation \& Journalism

* Write **funding news, company profiles, financial performance stories, fundraising analysis and industry reports**.
* Convert complex financial information into clear, concise and reader\-friendly business journalism.
* Develop data\-backed narratives around companies and sectors.
* Conduct background research and independently verify information before publication.
* Maintain high standards of accuracy, attribution and editorial integrity.

Data \& Research

* Track and maintain databases covering **funding, investors, valuations, financial performance and company developments**.
* Compare companies across sectors using relevant financial and operating metrics.
* Identify trends across funding activity, profitability, valuations and investor participation.
* Build research frameworks and recurring datasets that can support DSJ's editorial and data products.

What We Are Looking For

* Strong interest in **business journalism, startups, venture capital, private equity and financial markets**.
* Good understanding of financial statements and corporate finance.
* Ability to independently research a company and understand its business model.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* Excellent written English and ability to write crisp, newsroom\-ready content.
* Ability to distinguish between **facts, management claims, reported information and analytical interpretation**.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Comfortable working with large amounts of financial and business information.
* Curiosity to continuously follow the Indian startup and investment ecosystem.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates pursuing or having completed **CA, CFA, CMA, MBA Finance or equivalent financial qualifications** would be preferred.

Candidates from **financial research, equity research, business journalism, investment banking, consulting, corporate finance or startup research** backgrounds are also encouraged to apply.

**CA/CFA qualification is preferred,** Journalism **student with strong financial understanding , this role requires strong analytical ability and demonstrated writing/research skills will carry significant weight.**

Skills That Will Give You an Edge

* Financial statement analysis
* Company and industry research
* Valuation fundamentals
* Startup and VC ecosystem knowledge
* Excel / Google Sheets
* Business writing
* Data interpretation
* Fact\-checking and source verification
* Ability to identify the **story behind the numbers**

What You Will Learn

you will get exposure to the intersection of **business journalism, financial research and startup intelligence**.

You will work on real companies and transactions and develop an understanding of:

* How startups raise capital
* How VC and PE investments are structured
* How valuations and dilution work
* How to analyse startup financial statements
* How businesses scale and where they burn capital
* How investors evaluate companies
* How financial data can be converted into actionable business intelligence
* How to turn research into high\-quality business journalism

Who Should Apply?

This role is particularly suited for someone who says:

**"I don't just want to report what happened. I want to understand why it happened, what the numbers say and what it means for the business."**

If you follow **startup funding announcements, VC deals, IPOs and company financials** in your free time and enjoy digging deeper into the numbers, this could be the right role for you.

Key Performance Indicators

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Quality and accuracy of published stories
* Depth of financial and company research
* Ability to identify relevant business developments
* Speed and consistency of news tracking
* Quality of financial analysis
* Originality of insights
* Reliability of data and sources
* Ability to independently take a story from **research → analysis → publication**

title: Print Services Executive / Engineer
description:
**About us**

Divide By Zero Technologies designs and manufactures industrial 3D printers in Navi Mumbai. We don't import machines and put our sticker on them — we design the motion system, the extruder, the firmware and the electronics ourselves, and we build them here.

Twelve years in, over 1,300 machines installed across defence, aerospace, automotive, medical, education and general engineering customers. Alongside the machine business we run our own print services bureau, making jigs, fixtures, gauges, prototypes and low\-volume production parts for customers on our own Quantum Pro 500, Aeqon 400 V4, Alpha 500 and Aion 500 MK2 machines.

**What the role actually is**

**You run our print floor.**

A customer file lands. You check it will actually print — wall thickness, feature size, mesh errors, overhangs. You pick the material and profile, slice it, put it on the right machine, and watch the first few layers. When it's done you pull the supports, finish the part, measure it against the drawing, and if it isn't right you print it again. Then you pack it, label it, and get it out the door on the date we promised.

**Every job that leaves this building goes through your hands.**

Two things make this more than machine\-minding. Our bureau is also our proving ground — the sample parts printed here are what convince customers to buy a machine, so the quality of your work directly turns into sales. And because we *build* these printers, when something behaves strangely the engineers who designed the extruder are sitting two rooms away. Your observations from the floor go straight back into the product.

You do not need to know all of this on day one. You need to be practical, careful, and genuinely interested in making things work. We will train you on our machines, materials and slicer profiles.

**What you will do**

* Check incoming customer files for printability and flag problems before the job starts
* Pick the material and profile, set orientation and supports, and slice the job
* Plan jobs across the machines so the fleet stays busy and jobs go out on time
* Start prints, watch them, and catch failures early instead of losing a full build
* Post\-process — support removal, deburring, sanding, drilling, tapping, assembly
* Measure finished parts against the drawing with calipers and gauges, and reprint what doesn't pass
* Run daily and weekly machine maintenance — nozzle checks, bed levelling, belt tension, cleaning — and log it
* Track filament stock and consumption, store material properly, raise indents before you run out
* Update the job tracker for every single job, file receipt through to dispatch
* Pack, label and dispatch finished parts
* Print sample and demo parts for the sales team at short notice
* Report recurring faults and odd machine behaviour to the engineering team

**What we need from you**

**Must have**

* Diploma or B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, Mechatronics or Automobile Engineering. ITI with strong machine\-handling aptitude is fine
* Comfortable working with machines hands\-on — loading, levelling, changing nozzles, clearing jams
* Able to read a basic 2D drawing — dimensions, tolerances, orientation
* Careful and methodical. You follow a written SOP exactly and you record what you actually did, not what you meant to do
* Real attention to detail on finished parts — you spot stringing, layer shift, warping and dimensional drift before the customer does
* Basic computer skills and willingness to learn new software
* Hindi and Marathi for the floor, working English for job notes
* Based in or around Navi Mumbai — Nerul, Vashi, Panvel, Kharghar, Belapur, Thane

**Nice to have**

* Hands\-on with a slicer — Simplify3D, Cura, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio
* Familiar with STL, STEP or OBJ files and basic mesh repair
* Worked with PLA, PLA\-CF, PETG, ABS, ASA, PA6\-CF or PC
* Any CAD exposure — SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD — even from a college project
* Experience in a machine shop, tool room, CNC job shop, prototyping lab or plastics unit

**If you have built, tuned or repaired a 3D printer yourself — even a cheap one at home — tell us in your application. We will move you to the front of the queue regardless of your formal experience.**

Why this is a good place to learn this trade

* You will work on industrial machines, not desktop hobby printers — build volumes and materials most people in this field never get to touch
* The people who designed the machine are in the same building. When you want to know why something happens, you can go and ask
* Full training on machines, materials and profiles. Freshers are genuinely welcome here
* Clear growth path — Print Services Executive into Senior Executive, then into applications engineering or service engineering as you build depth
* You will see finished parts go out to real defence, automotive and aerospace customers every week

Compensation and details

* ₹18,000 – ₹22,000 per month, depending on hands\-on experience
* Day shift, Monday to Saturday
* In person at Nerul West, Navi Mumbai

We are looking for a **Lead Generation Executive** who will work purely on **outbound telecalling** — no digital marketing, no social media promotion. The executive will call an assigned prospect database, explain the Alibaba GGS membership in detail, build the prospect's interest and conviction, and take them close to the closing/payment stage. **Company:** Smartfin Corporate Advisors Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Business Development  
**Location:** Mumbai / Navi Mumbai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–4 years / Freshers also Welcome  
**Reporting To:** Business Head / Director

About the Role

We are looking for an energetic and target\-oriented **Business Development Officer (BDO)** to expand our network of Chartered Accountants, DSAs, Tax Consultants, Financial Consultants, Business Consultants and other referral partners.

The primary responsibility of this role is to **identify, approach, meet, onboard and activate new channel partners** who can refer MSME and SME loan requirements to Smartfin.

This is a field\-oriented relationship\-building role and requires excellent communication, follow\-up and networking skills.

Key Responsibilities1\. Channel Partner Acquisition

* Identify potential CAs, DSAs, Tax Consultants, Financial Consultants and other professionals.
* Build a database of prospective channel partners.
* Conduct daily outbound calls and WhatsApp/LinkedIn outreach.
* Fix and conduct face\-to\-face meetings.
* Explain Smartfin's products, process and partner proposition.
* Onboard new associates as per company process.

2\. Channel Partner Activation

* Maintain regular contact with newly onboarded associates.
* Understand their client base and potential business opportunities.
* Educate partners about suitable loan products.
* Generate regular referrals from existing associates.
* Follow up with inactive associates and reactivate them.

3\. Business Generation

* Generate MSME/SME loan leads through the channel\-partner network.
* Understand the basic requirement of the client before passing the lead to the internal team.
* Coordinate with the sales and processing team for further action.
* Track every lead until it is either converted or closed.

4\. Field Sales \& Networking

* Visit CA offices, DSA offices, business consultants and commercial establishments.
* Attend networking events and MSME/business meets.
* Develop relationships with professionals who can generate recurring referrals.
* Identify new geographical and professional segments for expansion.

5\. Follow\-Up

* Maintain systematic follow\-up with prospects and existing associates.
* Ensure no lead or partner opportunity remains unattended.
* Maintain next\-action dates in CRM.
* Follow up with partners for pending documents and client information wherever required.

6\. CRM \& MIS

* Maintain complete records of prospects, meetings, associates and leads.
* Update CRM on a daily basis.
* Submit daily activity reports.
* Submit weekly performance reports to the Business Head.
* Maintain an active pipeline of prospective and existing channel partners.

Daily Activity Expectations

The BDO will be expected to achieve approximately:

* **30–40 new outbound calls**
* **10–15 follow\-up calls**
* **3–5 partner meetings**
* **5–10 new prospects added to CRM**
* **100% CRM update of daily activities**
* Continuous WhatsApp/LinkedIn outreach to relevant prospects

Monthly KPIsKPITargetNew prospects contacted500\+Meetings conducted60–80New channel partners onboarded15–20Qualified loan enquiries20–30Loan files generated10–15Active partners10\+Partner follow\-ups100%CRM updating100%

*Targets can be modified after the first 60–90 days based on actual conversion data.*

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* Highly energetic and self\-driven.
* Comfortable with field sales and travelling.
* Excellent at communication and relationship building.
* Persistent with follow\-ups.
* Comfortable making a large number of calls every day.
* Target\-oriented and commercially minded.
* Able to independently manage a territory/network.
* Comfortable using WhatsApp, Excel/Google Sheets and CRM software.

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience in any of the following sectors will be preferred:

* Banking / NBFC
* Loan DSA
* Financial services
* Insurance
* Mutual funds
* Real estate
* B2B sales
* CA/Tax consultancy relationship management
* Channel partner acquisition

Qualification

**Minimum:** Graduate in any discipline.

MBA/PGDM in Sales \& Marketing or relevant financial\-services experience will be an advantage.

Compensation

**Salary:** ₹25,000–₹40,000 per month depending on experience and capability.

In addition to fixed salary, the candidate will be eligible for **performance\-based incentives** linked to:

* New partner acquisition
* Qualified leads
* Files generated
* Successful disbursements
* Revenue generated through the partner network

Career Growth

A successful candidate can grow into:

**BDO → Senior BDO → BDM – Channel Partners → Regional Channel Partner Manager**

What Success Looks Like

The objective is not simply to make calls.

The BDO should gradually build a **large, active and recurring referral network** for Smartfin, so that the company receives a predictable flow of MSME loan enquiries without depending entirely on the Business Head's personal networking.

Important Hiring Note

We are looking for a **hunter**, not an office\-based telecaller.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable with:

**Call → Meeting → Relationship → Onboarding → Follow\-up → Referral → File → Disbursement**

The person will be measured primarily on **productive meetings, active partners and business generated**, rather than merely the number of calls made.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

title: SCRUM MASTER L1
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
**Role Purpose** 




 As a trained Scrum Master, you are responsible for facilitating a Scrum team and are accountable for removing impediments of the team to achieve the sprint goals/deliverables. You are responsible to ensure that the Scrum process is used as intended. A key part of your role is to protect the development team, allow the teams  to be self managed, foster collaboration across teams and keep them focused on the tasks at hand.
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 



* Is accountable for meeting Sprint objectives along with scrum team
* Ensure meeting of sprint commitment
* Own and help resolve impediments of the team
* Help PO adopt Scrum Process properly and ensure PO availability
* Support the PO in maintaining the Product Backlog, defining User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
* Facilitate estimation, backlog refinement and all planning ceremonies
* Ensure that DOR, DOD, Acceptance criteria is available and adhered to
* Ensure MoSCoW adherence of Sprint Backlog at the Sprint level
* Accountable for the correct implementation of the Agile Process
* Protect the team from external interference.
* Facilitate technical assistance to the team and enables clear communication amongst the team members
* Participate in Scrum of Scrum across teams and highlights impediments
* Provide feedback on the team members performance to the Agile Line manager and Agile Program Leader
* Facilitate all the Scrum Ceremonies (Planning, Daily Standup, Grooming, Demo, restrospection) and ensure correct adoption


 ͏
 * Ensure updating of all Scrum artifacts
* Ensure ALM tool (either client or Wipro) is updated on a daily basis
* Update key Scrum metrics into Wipro internal tool on a Sprint\-by\-Sprint basis
* Analyse key Scrum metrics and take corrective actions
* Create competency improvement and cross\-skilling plan for the team (by the start of the project). Review monthly and ensure improvement in competency score. Ensure multiskilling for at least 50% of the team.
* Help team attain stable velocity within 6\-8 sprints (allowing for 10% variation either way)
* Train team on the proper adoption of Agile processes  (Scrum / XP / Kanban)
* Help in adoption of engineering practices like ATDD, TDD, CI, CD, Refactoring
* Record and own the restrospection actions
* Participate in community of practice initiatives
* Provide inputs to the Line manager for internal quality forums (QIC  / APR / QBR / MBR etc.)

title: UI/UX Designer - Intern
description:
**Who Are We**
 Raptee.HV is a full\- stack electric motorcycle startup with a very strong technical moat, founded in 2019 by four engineers from Chennai (Ex Tesla, Wipro), working on bringing a no\-compromise upgrade motorcycle to an otherwise scooter\- only EV market. Raptee is incubated at CIIC \& ARAI.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We’re not just building Motorcycles, we’re building smart machines that vibe with their riders. To pull that off, we need design minds who can mix logic with aesthetics, function with feelings. As a UX/UI Design Intern at Raptee, you won’t just design screens you’ll design experiences riders flex about after every ride. From apps to dashboards, your pixels will set the tone for the future of riding.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Design apps, dashboards, and interfaces that riders will love using every day making every ride smoother, smarter, and more engaging.
* Turn complex information like battery stats and ride analytics into clear, approachable, and visually compelling experiences.
* Prototype ideas quickly sketch, wireframe, test, and iterate until your concepts come alive.
* Bring bold, fresh ideas to the table and challenge existing patterns to push our design language forward.
* See your work make an impact on real products. Your designs won’t sit in a folder, they’ll be in the hands of real riders.
* Work across platforms, from our mobile app to the motorcycle’s HMI, creating a seamless rider\-first journey.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and fellow designers to bring ideas from concept to reality.
* Keep learning and growing by experimenting with new tools, methods, and design trends.
* Contribute to evolving our design systems with your unique perspective.
* Always design with the rider in mind, ensuring every detail enhances the overall riding experience.


**Requirements**
* Currently pursuing or Bachelor's degree in CS, IT, Design, or related field.
* Strong understanding of UX/UI design principles and methodologies.
* Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch.
* Passion for solving complex design challenges and creating exceptional user experiences.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment and adapt to changing priorities.


**What We’re Looking For**
* A portfolio that shows creativity, curiosity, and potential, not just perfection.
* Someone who thinks beyond screens and understands that great design is about how it feels, not just how it looks.
* Passion, curiosity, and a growth mindset. We value drive over years of experience.
* Strong skills in Figma; motion design or prototyping experience is a big plus.
* A naturally curious learner who’s always exploring new tools, trends, and ideas.
* A collaborator who thrives in a team but is confident in bringing their own perspective and ideas forward.


**Benefits**
* Opportunity to work in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* A culture that fosters collaboration and creativity within the team.
* Collaboration with seasoned experts in the field.
* Gain valuable experience in UI/UX design and contribute to innovative projects.
* A stipend of INR 15000/\- per month is provided for the internship.

title: UX Designer
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a UX Designer based in India.**
 Join a small, high\-ownership design team shaping how people discover and shop through AI\-powered experiences on connected TVs. You will own user experiences end to end, from understanding the underlying problem to delivering polished, production\-ready solutions. The role combines user\-centered thinking, interaction design, visual craft, prototyping, and close collaboration with product and engineering teams. You will tackle a relatively unexplored design space where traditional mobile patterns cannot simply be transferred to the living room. Your work will influence how commerce, discovery, and AI come together on large screens and remote\-driven interfaces. This is an opportunity to work in an ambitious environment where designers have meaningful ownership and are expected to bring both creativity and strong product judgment.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Understand user needs and product objectives before beginning design work, challenging assumptions and clarifying the underlying problem to be solved.
* Explore multiple design directions, communicate the reasoning behind different approaches, and make informed decisions based on user needs, product goals, and technical considerations.
* Design complete end\-to\-end experiences rather than isolated screens, accounting for loading, empty, error, first\-use, offline, and other important states.
* Create polished user interfaces within an established design system, extending existing patterns thoughtfully when new interaction requirements arise.
* Prototype interactions when static designs are insufficient, particularly for motion, navigation, focus behavior, and remote\-driven interactions on connected TV experiences.
* Work closely with product managers and engineers throughout development, maintaining design quality from initial concept through implementation and launch.
* Present design rationale clearly through the most effective artifacts, including user flows, prototypes, comparisons, and other visual or interactive explorations.
* Participate actively in design critiques, provide constructive feedback, collaborate with peers, and contribute to a supportive and high\-performing design culture.
* Take ownership of edge cases and interaction details that can significantly affect the usability and quality of large\-screen experiences.
* Help explore emerging opportunities for AI as a design material and contribute to new interaction paradigms for AI\-powered consumer products.


**Requirements**
* Approximately 2\-4 years of experience designing consumer\-facing digital products, with shipped work that demonstrates your ability to take designs from concept through production.
* A strong portfolio that demonstrates design thinking and decision\-making, including the alternatives considered, trade\-offs made, and lessons learned—not just polished final screens.
* Strong visual and interaction design skills, with high standards for craft and the judgment to know when additional refinement adds value.
* Experience designing complete user journeys and accounting for complex interaction states, rather than focusing exclusively on happy\-path experiences.
* Comfort working with ambiguity and the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and define problems when requirements are not fully specified.
* Ability to collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and other stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain design decisions and incorporate constructive feedback.
* Curiosity about AI and an interest in exploring AI as a fundamental design material rather than simply adding AI\-powered features to existing experiences.
* Experience designing for connected TV, OTT platforms, or other large\-screen interfaces is an advantage but is not required.
* A pragmatic approach to design tools, with a focus on sound judgment, user outcomes, and product quality rather than attachment to any particular software.


**Benefits**
* Opportunity to work on emerging AI\-powered commerce and discovery experiences.
* High ownership within a deliberately small design team, with meaningful responsibility for real product surfaces.
* Opportunity to shape new interaction patterns for connected TV and large\-screen experiences.
* Exposure to AI, consumer technology, e\-commerce, and emerging digital product experiences.
* Close collaboration with product and engineering teams throughout the full product lifecycle.
* Opportunity to work on products reaching large and diverse consumer audiences.
* A creative environment that values experimentation, strong design craft, thoughtful decision\-making, and constructive critique.
* Opportunity to contribute to a relatively new design space without being constrained by an established playbook.
* Competitive compensation and benefits, subject to the applicable employment package.
* India\-based opportunity with a Bangalore location.

 **AI\-powered matching process** 
 to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top\-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We are looking for a talented **Human Resources Business Partner** to join our dedicated team at our office in **Vikhroli, Mumbai**.

  

Position Responsibilities

  

Strategic HR Partnership

* Partner with project leaders, engineering heads, and functional managers to align people strategies with business and project goals.
* Translate business requirements into HR initiatives covering talent, capability building, and organizational effectiveness.
* Provide data\-driven insights on workforce trends, attrition, productivity, and engagement.


Talent Management \& Workforce Planning

* Support manpower planning for projects including mobilization, ramp\-ups, and demobilization.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition for timely hiring of project, engineering, and support roles.
* Identify critical roles and high\-potential talent, support succession planning and development initiatives.


Performance Management

* Drive the end\-to\-end performance management process in alignment with global or organizational frameworks.
* Coach managers on goal setting, performance reviews, feedback, and performance differentiation.
* Support performance improvement initiatives, including Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).


Employee Relations \& Engagement

* Act as the first point of contact for employee relations matters within assigned business units.
* Proactively manage employee concerns, grievances, and disciplinary cases with fairness and consistency.
* Design and implement employee engagement initiatives suitable for project\-based and site environments.


Learning \& Capability Development

* Identify skill gaps in project and engineering teams and support targeted learning interventions.
* Partner with L\&D teams to roll out technical, leadership, and behavioral training programs.
* Support development plans for high\-potential employees and future project leaders.


Change Management \& Organizational Effectiveness

* Support organizational changes such as restructuring, project transitions, role changes, and site closures.
* Enable leaders through communication planning, change readiness, and stakeholder management.
* Drive adoption of new HR policies, processes, and systems.


Compensation, Benefits \& Rewards

* Support annual salary reviews and bonus planning.
* Provide guidance on job evaluations, pay benchmarking, and internal equity.
* Drive rewards and recognition initiatives aligned with project milestones and performance.


HR Operations, Policy \& Compliance

* Ensure compliance with labor laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies.
* Support audits, documentation, and adherence to company governance standards.
* Partner with HR Operations to ensure smooth execution of employee lifecycle processes.


Qualifications \& Requirements:
* MBA / master’s in human resources or equivalent.
* 12\+ years of progressive HR experience (flexible based on role level).
* Prior experience as HRBP in Consulting, Engineering, Pharma, Life Sciences environments preferred.
* Experience supporting multi\-location or site/project\-based workforce is a strong advantage.


About Us:

IPS, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a global leader in technical consulting, architecture, engineering, procurement, construction management, commissioning, qualification, and validation services for technically complex facilities. Integration is how we think and work. It requires the ability to unite existing and emerging technologies into a process that reliably delivers products and accelerates speed to market. That end\-to\-end mindset allows us to be agile and anticipate challenges as we move projects toward operational readiness. IPS applies design and delivery expertise, client\-side experience, and supplier\-side insight to every project. We infuse our curiosity, our passion, and our commitment to partnership in delivering solutions at any scale. We meet our clients where they are and get them to where they need to go. That’s only possible when we care as much as our clients do.  

Specialties  

Process Architecture, Process Design, Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Qualification, LEAN Project Delivery, Strategic Master Planning, Energy Conservation Management, Project Controls, Program/Project Management, Operations/Logistics Strategy and Planning, EPCMV, and Staffing Services.  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at IPS without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or any other status protected by law. **Manager – Operations Excellence (AI \& GenAI)**

 **About Catalyst Brands:**  

Catalyst Brands is a leading U.S.\-based retail organization formed in 2025through the merger of JCPenney and SPARC Group, combining multiple iconic fashion brands under one umbrella. Headquartered in Plano, Texas, Catalyst Brands focuses on delivering modern retail experiences while leveraging the heritage of established global brands. With a workforce of over tens of thousands and multi\-billion\-dollar revenue, the organization operates at a large scale across retail, e\-commerce, and supply chain domains. The company emphasizes innovation, digital transformation, and customer\-centric strategies to enhance brand value and consumer engagement. Catalyst Brands is expanding its global presence, including a growing capability centre in India that supports technology, digital operations, and analytics. It aims to drive operational excellence and business growth by integrating technology, data\-driven insights, and efficient retail practices.

 ***Role Summary***

  

Lead the Finance AI and Transformation agenda across Catalyst Brands Finance by identifying, prioritizing, implementing, and scaling AI\-, automation\-, and agentic workflow\-driven solutions. Partner with Finance leaders to transform manual processes into intelligent, scalable, and measurable digital capabilities while ensuring business value realization.


Core Responsibilities

  

AI Strategy \& Transformation  

* Develop and execute Finance AI roadmap
* Identify and prioritize AI opportunities across Finance functions
* Build Finance AI adoption framework and governance
* Drive Finance transformation initiatives aligned with CFO priorities
* Establish Finance AI Center of Excellence (CoE) capability

AI Use Case Discovery  

* Conduct structured discovery sessions with Finance leaders
* Evaluate opportunities based on value, feasibility, and data readiness
* Build and maintain AI opportunity portfolio
* Develop business cases and implementation roadmaps

Operational Excellence \& Transformation  

* Partner with AP, Payroll, GL , Inventory and Credit/CSA managers to define annual productivity, cycle\-time, and quality improvement goals.
* Conduct process diagnostics, maturity assessments, and root cause analysis to identify systemic inefficiencies and eliminate waste.
* Lead Lean\-driven improvements that enhance throughput, SLA performance, stability, and control posture across all three functions.
* Establish enterprise\-aligned governance rhythms — weekly dashboards, KPI packs, exception logs, audit readiness scorecards.
* Ensure standardized execution of Ops Excellence frameworks across towers, reducing variation and strengthening process predictability.

Controls, Compliance \& Quality  

* Strengthen maker–checker, exception governance, reconciliation controls, and audit preparedness across all three operational towers.
* Identify control gaps, analyze exceptions, and implement systemic fixes to reduce defects, rework, and audit observations.
* Drive compliance with SOPs, DoA policies, reconciliation timelines, data\-quality requirements, and regulatory expectations.
* Partner with Quality/Controls teams to embed preventive controls, enhance evidence trails, and support certifications and audits.

People, Capability \& Change Management  

* Coach tower managers and teams on Lean, structured problem solving, AI literacy, process thinking, and automation\-first ways of working.
* Conduct Kaizens, workshops, learning sprints, and capability uplift initiatives that build CI culture across AP, Payroll, General Accounting End to end process and Inventory End to End and Credit/CSA.
* Develop change adoption plans, communication packs, and updated SOPs/playbooks to ensure successful rollout of new processes/tools.


Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration  

* Engage closely with US/SLC stakeholders, Finance Ops leadership, IT/Access, Procurement, HR, Merchant Services, Accounting/GL, and other upstream/downstream partners.
* Drive structured issue triage, escalation management, and cross\-functional alignment on volume spikes, close cycles, and system changes.
* Provide leadership with data\-backed recommendations, trend insights, and process/automation opportunity identification.

Automation \& Agentic Workflows  

* Lead implementation of AI agents and workflow automation
* Design agentic workflows across Finance processes
* Drive process simplification before automation
* Scale successful pilots into enterprise\-wide solutions

Change Management  

* Drive AI adoption across the Finance organization
* Build training and capability\-building programs
* Track adoption and value realization
* Partner with leadership to remove barriers to adoption

KPI \& Value Realization  

* Establish productivity, quality, cycle\-time, and adoption KPIs
* Measure benefits at 30/60/90 days
* Report outcomes to Finance leadership
* Ensure realized business value from investments

Systems Exposure  

Preferred experience with:  

* OneStream
* Oracle EBS
* Kyriba
* Esker
* Infor Nexus
* Power Platform
* Microsoft Copilot
* Power BI
* SharePoint
* Teams
* AI Agent Platforms
* Workflow Automation Platforms
  

Experience:

* 8–12\+ years experience
* Finance Shared Services / Controllers / FP\&A / Transformation
* Experience leading digital transformation initiatives
* Process Excellence and Automation experience
* Exposure to AI, Machine Learning, Copilot, or GenAI programs preferred

Qualifications  

* CA / CMA / MBA Finance / Commerce Graduate
* Lean Six Sigma preferred
* AI, Data Analytics, Power Platform certifications desirable
* Program Management experience preferred
  

Competencies:

* Analytical rigor and structured problem\-solving
* Digital\-first mindset with strong curiosity and experimentation orientation
* Influential communicator with strong stakeholder management
* Strong execution discipline and data\-backed decision making
* Ability to simplify complexity and drive clarity in ambiguous environments
* Innovation, creativity, and solution\-oriented thinking

  

Behavioral Expectations:  

* High ownership, accountability, and proactive risk management
* Transparent communicator; escalates early and clearly
* Inclusive leadership that builds capability across teams
* Calm under pressure; thrives in high\-volume, fast\-paced operations
* Demonstrates continuous learning and embraces emerging technologies

	+ Develop deep fluency in Engineering/R\&D operations, technology cost drivers, and symplr’s product/platform investment model.

	+ Work collaboratively across U.S. and India time zones, balancing responsiveness with high\-quality, well\-organized analytical output.
	+ Bring curiosity, ownership, and continuous\-improvement mindset to a growing FP\&A function that is being built as an enterprise decision engine.

* Experience with workforce planning, headcount modeling, variance analysis, forecast support, vendor/contractor spend analysis, or management reporting strongly preferred.
* Exposure to PE\-backed, high\-growth, scaling, multi\-product, or operationally complex businesses is helpful but not required.

* Strong financial modeling, Excel, analytical, and problem\-solving skills, with ability to manage detail while telling a clear business story.
* Working knowledge of workforce planning, scenario analysis, variance analysis, cost\-center reporting, vendor analytics, and productivity metrics.
* Familiarity with R\&D capitalization, OpEx/CapEx concepts, cloud/tooling cost analysis, and technology cost structures preferred.
* Comfortable working with planning systems, BI tools, ERP/financial systems, and large datasets; curiosity about automation and AI\-enabled analytical improvements.

 **WAYS OF WORKING**

* Hands\-on analyst with strong ownership, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to ask why before accepting surface\-level answers.
* High attention to detail, strong documentation habits, and commitment to producing accurate, timely, and explainable work product.
* Clear communicator who can summarize analysis, risks, and drivers for finance and non\-finance stakeholders.
* Builder mindset with a bias toward practical process improvement, scalable reporting, and continuous learning.

**Job Title:** Operations Manager (B2C Customer Support \| Voice \& Chat)  

**Location:** Hyderabad  

**Shifts:** Rotational Shift including night shifts  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  

**About Us:**  

UnifyCX is a transformative AI platform that empowers and enables teams to deliver efficient, exceptional customer experiences. We engineer superhuman customer experiences through a powerful blend of strategy, omnichannel support, analytics, and AI\-driven tools like GoTalent.AI, Voice of Customer, and automatic QA. Our outcome\-based model prioritizes measurable results for more than 200 client programs serviced today. With a focus on automation, talent enablement, strategic partnerships, and strict data ethics, UnifyCX delivers scalable, personalized, and compliant solutions that create real business impact.  

UnifyCX is a certified minority\-owned business and an EOE employer who welcomes diversity.

**Job Summary**
The Operations Manager is responsible for end\-to\-end delivery of B2C Customer Support operations across voice and chat channels. This role ensures achievement of business KPIs, operational excellence, customer experience, people development, and compliance while managing Team Leads and support functions such as Quality and Training.
**Key Responsibilities**
**1\. Operations \& Delivery Management**
* Manage overall day\-to\-day operations for B2C Customer support processes (Voice \& Chat).
* Own and deliver key KPIs including CSAT, FCR, Quality, AHT, Productivity, and Service\-to\-Sales.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, schedules, and workforce plans.

**2\. People \& Performance Management**
* Lead, mentor, and develop Team Leads and mid\-level managers.
* Drive performance management, succession planning, and talent retention.
* Partner with HR, Training, and Quality teams for capability building.

**3\. Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
* Participate in business reviews, performance calls, and client calibrations.
* Share operational insights, risks, and improvement plans.

**4\. Quality, Compliance \& Risk Management**
* Ensure compliance with quality standards, SOPs, and regulatory requirements.
* Review quality trends, customer feedback, and repeat contact drivers.
* Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies.

**5\. Process Improvement \& Innovation**
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and customer experience.
* Use data and analytics to identify root causes and optimize processes.
* Support automation, knowledge base enhancements, and tool adoption.

**6\. Financial \& Business Management**
* Manage budgets, cost controls, and resource optimization.
* Support hiring plans, ramp\-ups, and capacity management.
* Contribute to business growth, transitions, and new process launches.

**Qualifications \& Experience**
✔ Graduate / Postgraduate preferred  

✔ 8–12 years of overall BPO / Contact Center experience  

✔ 3–5 years in an Operations Manager or equivalent leadership role  

✔ Strong experience managing B2C Telecom / ISP technical support  

✔ Proven track record of delivering KPIs across voice \& chat channels  

✔ Strong people leadership, stakeholder management, and analytical skills  

✔ Flexible to work shifts and support business needs

About ArangoDB


Arango delivers a unified, natively multimodel contextual data platform that powers AI agents, assistants, and applications with the unified, current, and trusted business context needed to reason, decide, and act at scale.  

The Arango Contextual Data Platform connects fragmented enterprise data with LLMs, copilots, and AI agents through a simplified architecture delivered out of the box. By combining graph, vector, document, key\-value, and search capabilities in a single platform, Arango eliminates the complex stacks many organizations build to operationalize enterprise AI.  

Trusted by organizations including NVIDIA, HPE, the London Stock Exchange, PSI CRO, the U.S. Air Force, NIH, Siemens, Transient.AI, Matpriskollen, and Articul8, Arango helps enterprises move from AI pilots to reliable production systems faster while lowering infrastructure complexity and total cost of ownership. Arango is a proud member of the NVIDIA Inception Program and the AWS ISV Accelerate Program. Learn more at arango.ai, LinkedIn, and G2\.

  

Location: Hyderabad, India (new office), hybrid


Reports to: Initially reports to Site Manager, dotted line reports to Global Director of Human Resources

### **Role Overview**


As the founding member of the new India office, you will be the right hand to the Site Manager during the critical launch phase of our India operations. This is a high\-impact, multifaceted role where you will manage the administrative backbone of the company—from coordinating office build\-outs and vendor relationships to executing the daily HR operations that support our growing engineering team.


Key Responsibilities:

#### **1\. Recruitment \& HR Coordination**

* Lead the day\-one orientation for new hires, ensuring all equipment, access badges, and "welcome kits" are ready.
* Maintain secure employee files and ensure all mandatory local documents (Form 11, Aadhaar/PAN copies) are collected and filed.
* Support the payroll team by working with our local payroll provider to track attendance, leaves, and reimbursement claims for monthly processing.
* Assist the Site Manager in scheduling interviews, managing candidate pipelines to scale the engineering team.

#### **2\. Office Administration**

* Support the initial office setup by coordinating with interior designers, IT installers, and furniture vendors.
* Act as the primary point of contact for the facility manager, ensuring the office is clean, stocked with supplies, office keys are safely managed, and fully functional.
* Manage relationships with local service providers (Internet, Utilities, Housekeeping, and Security).
* Arrange travel and accommodation for visiting guests, global leadership and local team events.
* IT equipment shipping and handling, and tracking

#### **3\. Compliance \& Legal Support**

* Assist the Site Manager in gathering documents required for MCA filings, GST registrations, and labor law compliance.
* Ensure the office remains compliant with local safety regulations and support the implementation of POSH Act awareness training.

  

Skills and Experience:

* Experience: 10\+ years of experience in HR Administration or Office Management, preferably within a fast\-paced tech startup or a multinational company.
* Fluent in English and Hind (both written and spoken)i; proficiency in the local regional language of the office site is a strong advantage.
* High proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and familiarity with HRIS/Payroll software.
* A proven ability to juggle multiple operational tasks with high attention to detail and zero oversight.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with the "Shops and Establishments Act" and basic Indian labor law compliance.
* Experience working in a global team environment.

**What Makes Arango Special?**
------------------------------


At Arango, we believe that AI is only as powerful as the data foundation. Our mission is to help organizations build AI systems that can reason, decide and act based on unified, current, and trusted business context at scale. We are helping define a new category of infrastructure: the contextual data layer for AI.


Working at Arango means:

* Collaborating with experienced engineers, marketers, and product leaders
* Helping shape how enterprises build AI\-powered applications


If you're excited about the intersection of AI, data, and social media, we’d love to hear from you.

The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership, enterprise network engineering depth, operational discipline, stakeholder management, and delivery execution. People \& Talent Leadership

* Lead and develop an India\-based team of network engineers and technical specialists.

We seek creative, customer\-focused individuals with strong enterprise network engineering experience, people leadership capability, and a mindset for continuous improvement. * Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Thank you for your interest in Shell.**

* 

**An Inclusive \& Progressive Place to Work**

* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.

**Shell in India**

Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R\&D, digitalisation, and business operations.


Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net\-zero emissions energy business by 2050\. As India moves towards its target of net\-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.


Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end\-to\-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world\-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350\-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.


Shell owns and operates a LNG re\-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck\-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1\.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.


Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting\-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.


We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco\-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

title: GCC Human Resources - Director
description:
Who We Are
  
At Fossil Group, we are part of an international team that dares to dream, disrupt, and deliver innovative watches, jewelry, and leather goods to the world. We're committed to long\-term value creation, driven by technology and our core values: Authenticity, Grit, Curiosity, Humor, and Impact. If you are a forward\-thinker who thrives in a diverse, global setting, we want to hear from you.
  
  

MAKE AN IMPACT
  
We are seeking a talented and people driven Director – HR, FGSI to join our Human Resources team at Fossil Group in Bangalore, GBS. If you are passionate about strategic people leadership and enjoy shaping high\-performing organizations through talent, culture, and organizational transformation, this could be the perfect role for you. In this dynamic and global company, you will serve as a strategic partner to the FGSI leadership team, enabling business performance through an engaged, capable, and future\-ready workforce.
  
This is a hybrid position based in our Bangalore office. You will be required to work onsite from Monday through Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Fridays. This role reports directly to the Sr. Director \& Head of HR – India.
  
What you will do in this role
  
HR Strategy \& Business Partnership
  
* Lead the implementation of the people strategy for FGSI, translating business priorities into targeted HR interventions and measurable outcomes.
* Partner with the FGSI leadership team on organization structure, workforce planning, capability requirements, and strategic people decisions.
* Assess external HR trends and evolving people practices to identify opportunities that strengthen organizational effectiveness.
* Advise leaders on organization design, talent priorities, employee engagement, and people\-related business decisions.


Culture, Leadership \& Organizational Effectiveness
  
* Shape a high\-performance culture that reflects Fossil Group’s values and enables empowered, accountable leadership.
* Act as a change agent, leading people and organizational change initiatives through effective communication and stakeholder engagement.
* Strengthen leadership capability and build a strong, connected FGSI leadership team.
* Foster an inclusive environment with fair, consistent, and effective employee and workplace relations practices.


Talent, Performance \& Capability
  
* Drive talent management, succession planning, and workforce capability strategies aligned with FGSI’s business objectives.
* Identify current and future capability gaps and develop strategies to build, develop, or acquire critical talent.
* Partner with global, regional, and local HR teams to strengthen talent quality, organization effectiveness, and leadership pipelines.
* Build strong talent pipelines and engagement strategies to attract, develop, and retain high\-performing talent.


Total Rewards, HR Operations \& Transformation
  
* Oversee the development and implementation of competitive compensation, benefits, reward, and recognition practices aligned with local requirements.
* Partner with relevant teams on HRIS implementation, people analytics, reporting, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Ensure effective implementation of HR policies, processes, and principles while maintaining strong operational delivery and compliance.
* Lead learning and organizational development initiatives that build capabilities and support continuous improvement.
* Drive HR projects and change initiatives across a matrixed, global environment, ensuring effective execution and sustainable outcomes.


Who You Are
  
* MBA or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a relevant discipline.
* 16\+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, preferably within a multinational organization and Global Business Services/Captive Centre environment.
* Proven experience operating in a senior HR leadership capacity such as HR Director or Senior HR Manager.
* Strong track record in strategic HR business partnering across multiple functions and business lines within a global organization.
* Demonstrated expertise across organization design, talent management, succession planning, performance management, employee relations, and HR transformation.
* Strong knowledge of HR processes, employment practices, compliance requirements, and workplace relations.
* Experience leading change management and HR projects within complex, matrixed organizations.
* Strong leadership, influencing, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior business leaders and global HR teams.


What We Offer
  
* Opportunities to shape people strategy and organizational transformation within a global lifestyle brand.
* Exposure to global leadership teams, cross\-functional partnerships, and international HR initiatives.
* Learning and development opportunities to support continuous professional growth.
* Employee product discounts across Fossil Group brands.
* An inclusive, collaborative, and values\-driven culture that encourages curiosity, innovation, and impact.
* The opportunity to make a meaningful difference to talent, culture, leadership, and business performance.


At Fossil Group, we embrace purpose and take every opportunity to work together to make the world a little better. We’re committed to fostering a culture of inclusivity and collaboration, where all employees are encouraged to contribute their unique selves and perspectives as valued members of our team.
  
  

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer dedicated to a policy of non\-discrimination in all employment practices without regard to age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, pregnancy, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  

If you need any accommodations during the interview process, just let us know at careers@fossil.com.

title: Partner Readiness Manager
description:
**Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning**

Pigment is the AI\-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature\-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.

With a team of 600\+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top\-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.  

We are looking for a highly technical, business\-savvy **Partner Readiness Manager (PRM)** specializing in the EPM market. In this role, you will act as the technical backbone of our Partner Alliance organization, working hand\-in\-hand with Partner Account Managers (PAMs) and Partner Sales Managers (PSMs). Your mission is to enable, coach, and elevate our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), ensuring they have the architectural expertise required to design and deliver world\-class Pigment solutions for enterprise customers.
### **What You Will Do:**

### **Partner Strategy \& Enablement**


* Drive the technical execution strategy for assigned GSIs and RSIs, aligning Pigment product capabilities with partner industry practices.
* Lead the maturity of partner Centers of Excellence (CoEs) through technical health checks, architectural standards, and early access to the product roadmap.
* Design and deliver advanced enablement programs for partner Solutions Architects and Lead Model Builders, including bootcamps, architectural reviews, and hackathons.
* Design and scale a structured technical onboarding program for new implementation partners, ensuring proficiency in Pigment's platform and delivery standards.
* Publish reusable technical assets, integration guides, and model\-building best practices to accelerate time\-to\-value.
* Champion the adoption of Pigment's native AI capabilities and AI\-assisted modeling tools in partner implementations to ensure delivery quality and reduce time\-to\-value for customers.

### **Strategic Deal Support**


* Support partner\-led sales cycles on strategic accounts by leading discovery sessions, framing business value, and driving technical wins against legacy EPM competitors.
* Oversee high\-impact scoping workshops and POCs led by partners, ensuring models are structured for multi\-year scalability and performance.
* Act as the technical liaison between GSI delivery teams and Pigment's internal Product and Professional Services teams to unblock complex implementation hurdles.

### **Technical Depth**


* Serve as the subject matter expert on Pigment's core architecture, including advanced multi\-dimensional modeling, dependency mapping, and formula optimization.
* Guide partners on data pipelines connecting Pigment with ERPs (Workday, NetSuite, SAP), CRMs (Salesforce), HRIS (Workday, BambooHR), and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery).
* Enable and support partners on best practices for migrating customers off legacy EPM systems (Anaplan, Hyperion, Cognos, Adaptive) to Pigment's modern architecture.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to synthesize partner field feedback into actionable product recommendations
* Mentor internal Solutions Consultants and Technical Account Managers on GSI engagement models, delivery governance, and partner relationship management.
### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field. An MBA or Master's in Finance/Data Science is a plus.
* 5\+ years in a highly technical consulting or solution architecture role within the EPM/Business Planning space (e.g., Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive Insights, Planful, OneStream, or Hyperion).
* Strong experience working directly with or within GSIs (e.g., Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG, Slalom) to build technical capabilities and support complex delivery ecosystems.
* Proficiency in data modeling concepts, SQL, and API\-driven enterprise application integrations.

This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.*

*Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. title: Indirect Tax Senior Analyst
description:
**Job Description**  

The Indirect Tax Senior Analyst at NIQ enhances the Indirect Tax team within the Global Finance Operations. This position involves performing the day\-to\-day activities across global indirect tax compliance, indirect tax provisions, and coordinating with external advisors and tax authorities to ensure compliance with applicable indirect tax laws and regulations. The Indirect Tax Senior Analyst is instrumental in maintaining the highest standards of efficiency and effectiveness for indirect tax activities and adhering to clear service level agreements (SLAs) with internal stakeholders. Reporting to the Indirect Tax Manager, this role is pivotal in upholding our company's compliance and operational excellence in the realm of indirect taxation.


Key Responsibilities:

* Indirect Tax Reporting: Execute day\-to\-day operations related to global indirect tax reporting, ensuring accurate and timely filings.
* Compliance: Ensure all global indirect tax activities comply with local, regional, and international tax regulations, mitigating risks associated with non\-compliance.
* Third\-Party Coordination: Collaborate with third\-party outsourced providers to ensure the efficient delivery of global indirect tax filings, maintaining quality and accuracy standards.
* SLA Management: Develop and maintain clear SLAs with internal stakeholders to ensure indirect tax activities align with organizational expectations and standards.
* Process Improvement: Identify and implement process improvements within the indirect tax function to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.
* Regulatory Monitoring: Stay abreast of changes in indirect tax laws and regulations, ensuring NIQ's tax practices remain compliant and up to date.
* Collaboration: Work closely with the Indirect Tax Manager and other finance team members to support broader tax strategy and compliance efforts.

 **Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field. A professional certification in taxation or accounting (e.g., CA, CPA, CMA) is mandatory.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in indirect tax, preferably within finance operations environment or multinational corporation.
* Tax Knowledge: Knowledge of indirect tax regulations and reporting requirements across various jurisdictions.
* Analytical Abilities: Strong analytical skills with a keen attention to detail, capable of analyzing complex tax data and identifying compliance issues.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication abilities to effectively collaborate with team members, third\-party providers, and internal stakeholders.
* Organizational Skills: Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously, meeting tight deadlines without compromising quality or accuracy.
* Technical Proficiency: Proficient with tax software and ERP systems, as well as Microsoft Office Suite,
