Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

Positions in this function are responsible for development and interpretation of employment policies and practices, as well as consultation with the Employee Center and People Team on high\-risk, high\-level, or organization\-impacting workplace issues to ensure internal equity and legal compliance. Function is also responsible for risk mitigation and compliance activities, including responding to employment claims filed with external agencies, union avoidance and affirmative action requirements. In roles outside the United States, managers in this function may also be responsible for Employee relations. The ERES titles are intended to be used for these employees. Generally work is self\-directed and not prescribed.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* ERL\_Manage Employee Relations Cases
	+ Ensure appropriate and timely response to workplace issues (e.g., phone coverage, service requests)
	+ Ensure cases are opened and closed as required
	+ Manage case volume
	+ Ensure comprehensive documentation of ER cases (e.g., including all relevant information)
	+ Interpret, apply and ensure compliance with relevant company policies and applicable governmental laws/regulations for specific ER cases
	+ Identify appropriate actions for employees, managers and HCPs to take
	+ Escalate cases as appropriate (e.g., based on salary grade, issue complexity, legal/business risk)
* ERL\_Provide Consulting/Expertise on Employee Relations Issues
	+ Maintain knowledge of current best practices in the employee relations field (e.g., theories, frameworks, technologies, and trends)
	+ Provide leadership and direction to employees, managers and HCPs on handling workplace issues
	+ Establish personal trust and credibility with business partners and stakeholders (e.g., leaders, Human Capital Partners)
	+ Demonstrate a clear point of view about Human Capital activities as well as business needs
	+ Provide consulting to managers on Corrective Action issues (e.g., CAPs)
	+ Provide consulting on involuntary employee terminations issues, and process involuntary employee terminations
	+ Administer/support coordination for a variety of ER processes/initiatives/programs (e.g., I\-9, personnel file fulfillment, legal requests)
	+ Incorporate industry best practices into employee relations practices/programs (e.g., CLC, gOEbase, Bersin)
	+ Leverage and build upon current best practices to create industry\-leading employee relations practices/processes
	+ Manage/support Employee Relations programs/initiatives
	+ Provide support for RFPs
	+ Provide training on HRdirect/Employee Relations model and topics
* ERL\_Conduct/Support Investigation of Workplace Issues and Programs
	+ Investigate complex workplace issues (e.g., wage/hour, discrimination, harassment)
	+ Provide tools and coaching to managers and HCPs to help them conduct workplace investigations
	+ Manage/support Employee Relations programs/initiatives (e.g., random drug testing, background investigations)
	+ Manage the IDR process (e.g., meeting coordination/facilitation, review responses, obtain legal review)
	+ Identify the need to update/revise existing policies and create new policies based on company needs or legal/regulatory requirements
	+ Communicate and implement new/updated/revised policies
* ERL\_Conduct Reporting/Analysis of ER Activities
	+ Identify appropriate metrics and data collection approaches to support business needs (e.g., IDR volume, case volume, case types)
	+ Provide reporting to applicable stakeholders to meet business or legal needs
	+ Identify/communicate trends and information related to current business issues/needs (e.g., areas of concern, volume of employee complaints, management issues, financial impacts, training needs)
	+ Research complaints by location and/or manager as needed for investigations
	+ Analyze data/reports to help improve performance of the ER function
* ERL\_Manage/Support Auditing Activities
	+ Manage/support OFCCP audits
	+ Respond to OCFFP data requests
	+ Manage/support on\-site audit activities
	+ Provide policy support as needed for various auditing activities (e.g., CMS)
	+ Respond to Dept of Labor requests as needed (e.g., answer questions, provide data)
* ERL\_Manage the Downsizing Process
	+ Provide manager training on how to complete the business case, DA and notification training
	+ Coordinate/support communication strategies (e.g., employee notification, benefit impact calls)
	+ Work with managers to develop the business case
	+ Identify the impacted group
	+ Conduct competency and adverse impact analysis
	+ Prepare job title and age list
	+ Prepare severance agreements and outplacement packets
	+ Process payments and terminations
	+ Provide reports to finance on downsizing costs
	+ Works with less structured, more complex issues
	+ Serves as a resource to others
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience
* 7\+ years of experience in Employee Relations, Human Resources or Employment Legal
* Experience in conducting investigations and advising on or supporting local disciplinary and investigation processes
* Experience in establishing cross\-functional relationships at all levels and geographies

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

description:

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1725498
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Job Description: Assistant Manager – Employee Relations**


**Role :** Assistant Manager – Employee Relations


**Function Description:**



Employee Relations function is a Centre of Excellence function within the Talent organisation of EY Global Delivery Services (GDS). Employee Relations CoE works in close partnership with Strategic Talent Consultant function, GDS Ethics Office as well as GDS General Counsel’s Office and is primarily responsible for managing complex/sensitive ER incidents. The function continuously monitors the ER risk profile of the Firm and develop/deploy strategies to manage the same. ER CoE is also responsible to project manage Talent special projects and is the custodian of all Talent Policies.

  


**Job description:**


* Conduct workplace investigations into sensitive Employee Relations matters. This involves facilitating and documenting Investigation interviews, analysing evidence and drafting investigation findings reports.
* Partner with Senior ER professionals in providing guidance to Talent Consultants and Business Leaders in managing wide range of Employee Relation issues, including Code of conduct breaches, Performance lapses, Discrimination allegations, Workplace harassment allegations, Integrity issues etc., and ensure resolution of the same with minimal risk exposure to the Firm and its professionals.
* Maintain ER Incident data base, identify trends and thereby assist Talent leadership in developing appropriate strategies and initiatives to proactively mitigate ER risk exposures.
* Actively participate in special projects undertaken by EY GDS Employee Relations Centre of Excellence

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have:**


* **Education** : Master’s Degree in Human Resource Management or Business Administration with HR specialisation or Bachelor in Legislative Law (LLB)
* **Experience** : 6 \- 10 years of experience of Human Resources, with at least 4 years experience in Employment Law, preferably in Big Fours or Leading IT services/Consulting Firms.
* Should have strong knowledge of Indian employment law and regulations, especially related to conduct of disciplinary procedures, work\-place investigations, employment litigation procedures etc.
* Should possess exceptional written skills, specifically legal writing, as well as oral communication skills.
* Should have the capability to apply discretion and make sound judgement, even in highly stressful and emotional scenarios.
* Should have the ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information
* Should be able to navigate through complex, difficult, and ambiguous situations.

  


**What we offer**



EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across eight locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, Mexico, Philippines, Poland, Spain and Sri Lanka – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.


* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Analyst - Pension Administration
description:
**About Aptia**

Founded to shape the future of pensions, health, and insurance solutions, Aptia is a leading professional services firm dedicated to simplifying complexity for businesses and individuals. We bring together cutting\-edge technology and deep industry expertise to help organisations navigate an evolving landscape with clarity and confidence.


With a presence in the US, UK, India, and Portugal, we support over six million people and more than 1,100 clients, delivering solutions that drive efficiency, enhance financial security, and provide peace of mind.


Our strength lies in the combination of smart technology and expert teams, ensuring that managing pensions, health, and insurance is more effective. By focusing on innovation, accessibility, and client success, we help businesses take care of their people, so they can focus on what they do best.


And we are expanding. Aptia Group is not only fueled by our investors' backing but also by our commitment to foster the growth and success of our people. At Aptia, we're investing heavily in learning and development, paving unique career paths for our colleagues.


Specialist. Responsive. Thoughtful. Our values aren't just words; they are the backbone of our business. Our team embodies our values daily, to surpass client expectations, evolve constantly and nurture genuine relationships for the long\-term.


**Job requirements**

**Aptia** **Group** **is one of the largest defined benefits \& pension administration** **platforms in the UK \& US.**
=======================================================================================================================

**Job Description**
===================

Company


Aptia India


Position/ Title


**Senior Analyst – (Grade 1\)**

**Profile Specifics**

Department


Pension Administration


Location


Pune/Mumbai/Gurgaon


Role Overview


The Senior Analyst – Pension Administration is the entry\-level role within the pension operations hierarchy.
  

This role is responsible for carrying out day‑to‑day pension administration tasks, maintaining member records, and supporting accurate processing of member events under Defined Benefit (DB), Defined Contribution (DC), or Hybrid schemes.


As a frontline colleague, the Senior Analyst follows established procedures, works with high attention to detail, and ensures SLA‑driven delivery of calculations, data updates, and member communication drafts.
  

The role supports the wider team by completing assigned work efficiently, escalating issues appropriately, and contributing to high\-quality member service.


Role \& Responsibilities
 

**Member Event Processing**

* Process routine pension administration tasks such as Retirements, Leavers, Transfers, Deaths and member data updates.
* Follow documented procedures, Scheme Rules, and calculation guidance to complete work accurately and on time.
* Input and maintain member data across designated pension administration systems.

**Pension Calculations**

* Perform simple calculations using automated and manual tools, under supervision.
* Check own work carefully and escalate discrepancies or unclear cases to senior colleagues.
* Ensure calculation outputs are aligned with Scheme Rules and internal quality standards.

**Quality, Compliance \& Controls**

* Deliver work with strong accuracy and adherence to SLAs, audit requirements, and compliance standards.
* Follow data security policies and maintain confidentiality of member records.
* Escalate potential errors, risks, or issues in line with defined procedures.

Experience \& Qualifications


* 1–2 years of experience in pensions, financial services, shared services, or operations (freshers with strong aptitude may be considered).
* Basic understanding of Defined Benefit and Defined Contribution pension concepts — training will be provided.
* Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and willingness to learn technical pension rules.
* Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Proficiency in MS Office and ability to work with workflow systems.
* Professional pensions qualifications (PMI) — **not mandatory; training support may be offered** .

Reporting To


Operations Manager

**Nomura Overview:**

  

Nomura is an Asia\-headquartered financial services group with an integrated global network spanning over 30 countries. By connecting markets East \& West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its four business divisions: Retail, Asset Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking), and Merchant Banking. Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com

  

Nomura Services India, (Powai) supports Nomura’s businesses around the world. Powai’ s world class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support have played a key role in facilitating Nomura’s global operations and are an integral part of Nomura’s global expansion plans. The Powai operation is a critical part of the platform to support the growth of Nomura’s global business.

The Operations division provides the support and control infrastructure that enables the Firm to develop and deliver financial products throughout the world. Working with the Sales, Trading and Information Technology Divisions, Operations professionals are responsible for the management and execution of transactions in a manner which maximizes profitability and minimizes risk. Our division is responsible for the management and execution of millions of securities transactions on a daily basis. In partnership with sales, trading, prime services, information technology and other teams from across the bank, we apply a continual focus on improving productivity and efficiency, while seeking new and innovative ways to support our clients' changing needs.

The role of Shared Services is to support the activities of the Global Markets and IBD businesses. title: GTM Intern — Sales & Business Development
description:
**Hiring for: Proverse Talent — a proof\-led talent network for engineering, AI, product and go\-to\-market hiring.**  
**Role:** GTM Intern – Sales \& Business Development  
**Positions:** 1  
**Experience:** 0–1 Years / Freshers  
**Location:** Remote  
**Type:** Internship – 3–6 Months, with potential for Full\-Time conversion  
**Focus:** Lead Generation, Sales Pipeline, Business Development \& GTM Automation  
**Tools:** Claude, Notion, NotebookLM, MCPs

**About us**  
Proverse Talent is a recruiting company that runs on software we build ourselves. We place engineers and specialists for fast\-growing companies, and we're building the platform that makes that placement faster and more evidence\-based than a traditional agency can manage.

**Job Description**

That gives us three ways to make money, and this role touches all three.  
What you'd actually be doing  
**1 · Vendor empanelment — the one that unlocks everything**  
Getting Proverse onto a company's approved recruitment\-vendor list is the gate before any agency revenue exists. You'd research target companies, find who owns vendor decisions in TA and procurement, prepare empanelment documentation, manage submissions, and chase them to a decision. **This is a real, learnable, valuable skill, and most people your age have never been taught it.**  
**2 · Agency business development**  
Build and work a pipeline of companies hiring for roles we can fill. Research, outreach, qualification, and getting the right conversation into the founder's calendar.  
**3 · Marketplace and platform demand**  
Bring companies onto our marketplace to post roles, and recruiters onto our platform. Different audiences, different messaging — you'd help work out which lines land.  
Across all three, you'd own

* Building and maintaining the pipeline so nothing is lost and every lead is traceable
* Research on target companies, hiring signals, and the people who make the decision
* Tracking follow\-ups and activity — being the reason nothing goes cold
* Building simple automations so the same manual work doesn't get done twice
* Writing down what works, so the second month is easier than the first

What we're honest about  
You won't be closing deals in month one — the founder closes. **Your job is to create and qualify the opportunities that make closing possible**, and to build the process that lets us do it repeatably. If you're good at that, you'll be closing before the internship ends.

**What Good Looks Like**  
**30 Days**

* Build a clean pipeline and identify the top 50 target companies.

**60 Days**

* Get empanelment submissions moving and establish a consistent outreach process.

**90 Days**

* Identify which channels work best using response and conversion data, and help build a repeatable GTM process.

**Required**

* Genuinely strong research skills — you can find the right person and a reason to contact them
* Clear written English; most of this job is written
* Organised by instinct. A pipeline you don't maintain is worse than no pipeline
* Comfortable with AI tools as everyday leverage, not as a novelty
* Willing to hear "no" repeatedly and keep going

**Preferred**

* Any exposure to B2B sales, recruitment, or staffing
* Hands\-on with Claude, Notion, NotebookLM, or MCP\-based automation
* Understanding of how Indian enterprises procure vendors

**Not required:** a sales background, or a technical one. We'll teach the process.  
Why this is worth your time  
You'd be the first commercial hire, building the sales function rather than inheriting one — with direct access to the founder and real ownership of what gets tried. If it works, this becomes a full\-time role owning GTM.

Work Location: Remote

title: IT Support Engineer
description:
IT SUPPORT ENGINEER – JUNIOR LEVEL

**Job Title :** IT Support Engineer

**Experience :** Freshers / 0–2 Years

**Job Location:** Ernakulam

**Employment Type :** Full\-Time

PURPOSE

The IT Support Engineer will be responsible for providing day\-to\-day technical support to employees, maintaining IT infrastructure, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, supporting network and system operations, and ensuring smooth functioning of IT services across the organization.

The position is suitable for a **fresher or candidate with up to 2 years of relevant experience** who has a strong interest in IT support, troubleshooting, networking, and end\-user support.

KEY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES

IT Helpdesk \& User Support

* Provide first\-level technical support to employees for hardware, software, network, email, printer, and other IT\-related issues.
* Receive, record, troubleshoot, and resolve user IT support requests.
* Assist users with computer, laptop, printer, scanner, projector, and other IT equipment.
* Support employees in installation and configuration of required software and applications.
* Provide remote and on\-site technical assistance as required.
* Escalate complex technical issues to the IT Manager / IT \& ERP Coordinator or external service providers.

Hardware \& Software Support

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT devices.
* Assist in operating system installation, configuration, updates, and troubleshooting.
* Install and maintain approved software and applications.
* Maintain records of IT hardware, software, accessories, and assigned assets.
* Assist in identifying hardware requirements and replacement needs.
* Coordinate with vendors for warranty, repairs, and technical support when required.

C. Network \& Connectivity Support

* Provide basic support for LAN, Wi\-Fi, internet, and network connectivity issues.
* Troubleshoot basic IP address, DNS, DHCP, and connectivity\-related problems.
* Assist in maintaining network devices such as switches, routers, access points, and related equipment.
* Monitor and report recurring network issues.
* Coordinate with internet/network service providers for connectivity\-related problems.
* Email \& User Account Support
* Assist users with official email account configuration and troubleshooting.
* Support password resets and basic user account\-related issues as authorized.
* Assist with Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace or other organizational applications, as applicable.
* Ensure user access is provided according to approved requirements and company procedures.

ERP \& Business Application Support

* Provide basic technical support to users for the organization's ERP and other business applications.
* Assist users with login, access, system configuration, and basic application\-related issues.
* Coordinate with the IT \& ERP Coordinator / ERP vendor for unresolved issues.
* Record and follow up on ERP\-related support tickets and issues.
* Assist in user training and basic guidance on IT applications whenever required.

IT Asset Management

* Maintain an updated IT asset register covering computers, laptops, printers, networking equipment, accessories, and other IT assets.
* Record issue, allocation, transfer, repair, replacement, and return of IT assets.
* Ensure IT equipment is properly tagged and assigned to employees.
* Conduct periodic physical verification of IT assets.
* Report damaged, missing, or malfunctioning equipment to the concerned authority.

IT Security \& Data Protection

* Follow company IT security policies and procedures.
* Assist in maintaining antivirus/endpoint security and system updates.
* Ensure systems are protected with appropriate passwords and security controls.
* Report suspected malware, phishing, unauthorized access, or other security incidents immediately.
* Ensure company data and user information are handled confidentially.
* Assist in implementing backup and data protection procedures as directed by the IT team.

Support for Project Sites

* Provide IT support to project/site offices when required.
* Assist with installation and maintenance of computers, printers, internet connectivity, Wi\-Fi, CCTV/network\-related equipment, and other IT infrastructure at project locations.
* Coordinate with site personnel and external vendors for resolving technical issues.
* Travel to project sites as required for IT support and maintenance.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain records of IT complaints, service requests, and resolutions.
* Maintain documentation related to IT assets, software, licenses, network equipment, and user access.
* Prepare periodic IT support reports as required.
* Maintain a record of recurring technical issues and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Ensure proper documentation of IT procedures and troubleshooting activities.

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, or a related discipline.

Pay: ₹180,000\.00 \- ₹225,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee (NOC)
description:
**We’re hiring at Pitney Bowes, where top talent builds meaningful careers and lasting impact. We Move fast, Deliver excellence, and Win together…that’s The Pitney Bowes way. Here, how we work matters just as much as what we achieve.**

We’re looking for people who:


* Act with urgency, accountability, and purpose
* Deliver high quality work with consistency and pride
* Collaborate effectively and elevate those around them
* Focus on outcomes that drive impact and growth

**Job Description:**

**Join Pitney Bowes as a Graduate Engineer Trainee**

**Location:** **Pune (Hybrid)**

**Role: Contractual(Third\-party)**

**Years of experience: 0\-2 years**

**About the Role**

We are seeking enthusiastic and self\-driven engineers with strong fundamentals, curiosity and automation mindset in Network Operations, Automation, DevOps, and Infrastructure Monitoring.


This role is focused on building a modern, automation\-first Network Operations Center (NOC) rather than a traditional helpdesk environment.


The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, networking fundamentals, and an interest in scripting, observability, and automation technologies.


**1\. Responsibilities**

**DevOps (Modern NOC \- Automation \& Continuous Improvement)**

* Assist in automation of monitoring and operational workflows through basic scripting.
* Support infrastructure and network change monitoring as part of CI/CD pipelines.
* Work with monitoring and observability tools (e.g. Grafana)
* Contribute to infrastructure improvements using automation/orchestration principles.
* Develop basic scripts (Python / PowerShell) to reduce manual effort.
* Work with APIs and structured data formats (JSON)
* Support automation initiatives and process optimisation efforts.
* Build foundational understanding of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD practices.

**Network Operations \- Incident Management \& Coordination**

* Monitor network, systems, and infrastructure (LAN/WAN, Wireless, VPN, firewalls, cloud) in a 24x7 environment using standard NOC tools.
* Detect, triage, and respond to alerts, incidents, and outages with defined SLAs.
* Perform first\-level troubleshooting across network and system components (routers, switches, wireless, firewalls, circuits)
* Log, track, and manage incidents via ticketing tools (JIRA, ServiceNow etc.)
* Follow established SOPs for troubleshooting and escalation to L2/L3 teams.
* Collaborate with internal teams (Network, Security, Application, Cloud) and external vendors/ISPs for issue resolution.
* Perform routine operational tasks such as configuration backups, patching, upgrades, and health checks.
* Support network changes, validation, and implementation activities.

**Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate incident records, RCA documentation, and network artefacts.
* Generate periodic reports on uptime, alerts, and performance trends.
* Update SOPs, runbooks, and internal knowledge base consistently.

**2\. Key Skills \& Background**

**DevOps / Automation (Must\-Have)**

* Scripting skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
* Awareness of automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, GitHub) and CI/CD concepts.
* Understanding of cloud fundamentals (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Basic working knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems
* Awareness of REST API, Webhook, CSV, Jason etc.

**Networking Fundamentals (Must\-Have)**

* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Routing \& Switching
* Basic understanding of firewall and network security concepts
* Familiarity with WAN, VPN, and Internet connectivity
* Exposure to enterprise network devices (routers, switches, firewalls)
* Experience or exposure to monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, ManageEngine, etc.)

**Troubleshooting \& Analytical Skills**

* Ability to perform initial fault isolation and structured troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving capability and willingness to learn.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills
* Ability to work in a 24x7 shift\-based NOC environment.
* Good documentation discipline and attention to detail.
* Ability to perform under pressure during incidents and outages.

**3\. Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science / IT / Electronics or equivalent
* 0–2 years of experience (freshers with relevant certifications can be considered)

**Preferred Certifications (Not mandatory)**

* CCNA / Network\+
* DevNet Associate
* ITIL Foundation
* Entry\-level Cloud or DevOps certifications (optional)

**The Team**

**Pitney Bowes** (NYSE: PBI) is a global shipping and mailing company that provides technology, logistics, and financial services to more than 90 percent of the Fortune 500\. Small business, retail, enterprise, and government clients around the world rely on Pitney Bowes to remove the complexity of sending mail and parcels. For additional information visit Pitney Bowes at www.pitneybowes.com .


**We will:**

  

* Provide the will: opportunity to grow and develop your career
* Offer an inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
* Deliver challenging and unique opportunities to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
* Offer comprehensive benefits globally **(** **PB Benefits and Wellbeing Programs** )

Pitney Bowes is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusiveness in the workplace.
  

  

All interested individuals must apply online.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
At Prodigal, we are building AI Agents for loan servicing and collections. Founded in 2018 by IITB alumni, our journey began when our founders Shantanu and Sangram faced the antiquated the $13B\+ lending/collections industry was mostly using pen and paper and decided to build the first real intelligence layer for debt recovery.
   

  

 Today, we stand at the forefront of a seismic shift in the industry, building Agentic AI applications for loan servicing and collections. Powered by our cutting\-edge platform, Prodigal’s Intelligence Engine (PIE), we’re creating the next\-generation agentic workforce \- one that empowers companies to achieve unprecedented levels of operational excellence and intelligence.
   

  

 With over 100\+ enterprise customers across North America and backing from Y Combinator, Accel and Menlo Ventures, we are the fastest growing AI company in consumer finance.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join the PIE team and work on the systems that power our autonomous AI agents in live financial conversations. You'll work alongside a small, high\-agency team where you will have real ownership over features and components from day one.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role. You'll be deep in the code \- building ML models, designing the ML system, finetuning and integrating LLMs, tuning prompts, and debugging gnarly real\-time issues. You don't need to have done all of this before, but you need to be the kind of engineer who figures things out fast, takes feedback well, and ships.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work across a range of ML problems \- Voice, Data, Recommendations, Infrastructure, LLMs, Product.
* Train LLMs for AI agents used for consumer finance.
* Develop evals, harnesses, and monitoring systems.
* Own major technical areas with significant autonomy, from problem definition to production deployment


**What You Bring**
* 2 – 5 years of hands\-on engineering experience, with good exposure to building or working with ML or AI systems in production.
* Solid Python fundamentals \- you are comfortable writing clean, maintainable code and debugging production issues.
* Some experience working with LLMs: prompt engineering, API integrations, or building simple pipelines or agents.
* High bias for action \- you don't wait to be told exactly what to do, and you push yourself to ship rather than over\-engineer.
* Eager to learn in a fast\-moving environment, take ownership of your work, and ask good questions.


**Why This Role**
* Real ownership from day one: ML team is a small pod. You won't be a cog \- you'll own components, ship features, and see your work in live consumer conversations within weeks.
* Frontier work: AI that reasons, decides, and acts is one of the hardest problems in applied AI. You'll be learning by doing on problems most engineers never touch.
* Strong mentorship: you'll work directly with senior engineers and the ML Lead who will invest in your growth \- this is a place to level up fast.
* High leverage early career: the decisions you make and the code you write will impact millions of financial conversations. Rare for an early\-career role.


 From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast\-paced, intellectually\-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US.
   

  

 To learn more about us \- please visit the following:
   

  

 Our Story \- https://www.prodigaltech.com/our\-story
   

  

 What shapes our thinking \- https://link.prodigaltech.com/our\-thesis
   

  

 Our website \- https://www.prodigaltech.com/

* Conduct exploratory and variance analysis to flag anomalies, policy violations, or process gaps for resolution by the relevant function (Data Management Lead, Governance Lead, SBU teams, or plant operations).
* Support ad\-hoc analytical requests from SBU heads, plant leadership, and senior management with quick\-turnaround data pulls and visualisations.



**Data Integration \& ETL** 



* Build and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, cleanse, and load data from CRM, ERP, marketing automation, and factory operations systems into reporting tools.
* Maintain unique key mapping and data integration logic across systems to eliminate data silos and ensure a single source of truth for stakeholder data.
* Coordinate with the Data Management Lead on data quality rules, validity standards, and master data structure to ensure reporting reflects the governed data model.



**Stakeholder Support \& Coordination** 



* Gather reporting requirements from SBU heads, departmental teams, and leadership; translate business questions into dashboard and KPI specifications.
* Support the Marketing Automation Lead with campaign performance reporting and ROI analysis across WhatsApp, email, and SMS channels.
* Document dashboard logic, data definitions, and reporting SOPs to ensure consistency and ease of handover.
* Train SBU users on self\-service dashboard usage where applicable.



**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; preference for Engineering, Statistics, Commerce, or Computer Applications

* Power BI / Power BI Developer

**Required Skills** 




 Strong proficiency in:

* Google Looker Studio and/or other BI/analytics platforms
* Working knowledge of Python (Pandas, NumPy) for data analysis and automation
* Experience integrating and reporting on ERP/CRM and factory/production data (SAP SD/MM or equivalent)
* Strong understanding of KPI design, MIS reporting, and data storytelling for senior leadership audiences
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across SBUs and translate business requirements into reporting solutions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with attention to data accuracy and detail
* Process orientation: ability to document SOPs and maintain reporting consistency at scale



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Dashboard Coverage \& Adoption: Core KPI dashboards live and actively used by SBU heads and plant leadership; usage/adoption tracked monthly.
* Reporting Turnaround: Standard reports delivered on defined refresh cycles; ad\-hoc analytical requests turned around within agreed SLA.
* Data Quality \& Accuracy: Data health score maintained above target threshold across CRM, ERP, and factory datasets; duplicate/erroneous records identified and flagged for correction.
* Operational Insights Delivered: Number and impact of actionable insights surfaced (e.g. inventory optimisation, cost savings, process inefficiencies identified) and adopted by business/plant teams.

title: Junior Malware Analyst — Adware & Extension Research (QA)
description:
About BrandLock

BrandLock is a revenue\-protection platform for e\-commerce merchants. We stop unwanted browser extensions and injected scripts — ads, coupon overlays, competitor price comparisons — from hijacking our clients’ online stores and leaking their revenue.

The Role

You will identify and classify the adware, malware and unwanted extensions that inject content into our clients’ websites, and help work out how to block them. This is a research and reasoning role: investigating unfamiliar domains, inspecting pages in DevTools, testing extension behaviour in the browser, and then working with QA to make sure what you found is genuinely blocked in production.

Ideal for freshers who are curious, analytical and want to build a career across security research, web technology and product quality.

What You’ll Do

* Analyse and categorise adware, malware and unwanted extensions by behaviour, type and risk level
* Classify resources collected from client sites at the domain and subdomain level — legitimate, unwanted, malicious or unknown
* Research unfamiliar domains in depth: who runs them, how they make money, and whether they belong on a client’s site
* Propose ways to block injected content — HTML/CSS selectors, DOM mutation detection, domain\-level blocking, or new approaches you research yourself
* Investigate extensions that stop being blocked or start evading detection, and find the root cause
* Perform QA testing on our blocking product and work with the QA team to validate every rule before release
* **Produce manual reports and visual evidence for clients and the Sales team** — visiting client and prospect websites, reproducing injections, capturing and annotating screenshots, and compiling the findings into shareable reports and trackers
* Write scripts and SQL queries to automate parts of the classification workflow, and document findings clearly

What You’ll Need

* 0–2 years of experience — **freshers are encouraged to apply**. Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
* Strong analytical and logical reasoning — you can reach a defensible conclusion from partial evidence and explain how you got there
* A genuine research instinct and real attention to detail
* Fundamental knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Basic Python or equivalent scripting, and familiarity with SQL / databases
* Understanding of QA and testing fundamentals
* Comfort with browser developer tools
* Clear written and verbal communication — your findings go to Engineering, QA and Sales

Nice to Have

* Exposure to browser extensions, DOM APIs such as MutationObserver, or browser automation (Selenium / Playwright)
* Basic understanding of malware and adware categorisation
* Awareness of digital advertising, affiliate marketing or the coupon ecosystem
* Any internship or project work in web research, QA, data annotation or security

Please Note

This is **not** an antivirus or reverse\-engineering role. You will not be analysing binaries, writing YARA rules or publishing threat intelligence. You will be classifying browser extensions, scripts and domains, and researching new ways to block them.

 To be successful as a Devops Engineer, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Proven track record as a DevOps Engineer supporting large\-scale, enterprise\-grade applications.

* Advanced scripting capabilities across PowerShell/Bash/Python/Ruby/Java/.NET.

* Working knowledge of code quality and security platforms including SonarQube and Veracode.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Cross\-platform experience with both Windows and Red Hat Enterprise Linux environments.
* Familiarity with Atlassian collaboration tools (Confluence, JIRA, Bitbucket, ServiceNow)
* Strong incident and problem management capabilities with focus on rapid issue resolution and uptime optimization.
* Experience analyzing application performance metrics using ELK Stack and AppDynamics

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high\-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber\-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.

title: AI-Augmented Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**If it's down, it's on you. If it stays up, that's on you too.**
 This isn't a ticket\-queue DevOps gig where you spin up infra and wait for the next request. At Techdome, you own production — for real Healthcare, FinTech, AI, and SaaS products, with real users depending on uptime that isn't negotiable.
   

  

 You'll build the pipelines, own the incidents, ship the zero\-downtime releases, and be the person the team trusts when something breaks at 2am. If automation, Kubernetes, observability, and AI\-powered ops genuinely excite you — not just as buzzwords on a resume — keep reading.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Do**
* Keep production up, fast, and stable — availability, reliability, scalability, and performance across every environment you touch.
* Run the cloud like it's yours — manage and optimize environments across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Build deployment pipelines that don't break things — CI/CD engineered for zero\-downtime, with Blue\-Green, Rolling, and Canary strategies as your default toolkit, not a slide in a deck.
* Codify the infrastructure — Terraform and Ansible, so nothing important lives only in someone's head.
* See problems before they become incidents — observability with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, and centralized logging.
* Own the numbers that matter — define and maintain SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, not just watch dashboards.
* Lead when things go wrong — incident management, RCA, and post\-incident reviews that actually prevent the repeat.
* Watch the bill, not just the uptime — cloud cost optimization and capacity planning.
* Automate the boring and the risky — scripting and AI\-powered tooling for alert triage, incident summarization, and operational workflows.
* Carry the pager — join the on\-call rotation, because ownership doesn't stop at 6pm.


**What You Bring**
* 3\+ years as an SRE, DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, or Cloud Engineer.
* Real hands\-on cloud experience — AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Docker and Kubernetes fluency — not "I've used it once," but production experience under real load.
* Infrastructure\-as\-Code expertise — Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent.
* CI/CD pipelines built from scratch — Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar.
* Solid Linux, networking, and distributed\-systems fundamentals — the stuff that doesn't show up in a tutorial.
* Scripting chops — Python, Go, or Bash.
* Experience running large\-scale production environments where "it's fine" isn't good enough.
* Working knowledge of Blue\-Green, Canary, and Rolling deployments — in practice, not just in theory.
* Time in FinTech, Payments, Healthcare, or another high\-availability environment where downtime has real consequences.
* A working AI toolkit — Copilot, Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar — used to actually move faster, not just talk about it.


**Extra credit**
* You've built AI\-powered operational workflows — monitoring, alert triage, incident summarization, automation — not just used AI to write scripts faster.
* You speak fluent SRE: SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, chaos engineering, and reliability engineering are habits you practice, not terms you've heard.


**Why Techdome?**
* No narrow lane — work across real\-world AI, Healthcare, Payments, and SaaS products, not one domain for years on end.
* Ownership from day one — critical production infrastructure is yours, not something you inherit after two years of proving yourself.
* Scale that matters — systems supporting thousands of users and business\-critical workflows, not internal tools nobody depends on.
* Direct access to the top — work with founders and senior engineering leadership, no six layers of management between your idea and a decision.
* An AI\-first culture that's actually real — modern tooling and real automation, not a mandate to "use AI more" with no support behind it.
* Speed and real ownership — fast decisions, real stakes, and growth that isn't stuck waiting for a title change.

title: Infra Tech Support Practitioner
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Infra Tech Support Practitioner
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Provide L1–L2 technical support for infrastructure, systems, and applications in production and development environments, both remotely and onsite, following defined operating models and processes. Act as the primary interface with users/clients to accurately diagnose issues and deliver effective resolutions across infrastructure, operating systems, networks, and application platforms, ensuring service stability and quality support.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Site Reliability Engineering
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As an Infra Tech Support Practitioner, a typical day involves delivering first and second level technical assistance for infrastructure, systems, and applications across both production and development settings. This role requires working closely with users and clients to identify and resolve issues efficiently, whether remotely or onsite. The practitioner follows established operational procedures to maintain service reliability and quality, ensuring smooth functioning of various technology platforms. Collaboration with different teams and adherence to defined processes are key aspects of the daily routine, aimed at sustaining optimal infrastructure performance and user satisfaction.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Infrastructure as Code \& Automation


 Automate Everything: Eliminate manual interventions by designing and implementing end\-to\-end infrastructure automation using tools like Terraform or Ansible.
   

  

 CI/CD Pipeline Management: Build, optimize, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless, automated software delivery and infrastructure deployments.
   

  

 Configuration Management: Define and manage system configurations via code to maintain consistency across Development, Staging, and Production environments.
   

  

* Reliability, Scalability \& Performance


 Architecture Design: Partner with development teams to architect scalable, fault\-tolerant, and high\-performance cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 Capacity Planning: Proactively monitor system resource utilization and plan capacity upgrades to handle traffic spikes and growth.
   

  

 Chaos Engineering: Introduce controlled failures into systems to test resilience and proactively identify architectural weaknesses.
   

  

* Monitoring, Observability \& Incident Response


 Observability Stack: Design and implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (e.g., Newrelic ) to establish deep system visibility.
   

  

 On\-Call \& Incident Management: Participate in an on\-call rotation. Lead the triage and resolution of critical production incidents.
   

  

 Blameless Post\-Mortems: Conduct thorough root\-cause analysis (RCA) for infrastructure failures and formulate actionable plans to prevent recurrence.
   

  

 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Site Reliability Engineering.
* Strong knowledge of infrastructure components including servers, storage, and network devices.
* Experience in troubleshooting operating systems and application platforms in complex environments.
* Ability to work with monitoring tools and incident management systems to ensure prompt issue resolution.
* Familiarity with automation and scripting to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual interventions.
* Understanding of service management frameworks and best practices to support IT operations.


**Category Required Skills \& Tools**
 Cloud Platforms:\- Advanced expertise in AWS (Cloud networking, IAM, security, compute, and storage services).
   

  

 Containers \& Orchestration:\- Deep operational knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, or AKS), including Helm charts and service meshes.
   

  

 Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Strong proficiency in Terraform or CloudFormation.
   

  

 Programming \& Scripting:\- Proficiency in Python, or Bash for building internal tooling and automation scripts.
   

  

 CI/CD Tools Hands\-on experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins.
   

  

 Observability Experience configuring in New Relic.
   

  

 OS \& Networking Strong Linux administration skills and a solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancing, and HTTP/S.
   

  

 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cybersecurity Engineer based in India.**
 This is a hands\-on cybersecurity role focused on strengthening product and enterprise security across a modern technology environment.
   

  

 You will combine penetration testing, threat modeling, secure architecture reviews, and security automation to identify and reduce risk.
   

  

 The role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, and Operations teams throughout the SDLC.
   

  

 You will help embed security\-by\-design principles and DevSecOps practices into development and deployment workflows.
   

  

 Your work will span web applications, APIs, cloud environments, infrastructure, containers, and modern distributed architectures.
   

  

 The position offers significant opportunity to influence security strategy while remaining deeply involved in technical execution.
   

  

 This is an ideal opportunity for a security\-minded engineer who enjoys thinking like an attacker while enabling teams to build resilient products.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Conduct manual and automated penetration testing across web applications, APIs, cloud environments, and supporting infrastructure, validating security controls and identifying vulnerabilities.
* Lead threat modeling exercises for new and existing products, identifying attack paths, risks, and appropriate mitigations using methodologies such as STRIDE, PASTA, or equivalent frameworks.
* Perform secure design and architecture reviews and promote security\-by\-design principles throughout the Software Development Lifecycle.
* Evaluate application, cloud, and infrastructure security controls and translate findings into practical, actionable remediation recommendations.
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Architecture, and DevOps teams to prioritize, track, and remediate security findings while promoting secure coding practices.
* Integrate security testing and validation into CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated security checks and continuous risk identification.
* Develop and maintain security tooling, scripts, and automation to improve the efficiency, scalability, and coverage of security assessments.
* Support vulnerability management activities, including risk assessment, validation, remediation guidance, and verification of fixes.
* Contribute to security standards, secure development guidelines, governance processes, and product security initiatives.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineering teams on secure design, threat mitigation, and security best practices.
* Support security audits, compliance initiatives, and evidence collection related to product and application security controls.
* Monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and security technologies and apply relevant developments to improve security capabilities.
* Drive continuous improvement across Product Security and DevSecOps practices through automation, innovation, and adoption of industry\-leading approaches.
* Be available to work a European shift from 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, application security, product security, security engineering, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience with manual and automated penetration testing of web applications, APIs, cloud environments, and infrastructure.
* Strong experience in threat modeling and security architecture reviews using STRIDE, PASTA, ATT\&CK, or equivalent methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of secure software development, common attack techniques, OWASP Top 10, and API Security Top 10\.
* Experience identifying, validating, prioritizing, and communicating security risks to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Java, JavaScript, C\#, PowerShell, or Go.

* Strong understanding of DevSecOps and experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience assessing and securing cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Knowledge of modern architectures including microservices, APIs, containers, Kubernetes, and serverless technologies.
* Familiarity with SAST, DAST, SCA, container security, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code security tools.
* Experience developing security automation, custom tooling, or pipeline integrations.
* Knowledge of secure architecture patterns, identity and access management, cryptography, and zero\-trust concepts.
* Experience supporting regulatory, compliance, or audit requirements, particularly in highly regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, or financial services.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to independently lead security initiatives while working effectively across Engineering, Product, Architecture, and Operations.
* A security\-first mindset with the ability to think like an attacker while partnering constructively with development teams.
* Curiosity, self\-motivation, and a commitment to continuous learning in emerging security technologies and attack techniques.
* Experience building or operating Product Security programs, leading enterprise\-wide threat modeling initiatives, conducting adversarial assessments, or creating secure coding standards and developer enablement programs is highly valued.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted security analysis, remediation workflows, or security engineering automation is an advantage.
* Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, GWEB, CISSP, CCSP, or AWS/Azure/GCP security certifications are valued.

title: Officer – Compliance & Audit
description:

---------------------

**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a **Chartered Accountant (CA)** to join our Finance team as an **Officer – Compliance \& Audit**. The role involves managing statutory compliance, supporting internal audits, overseeing accounts payable activities, maintaining financial records, and assisting with financial reporting and analysis.


The ideal candidate should have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and a sound understanding of taxation, audit, compliance, and financial operations.

### **Compliance \& Taxation**

	+ GST

	+ Income Tax
	+ ROC Filings
	+ Other applicable statutory requirements
* Maintain accurate records and documentation for statutory compliance.
* Coordinate with external consultants and regulatory authorities as required.

### **Internal Audit \& Controls**


* Conduct and support internal audit activities across business and financial processes.
* Identify process gaps, control weaknesses, and areas of financial risk.
* Recommend and support implementation of process improvements.
* Monitor internal controls and ensure adherence to company policies and procedures.
* Assist in audit documentation, reporting, and closure of audit observations.

### **Accounts Payable \& Financial Operations**


* Manage the end\-to\-end Accounts Payable cycle.
* Review and process vendor invoices.
* Perform vendor reconciliation and resolve discrepancies.
* Support timely vendor payment processing.
* Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.

### **Financial Reporting \& Analysis**


* Assist in the preparation of financial statements and management reports.
* Support budgeting and forecasting activities.
* Assist with financial analysis and provide relevant insights to management.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial data.

### **Audit \& Stakeholder Coordination**


* Coordinate with external auditors, consultants, and other financial stakeholders.
* Provide required information and documentation during audits.
* Support regulatory and statutory audit requirements.
* Ensure timely closure of audit\-related queries and observations.

**Required Skills**
-------------------


* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA).
* Strong knowledge of statutory compliance, taxation, and audit processes.
* Understanding of GST, TDS, Income Tax, and ROC compliance.
* Knowledge of internal audit and internal control processes.
* Experience or strong understanding of Accounts Payable and financial operations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet defined deadlines.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------


* Experience with ERP and accounting systems, particularly Tally.
* Exposure to multi\-entity accounting and financial operations.
* Experience in financial reporting and analysis.
* Exposure to process improvement and internal control frameworks.

**Preferred Qualification**
---------------------------


**Chartered Accountant (CA)** – Qualified.


CA Freshers and candidates with **2–3 years of relevant experience** are encouraged to apply.


**What We Offer**
-----------------


* Opportunity to work across compliance, audit, taxation, and financial operations.
* Exposure to end\-to\-end finance and accounting processes.
* Opportunity to work with experienced finance professionals and external stakeholders.
* Exposure to multi\-functional and multi\-entity financial operations.
* Collaborative and professional work environment.
* Career growth through continuous learning and challenging assignments.

**Ready to Join Us?**
---------------------


If you are a qualified Chartered Accountant looking to build your career in compliance, audit, taxation, and financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.


**Apply today and become a part of Swan Solutions \& Services Pvt. Ltd.**

title: Digital Marketing Intern
description:
Marketing Manager – Social Media \& Content \| Financial Services

**Roha Associates LLP \| Pune \| Full\-Time \| In\-Office**

Build Your Marketing Career in the World of Wealth \& Finance

Are you an MBA in Marketing who doesn't want to spend your first few years doing repetitive corporate marketing work?

Do you enjoy **Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, content creation, video editing, research and storytelling**?

And would you like to learn how marketing actually works inside a growing **wealth management and portfolio management business**?

If yes, this opportunity could be for you.

**Roha Associates LLP** is a fast\-growing Portfolio Management \& Wealth Management firm based in Pune. We work with investors and high\-net\-worth individuals to help them build and grow their wealth through research\-driven and performance\-oriented investment strategies.

We are looking for an ambitious **Marketing Manager – Social Media \& Content** who can help us build a powerful digital presence and take our content and social media growth to the next level.

This Is Not a Typical Marketing Job

This is a **hands\-on, ownership\-driven role**.

You won't just be preparing reports or coordinating with agencies.

You will actually be involved in:

**Research → Ideas → Scripts → Content → Video Editing → Publishing → Analytics → Growth**

You will have the opportunity to work across **Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube** and directly contribute to the growth of a financial\-services brand.

What You Will Do

**Social Media Management**

* Manage and grow Roha Associates LLP's Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube channels.
* Develop and maintain a consistent social media content calendar.
* Plan and execute campaigns to increase reach, engagement and followers.
* Monitor social media trends, algorithms and emerging content formats.
* Track content performance and identify what is working and what needs improvement.

**Content Creation**

* Research topics around stock markets, investing, personal finance, wealth creation and financial markets.
* Identify trending topics and convert them into relevant content opportunities.
* Develop content ideas for Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn posts and other formats.
* Write video scripts, hooks, captions and social media posts.
* Convert complex financial topics into simple, interesting and engaging content.
* Research competitors, financial creators and successful brands for content inspiration.

**Video \& Creative**

* Edit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other short\-form videos.
* Work with tools such as Canva, CapCut, VN, Premiere Pro or similar platforms.
* Select appropriate visuals, music, captions, graphics and transitions.
* Help improve the quality and consistency of the company's visual content.
* Coordinate the complete process from raw idea/video to final published content.

**Growth \& Marketing**

* Experiment with different content formats, hooks and distribution strategies.
* Analyze reach, engagement, watch time, followers and other relevant metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve organic social\-media growth.
* Support digital marketing, lead\-generation and brand\-building initiatives.
* Continuously test, learn and improve the company's content strategy.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **hungry to learn, willing to take ownership and genuinely interested in marketing.**

You could be a great fit if you:

* Have completed or are completing an **MBA / PGDM in Marketing**.
* Are a fresher or have 0–2 years of relevant experience.
* Regularly consume content on Instagram, LinkedIn or YouTube and understand what makes content engaging.
* Enjoy writing, researching, creating and experimenting.
* Have an interest in business, investing, entrepreneurship or financial markets.
* Have basic knowledge of the **stock market, mutual funds or financial services**.
* Can communicate clearly in English.
* Are comfortable learning new tools and technologies.
* Have a creative mindset but are also comfortable working with numbers and analytics.
* Take initiative instead of waiting for instructions.
* Want responsibility and the opportunity to make a visible impact.

Advantage if You Have

Candidates with any of the following will have an additional advantage:

* Social media management experience
* Content creation experience
* Instagram/Reels/YouTube experience
* Video editing skills
* Canva / CapCut / Premiere Pro knowledge
* Copywriting or script\-writing experience
* Personal social\-media page or content portfolio
* Internship in digital marketing
* Basic understanding of stock markets and investing
* Experience creating finance, business or educational content

**Freshers with strong skills, a good portfolio and the right attitude are absolutely welcome.**

What You Will Learn

This role gives you an opportunity to develop skills across multiple areas:

**Digital Marketing \+ Social Media \+ Content Strategy \+ Video Marketing \+ Personal Branding \+ Financial Services \+ Stock Market \+ Lead Generation \+ Analytics**

You will not be restricted to one small part of marketing.

If you perform well, your responsibility and scope will grow with the company.

Compensation

**Expected CTC: ₹4\.0 – ₹7\.0 LPA**

The final package will depend on your **skills, MBA profile, relevant experience, content portfolio and interview performance**.

For exceptional candidates with strong content, social\-media or digital\-marketing skills, compensation can be discussed based on capability.

**Performance\-based increments and growth opportunities** will be available based on contribution and results.

Job Details

**Position:** Marketing Manager – Social Media \& Content  
**Industry:** Wealth Management / Financial Services  
**Company:** Roha Associates LLP  
**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Work Mode:** Full\-Time \| In\-Office  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Qualification:** MBA / PGDM – Marketing preferred  
**Freshers:** Yes, encouraged to apply

Women Candidates Encouraged to Apply

We are committed to building a diverse and high\-performing team.

**Women candidates are especially encouraged to apply.**

Why Join Roha Associates LLP?

If you are looking for a job where you simply execute instructions, this may not be the right role.

If you want to **learn, experiment, create, take ownership and see the direct impact of your work**, this could be a great opportunity.

You will get exposure to:

* A growing financial\-services business
* Real\-world digital marketing
* Content strategy and social\-media growth
* Financial markets and investing
* High\-value client marketing
* Brand building
* Lead generation
* Video content
* Performance analytics

**Your work will be seen. Your ideas will be heard. And your growth will depend on the value you create.**

How to Apply

Please apply with your **updated CV/resume**.

Candidates who have created content, managed social\-media pages, edited videos or completed relevant marketing projects are encouraged to **share their portfolio, LinkedIn profile, Instagram page, YouTube channel or examples of their work along with their application.**

**Freshers:** If you don't have professional experience, don't worry. Show us what you can do.

A college project, internship project, personal Instagram page, YouTube channel, content portfolio or sample Reel can be enough to demonstrate your ability.

Screening Questions

Candidates applying through LinkedIn/Indeed can be asked the following questions:

**1\. Have you completed an MBA/PGDM in Marketing?**

* Yes
* Currently pursuing
* No

**2\. Are you comfortable working full\-time from our Pune office?**

* Yes
* No

**6\. Share one social\-media account/creator/brand whose content you think is excellent. Why do you think it works?**

**7\. If Roha Associates asked you to create a Reel on “3 mistakes investors make”, what would your opening hook be?**

**8\. Have you created any content yourself?**  
If yes, please share links to your work.

**9\. Why are you interested in working in marketing for a financial\-services/wealth\-management company?**

**10\. What would you do in your first 30 days if you were given responsibility for growing our Instagram and LinkedIn presence?**

What We Will Look For

We are not only looking at marks or previous experience.

We will primarily evaluate:

**Creativity \| Communication \| Curiosity \| Content Sense \| Digital Skills \| Financial Awareness \| Initiative \| Learning Ability \| Ownership**

If you are an MBA fresher with **high energy, strong communication skills and a genuine interest in digital marketing**, we want to hear from you.
