title: Support Technician L1
description:
**About our Client:** 




 Our client has been developing point of sale (POS) software and payment solutions since 2006 and is an Australian market leader in delivery of end\-to\-end software, hardware, payment and integration solutions for the Hospitality industry. Their services include all hospitality venue types including high\-end restaurants, wineries, bars, pubs, hotels and bottle shops. Our client remains a fast and nimble business that moves quickly to provide innovative solutions, including their own payments platform designed to enhance the customer experience at every touchpoint. They now provide a one\-stop\-shop POS and Payments solution allowing us to eradicate outdated monthly fees.
   





**About Teamified** 




 Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast\-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost\-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers, designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day
   





**About the Role:** 




 We are looking for a customer\-focused 
 **Level 1 Support Technician** 
  to provide high\-quality remote, telephone, email, and chat support to clients using business\-critical Point of Sale (POS) systems.
 



 As a Level 1 Support Technician, you will be one of the first points of contact for customers experiencing technical issues. You will be responsible for understanding the problem, troubleshooting according to established processes, resolving issues within your technical capability, and ensuring more complex cases are appropriately documented and escalated.
 



 This role combines technical troubleshooting with excellent customer service. You will work closely with Level 2 Support, Systems Administration, Account Management, Customer Success, installation and training teams, and after\-hours support teams to ensure customers receive timely and effective assistance.
 



 A key measure of success will be your ability to resolve customer issues efficiently, increase first\-contact resolution, reduce repeat calls, and maintain clear communication with customers throughout the support process.
 



 The role operates 
 **5 days per week on a rotating roster, including weekends** 
 , with normal working hours of 
 **11:00 AM\-7:00 PM AEST** 
 . There may also be a requirement to provide 
 **after\-hours coverage** 
 , including 12\-hour shifts with appropriate breaks, when required to support team leave coverage.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Act as the first point of contact for customers across phone, SMS, email, chat, and other support channels.
* Respond to incoming POS software, hardware, system, and connectivity issues and troubleshoot them according to established support guidelines and internal processes.
* Diagnose and resolve Level 1 technical issues within your capability and escalate more complex incidents to the appropriate technical team.
* Ensure all customer calls, incidents, and support requests are accurately logged, prioritised, updated, and escalated when necessary.
* Work within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and ensure customers receive timely updates throughout the resolution process.
* Deliver a high standard of customer service and maintain clear, professional, and empathetic communication in every interaction.
* Aim to maximise first\-contact resolution and reduce repeat customer calls and tickets.
* Provide customers with basic system and product training over the phone or through remote support channels when required.
* Create sales orders for additional software or hardware requirements identified through customer interactions.
* Escalate customer complaints and significant service concerns to the Level 1 Team Leader or appropriate manager.
* Collaborate effectively with Level 2 Support, Systems Administration, Customer Success, Account Management, installation and training teams, and after\-hours support teams.
* Maintain accurate documentation of troubleshooting activities, customer communications, resolutions, and escalations.
* Participate in training, coaching, knowledge\-sharing, and professional development opportunities.
* Continuously develop technical knowledge across POS software, hardware, networking, and related technologies.
* Identify opportunities to improve support processes, customer experience, and team efficiency.
* Follow company security, workplace health and safety, operational, and customer service policies and procedures.
* Demonstrate the company's values through teamwork, accountability, customer focus, continuous improvement, open communication, and pride in the quality of your work.



**Qualifications:** 



* Previous experience in a 
 **Level 1 Help Desk, Service Desk, Technical Support, Application Support, POS Support** 
 , or similar customer\-facing technical support role.
* Demonstrated Level 1 technical troubleshooting knowledge and the ability to diagnose common software, hardware, system, and connectivity issues.
* Experience supporting 
 **Point of Sale (POS) systems** 
  or hospitality/retail technology is highly desirable.
* Intermediate computer skills with a good understanding of software and hardware; basic networking knowledge would be an advantage.
* Strong customer service skills with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to non\-technical customers.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tickets, systems, and customer interactions while meeting competing deadlines and service\-level requirements.
* Ability to accurately document technical issues, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and escalations.
* Strong initiative, self\-motivation, and the ability to work effectively with limited supervision.
* Proven ability to build and maintain positive working relationships with customers and internal teams.
* Comfortable working within structured processes while using sound judgement to identify when an issue requires escalation.
* Willingness and ability to work 
 **11:00 AM\-7:00 PM AEST on a rotating 5\-day roster, including weekends** 
 .
* Flexibility to provide 
 **after\-hours coverage when required** 
 , including extended shifts to cover team member leave.
* Commitment to continuous learning and developing technical knowledge as products, systems, and support processes evolve.
* Diploma or Degree in 
 **Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems** 
 , or a related discipline is advantageous but not essential.



**Benefits:** 



* Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
* Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
* A collaborative, no\-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
* A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
* Health insurance
* Leave Benefits
* Provident  Fund
* Gratuity



 If you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Apply now!

**The Role:**

* Ensure all contracted levels of performance are achieved and SLA’s as agreed are met.

**Role Responsibilities:**
* Troubleshoot complex customer network issues (LAN \& WAN) and provide corrective actions to restore the customer services.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex WAN issues in coordination with carriers \& suppliers.
* Act as technical escalation point of contact for Level 1 Engineers and all other internal and external issues in regard to Brennan Voice and Data service.
* Responsible for improving performance for the customer network, devices and services.
* Responsible for cross functional coordination to resolve internal and customer related issues.
* Maintain internal and customer communication during the ticket resolution.
* Escalate issues to next level as per define procedures.
* Responsible for documentation of customer network and updating internal knowledge database.
* Execute project tasks, including but not limited to gathering customer technical requirement, configuring router, switches, firewalls and other associated network devices if any.

* Assist is creation of Root Cause analysis (RCA).

* Good knowledge on network security (Cisco ASA, Juniper Netscreen, Sophos, Fortinet) and wireless technology (Cisco Meraki) etc.
* Good knowledge on network monitoring tools like Nagios, Cacti, Manage Engine, etc.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Electronics or Telecommunications)
* CCIE (Written) or equivalent in Routing \& Switching or Security.
* CCNA Must be Valid and also CCNP in Routing \& Switching (Atleast 1 Paper Must be completed)

title: Software Development Engineer - Mobile & Commerce (Apprentice)
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Development Engineer \- Mobile \& Commerce (Apprentice) based in India.**
 This is a 12\-month remote apprenticeship designed for an emerging software engineer who wants hands\-on experience building production\-grade systems.
   

  

 You will work alongside experienced engineers on real engineering charters that contribute directly to a large\-scale commerce and business platform.
   

  

 Depending on your team, you may work across domain services, accounting and ledger systems, payment infrastructure, document rendering, or developer tooling.
   

  

 The role offers meaningful ownership from early in the programme, including designing, implementing, testing, instrumenting, and shipping production code.
   

  

 You will develop practical expertise in distributed systems, APIs, containers, Kubernetes, reliability, and software design practices.
   

  

 Mentorship, technical reviews, design discussions, and structured progression will support your development throughout the apprenticeship.
   

  

 The programme also provides an opportunity to demonstrate your capabilities for potential full\-time conversion after successful completion.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Join an engineering team with a defined charter and contribute to production\-facing software development initiatives.
* Design and implement domain services using technologies such as Go, protobuf, and ConnectRPC, taking services from architectural decisions through production deployment.
* Contribute to ledger and accounting systems, including commerce\-event processing, double\-entry accounting, chart\-of\-accounts translation, and journal APIs.
* Work on payment infrastructure, including provider integrations, capability registries, idempotency, retries, and replay mechanisms designed to prevent duplicate transactions.
* Contribute to document\-rendering systems and cross\-runtime conformance testing across Go, JavaScript, and Dart implementations.
* Work on developer tooling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) initiatives, including protobuf\-based code generation, manifest generation, and governance mechanisms for safe AI\-agent API access.
* Write architectural decision records (ADRs), design documentation, technical proposals, and clear engineering notes.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and design reviews while incorporating feedback and communicating engineering trade\-offs.
* Develop, test, instrument, and ship production\-quality software with increasing levels of ownership.
* Build practical knowledge of distributed systems concepts, including consistency, retries, idempotency, fault handling, and network reliability.
* Work with containers and Kubernetes and troubleshoot deployment and runtime issues.
* Take ownership of the operational context of the systems you contribute to, including supporting production services when required.
* Progress through a structured programme that moves from an initial scoped project toward ownership of a substantial engineering charter.
* Participate in hardening, migration, documentation, and handoff activities as projects mature.


**Requirements**
* Completed a term in a recognized open\-source mentorship or contribution programme, with evidence of merged and reviewed contributions to a real software project.
* Strong working proficiency in Go, or demonstrated depth in another systems programming language combined with evidence of the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Understanding of distributed\-systems fundamentals, including idempotency, retries, consistency models, failure scenarios, and unreliable networks.
* Familiarity with containers and Kubernetes, including hands\-on experience diagnosing common deployment or pod\-startup issues.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear technical documentation, including design documents, issue discussions, commit messages, and architectural proposals.
* A track record of sustained contribution to a single technical project over multiple months is highly valued.
* Experience participating in public code reviews or technical discussions where you can demonstrate thoughtful reasoning, collaboration, and openness to changing your approach.
* Projects or experience involving financial systems, correctness invariants, transactional workflows, or multi\-tenant isolation are particularly valuable.
* Conference presentations, technical blog posts, upstream proposals, specifications, or other examples of technical communication are a plus.
* Strong curiosity about the business and customer problems behind engineering requirements.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with experienced engineers and communicate technical decisions clearly.
* Graduation timeline must allow for full\-time conversion at the end of the apprenticeship term.
* Ability to work remotely from India throughout the programme.
* Programme start date: September 2026\.


**Benefits**
* 12\-month full\-time apprenticeship within an engineering organization.
* ₹50,000 monthly stipend.
* Fully remote opportunity in India.
* Hands\-on experience working on real production systems and engineering initiatives.
* Structured technical learning, mentorship, and guidance from experienced software engineers.
* Opportunity to work across distributed systems, payments, commerce, developer tooling, APIs, and cloud\-native infrastructure.
* Progressive ownership, moving from a scoped starter project to a substantial engineering charter.
* Exposure to architecture reviews, ADRs, code reviews, production releases, hardening, and system operations.
* Opportunity to present technical designs and defend engineering trade\-offs.
* Potential for full\-time conversion following successful completion of the apprenticeship.
* Opportunity to contribute to systems operating at significant scale in a global, remote\-first engineering environment.

**Pay:** ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

**Location:** Thane, India (On\-site)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**About the Role:**

SYINRO is developing next\-generation service robots for the hospitality and industrial sectors. We are designing futuristic, consumer\-friendly robotic enclosures using high\-grade ABS plastics.

We are looking for an enthusiastic Junior Mechanical/Product Designer who wants to break into the robotics industry. If you have strong 3D CAD skills and want to learn how to design complex plastic enclosures for mass production, we will train you. You will work directly on designing the outer shells of our robots, taking them from software concepts to physical 3D\-printed prototypes, and eventually to injection molding.

**What You Will Do (with training and guidance):**

* **3D CAD Modeling:** Create visually appealing, modern 3D models of robot enclosures using SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or Creo.

* **Hardware Packaging:** Learn how to design internal space and mounting points for electronics, screens, Lidar, and ultrasonic sensors so they fit perfectly inside the plastic shell.
* **Learn Plastic Engineering (DFM):** We will train you on the fundamentals of Design for Manufacturing—teaching you how to add draft angles, maintain uniform wall thickness, and design snap\-fits for ABS injection molding.
* **Renderings:** Create realistic product renders (using KeyShot, Blender, or CAD built\-in tools) for design approvals.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Plastics Engineering, or Product Design. (Freshers are welcome!).
* **Software Skills:** Strong foundation in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or Creo. (Knowledge of surface modeling is a huge plus).
* **Passion for Design:** A strong interest in consumer electronics, automotive design, or robotics.
* **Portfolio Required:** You must submit a portfolio containing 3D CAD models you have designed (college projects, personal projects, or practice models are perfectly fine).

**What We Offer:**

* Hands\-on training in real\-world plastic product design and injection molding preparation.
* The rare opportunity to design complete hardware products from scratch in the robotics sector.

title: Draftsman - SolidWorks
company: kinemach engineering and machines pvt ltd
description:
About Kinemach

Kinemach is a Pune\-based manufacturing technology company specializing in assembly automation, material handling and robotics, processing equipment, packaging machinery, and inspection/testing systems. We serve customers across automotive, pharmaceutical, food processing, and electronics industries.

Kinemach's portfolio includes two specialized product lines: Procer Mixing, our range of high\-shear mixers and homogenizers built for GMP\-compliant food, pharma, cosmetic, and chemical applications; and DynaScrew, our precision automatic screw\-feeding and screw\-driving systems used in automotive, electronics, aerospace, and medical device manufacturing.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Draftsman with strong hands\-on SolidWorks skills to support design and engineering across all three Kinemach product lines \- automation and material handling equipment, Procer mixing systems, and DynaScrew screw\-driving stations. This role converts design engineers' concepts into accurate, manufacturable 3D models, 2D drawings, and BOMs, and works closely with the shop floor to keep documentation current through the build and dispatch process.

Key Responsibilities

\- Create and modify 3D models and assemblies in SolidWorks for machines, sub\-assemblies, and fabricated/machined components across all product lines.

\- Prepare detailed 2D manufacturing drawings \- general arrangement (GA), fabrication, and machining drawings \- complete with dimensions, tolerances, and GD\&T callouts.

\- Generate and maintain accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs) for assemblies and sub\-assemblies.

\- Work closely with design engineers to translate concepts, sketches, and design intent into detailed, production\-ready drawings.

\- Revise drawings promptly in response to design changes, engineering change notes (ECNs), and shop\-floor feedback.

\- Prepare drawings for sheet metal parts, weldments/fabrications, and precision\-machined components in line with drafting standards.

\- Create exploded views, assembly sequences, and reference layouts to support assembly and service documentation.

\- Maintain drawing revision control, numbering conventions, and documentation per Kinemach's drafting standards.

\- Coordinate with production, machining, and assembly teams to clarify drawings and resolve fit/interference issues.

\- Support new product development and design iterations for Procer and DynaScrew equipment, including GMP/hygienic design considerations and precision fastening system layouts where relevant.

Requirements

\- Diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

\- 0\-5 years of hands\-on experience in SolidWorks \- 3D modeling, assembly design, and 2D drafting (freshers with strong SolidWorks fundamentals are welcome to apply).

\- Solid working knowledge of GD\&T and standard engineering drafting practices (ISO/ASME).

\- Experience drafting sheet metal parts, weldments/fabrications, and machined components.

\- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, GA drawings, and BOMs independently.

\- Strong attention to detail and accuracy under production timelines.

\- Good communication skills to coordinate effectively with design, production, and quality teams.

Preferred

\- Prior experience in capital equipment or custom machine\-building environments, rather than mass\-production drafting.

\- Exposure to GMP/hygienic equipment design for pharma, food, or cosmetic applications (relevant to Procer).

\- Familiarity with fastening/screw\-driving system layouts or electromechanical assembly drawings (relevant to DynaScrew).

\- Working knowledge of SolidWorks PDM or similar drawing/revision management tools.

What We Offer

\- The opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of automation, mixing, and precision fastening equipment.

\- A collaborative engineering environment with direct exposure to the full design\-to\-dispatch cycle.

\- Competitive compensation aligned with experience and skill.

\- Growth opportunities within a fast\-growing manufacturing technology company.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

description:
**ABOUT AIR FREIGHT OPERATIONS**


The Air Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing the import and export of goods by air. Their primary objective is to create and maintain efficient processes, guaranteeing the seamless movement of goods by collaborating with Airline partners, Procurement and Capacity management and network offices, vendors, customs brokers, ultimately contributing to profitability.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**


As an integral part of the Air Freight Operations Export Team, this role encompasses optimizing and enhancing the export of goods by air in alignment with organization’s goal. The key responsibilities include ensuring efficient and compliant export processes, collaborating with airline partners and network offices, and prioritizing customer satisfaction. The role also involves actively contributing to the organization's profitability goals through effective operational execution and adherence to regulatory standards.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

**Operational Excellence**


* Develop and enhance operational processes to ensure consistent volume growth.
* Procure and utilize optimal airline capacity.
* Take charge of warehouse operations, ensuring seamless coordination between the warehouse and gateway.
* Manage end\-to\-end shipment processes from pick\-up to delivery, ensuring accurate file execution, timely invoicing, and dispatch as per SOP.
* Follow CW1 Best Practices, including milestone updating and effective utilization of CW1 tools.
* Accurately book costs and revenue, maintaining operational hygiene for a healthy P \& L.
* Be Proactive and Ensure Timestamp for Completeness \& Timeliness
* Handle carrier engagement to design solutions, improve profitability, and skillfully address claims, disputes, and customer complaints.
* Manage Complaints, Claims, Compliments \- be responsive and available.
* Taking complete responsibility for independently managing customer accounts, guided by both supervisor and manager, following the 'one file, one operator' approach.
* Drive the implementation of sustainable environmental practices within the air freight operations, contributing to corporate social responsibility goals.

  

**Stakeholder Management**


* Manage customer relationships and address grievances.
* Oversee overall billing quality and timeliness.
* Oversee end to end process for a specific set of customers from booking to delivery.
* Manage relationships with multiple carriers, vendors, customs brokers, and network partners.

  

**Customer and Network Support**


* Register complaints related to all export shipments.
* Execute and support day\-to\-day export operations deliverables.
* Reconcile and resolve network issues.
* Communicate frequently with sales and support functions.

  

**COMPETENCIES**


**Functional Competencies**


* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge of products, services, and logistics industry.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.

**Behavioral Competencies**


* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks and documentation.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high\-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues without waiting for direction.
* Team Collaboration: Collaborating across teams for smooth operations.
  

**WHO CAN APPLY?**


**Must Have**

description:
**BAKERY CHEF / BAKER**

**Company:** Grey Soul Coffee Roasters  
**Department:** Bakery / Kitchen  
**Designation:** Bakery Chef / Baker  
**Location:** \[Pune )  
**Reporting To:** Head Chef / Kitchen Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**1\. JOB SUMMARY**

The Bakery Chef / Baker will be responsible for the preparation, production, presentation, and quality of all bakery products served at Grey Soul Coffee. The role requires strong knowledge of baking techniques, consistency in product quality, proper food handling, cleanliness, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast\-paced café environment.

The Bakery Chef is expected to follow Grey Soul Coffee's recipes, SOPs, food safety standards, production schedules, and instructions from the Head Chef / Management.

**2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Bakery Production**

* Prepare and bake breads, pastries, cakes, cookies, muffins, croissants, and other bakery products as per the approved menu.
* Follow standard recipes, measurements, preparation methods, and presentation standards.
* Ensure consistency in taste, texture, appearance, size, and portioning.
* Prepare doughs, batters, fillings, creams, frostings, and other bakery components.
* Monitor proofing, fermentation, baking temperatures, and baking times.
* Ensure products are prepared according to daily production requirements.
* Maintain proper production schedules to ensure timely availability of products.

**B. Quality Control**

* Check the quality and freshness of all ingredients before use.
* Ensure all finished products meet Grey Soul Coffee's quality and presentation standards.
* Identify and report any quality issues immediately to the Head Chef / Kitchen Manager.
* Minimize wastage, overproduction, and product rejection.
* Maintain consistency across every batch.

**C. Inventory \& Ingredients**

* Check and monitor daily bakery ingredient requirements.
* Inform the Head Chef / Kitchen Manager about low\-stock or required ingredients.
* Ensure proper storage and labeling of raw materials and finished products.
* Follow FIFO (First In, First Out) principles.
* Avoid unnecessary wastage of ingredients.
* Maintain proper portion control.

**D. Hygiene \& Food Safety**

* Maintain high standards of personal hygiene and food safety.
* Keep bakery workstations, equipment, utensils, refrigerators, and storage areas clean and sanitized.
* Follow all company hygiene, sanitation, and food safety SOPs.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of dairy, eggs, flour, chocolate, cream, and other perishable ingredients.
* Follow temperature\-control and food\-storage requirements.
* Immediately report any hygiene, safety, or equipment\-related concern.

**E. Kitchen Operations**

* Coordinate with the Head Chef, Commis Chefs, Kitchen Team, and Service Team.
* Ensure bakery production is completed within the required timelines.
* Support the kitchen team during busy operational periods when required.
* Maintain discipline and professional conduct within the kitchen.
* Follow opening, closing, cleaning, and production checklists.
* Follow all instructions issued by the Head Chef and Management.

**F. Product Development**

* Assist in developing new bakery products and seasonal offerings.
* Suggest improvements to existing recipes and products.
* Conduct trials under the direction of the Head Chef / Management.
* Maintain proper recipe records for approved products.
* Support menu development while maintaining cost and quality standards.

**3\. DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Review the daily bakery production plan.
* Check availability and quality of ingredients.
* Complete required mise en place.
* Prepare and bake products according to production requirements.
* Maintain product consistency and presentation.
* Label and store finished products correctly.
* Record wastage where required.
* Clean and organize the bakery workstation.
* Complete the assigned closing / cleaning checklist.
* Report shortages, equipment issues, wastage, or quality concerns to the reporting manager.

**4\. REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES**

* Good knowledge of baking techniques and bakery production.
* Knowledge of dough preparation, proofing, baking, and finishing.
* Understanding of measurements and recipe accuracy.
* Good understanding of food hygiene and safety.
* Ability to work under pressure during peak hours.
* Good time\-management and organizational skills.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to maintain consistency in production.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a kitchen team.
* Willingness to learn and follow company SOPs.
* Good communication and workplace discipline.

**5\. QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE**

**Education:**

* Diploma / Certificate in Bakery, Pastry, Culinary Arts, or a related field is preferred.

**Experience:**

* 1–3 years of relevant bakery / pastry experience preferred.
* Experience in a café, bakery, restaurant, or specialty food establishment will be an advantage.
* Freshers with relevant bakery training may also be considered based on skills.

**6\. WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Full\-time role in a professional café / kitchen environment.
* 6 working days per week.
* Shift\-based working as per business requirements.
* Employee must report to work on time and be ready to begin duties at the scheduled shift time.
* The role requires prolonged standing and physical movement during working hours.
* The employee may be required to work during weekends, public holidays, or peak business periods as per the roster.

**7\. PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Quality and consistency of bakery products.
* Timely completion of production.
* Hygiene and food safety compliance.
* Recipe and portion control.
* Reduction of wastage.
* Attendance and punctuality.
* Teamwork and communication.
* Compliance with company SOPs and management instructions.
* Ability to maintain kitchen discipline and cleanliness.
* Customer and management feedback on product quality.

**8\. REPORTING \& ACCOUNTABILITY**

The Bakery Chef / Baker will report directly to the **Head Chef / Kitchen Manager** and will be accountable for the quality, quantity, hygiene, timely production, and proper handling of bakery products assigned to them.

The employee is expected to follow all **Grey Soul Coffee policies, SOPs, food safety standards, operational procedures, and reasonable instructions issued by Management.**

**9\. CONFIDENTIALITY \& COMPANY STANDARDS**

The employee shall maintain confidentiality regarding company recipes, production methods, costing, supplier information, internal processes, and other confidential business information.

The employee is expected to maintain the professional standards and values of Grey Soul Coffee at all times.

**Core Values:**  
**Discipline**  Integrity **Excellence**

title: Product Manager
description:
**Introduction**
 Plotline helps consumer apps create personalized in\-app and off\-app experiences without repeated engineering effort.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to own key product modules end\-to\-end. This is a
 **1\-to\-n product role** 
 focused on improving, scaling, and driving adoption of existing and new capabilities.
   

  

 You will work directly with customers, designers, engineers, Customer Success, and founders to decide what to build, ship it, and ensure customers receive measurable value from it.
   

  

****What You Will Own****
* Own the roadmap for assigned in\-app and off\-app modules
* Speak regularly with customers and participate in QBRs
* Identify recurring customer problems and convert them into scalable product improvements
* Benchmark Plotline against competitors and close important product gaps
* Define requirements and problem statements for design and engineering
* Drive features from prioritization through launch, adoption, and iteration
* Measure whether shipped features improve customer value
* Help establish Plotline as an innovative, AI\-first, class\-leading product


****What Success Looks Like****
**First 3 Months**
* Develop a strong understanding of Plotline’s customers, products, and competitive landscape
* Build relationships with 5 to 6 customers and independently run product conversations
* Establish adoption and value metrics for assigned modules
* Identify and prioritize the most important product gaps
* Own at least one meaningful product improvement from problem definition to launch


**First Year**
* Get each assigned module adopted by at least five paying customers
* Improve adoption and meaningful usage after launch
* Deliver improvements that solve recurring problems across multiple customers
* Keep Plotline competitive with leading customer\-engagement platforms
* Build a clear, evidence\-based roadmap with explicit trade\-offs
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in customer value, retention, or expansion


**Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership**
* Own assigned modules from roadmap through adoption and continuous improvement
* Prioritize customer problems using customer evidence, usage data, commercial impact, competitive context, and engineering effort
* Make clear decisions about what to build, what to delay, and what not to build
* Define the smallest valuable version and reduce unnecessary scope


**Customer Insight**
* Speak regularly with customers and independently lead product discussions
* Participate in QBRs and understand how customers use Plotline
* Synthesize customer interviews, support issues, usage data, and commercial feedback
* Separate recurring product problems from one\-off feature requests
* Validate whether shipped solutions have resolved the original problem


**Competitive Benchmarking**
* Regularly evaluate competing products and emerging market trends
* Identify capabilities where Plotline must match or lead the market
* Translate competitive findings into practical product decisions
* Help ensure Plotline is perceived as innovative and AI\-first


**Product Delivery**
* Give designers clear problems, user context, constraints, and desired outcomes
* Partner closely with engineering on feasibility, trade\-offs, edge cases, and delivery
* Maintain clear scope, requirements, success metrics, and non\-goals
* Resolve ambiguity and unblock decisions during development
* Coordinate launches with Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Support


**Adoption and Outcomes**
* Define success metrics before development begins
* Create rollout, enablement, and adoption plans for every major launch
* Track customer adoption, repeat usage, customer value, and retention signals
* Investigate why valuable features are not being adopted
* Improve, reposition, or stop investing based on evidence


****What we are looking for****
* 3 to 6 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or a comparable technology product
* Proven ownership of products or modules from prioritization through adoption
* Evidence of shipping and scaling features across multiple paying customers
* Strong examples of measurable adoption, usage, retention, or business impact
* Experience making prioritization decisions under limited engineering capacity
* Ability to independently run customer conversations
* Strong product judgment and customer empathy
* Experience working closely with product designers and engineers
* Comfort understanding APIs, SDKs, integrations, data flows, and analytics
* Strong written and verbal communication


****Strong Signals****
* You can explain what you personally decided, shipped, and improved
* You have taken a feature from low adoption to meaningful customer usage
* You have rejected attractive requests to protect a more important outcome
* You can identify patterns across conflicting customer feedback
* You benchmark competitors without blindly copying them
* You define success through customer outcomes, not launches
* You continue owning a product after it ships


****What This Role Is Not****
* It is not primarily a GTM, sales, or pipeline\-generation role
* It is not a project\-management or ticket\-writing role
* It is not limited to launching new features
* It is not a pure 0\-to\-1 discovery role
* It is not about building custom solutions for every customer


****Why Join Plotline?****
* Own strategically important products used by consumer businesses globally
* Work directly with customers, founders, designers, and engineers
* Shape the roadmap across in\-app engagement, off\-app communication, analytics, gamification, and AI
* See your work move from customer problem to shipped product and measurable adoption
* Operate with meaningful autonomy and clear outcome ownership


 If you enjoy understanding customers, making difficult product decisions, shipping with strong teams, and ensuring products create real value after launch, we would love to hear from you.

title: Fibre splicer
description:
**Position Title: Fiber Optic Splicer**

**Department:** Technical / Field Operations

**Reports To:** Field Supervisor / Project Manager

**Location:** As Assigned

1\. Job Summary

The Fiber Optic Splicer is responsible for installation, splicing, testing, maintenance, and repair of fiber optic cables to ensure uninterrupted broadband, IPTV, and leased line services. The role requires technical expertise, accuracy, safety compliance, and timely execution of assigned projects.

2\. Roles and ResponsibilitiesA. Fiber Splicing \& Termination

· Perform fusion and mechanical splicing of fiber optic cables.

· Prepare, strip, clean, and cleave fiber cables before splicing.

· Terminate fiber cables in ODF, patch panels, and distribution boxes.

· Ensure splice loss remains within acceptable standards.

B. Installation \& Deployment

· Install underground, aerial, and indoor fiber optic cables.

· Assist in cable laying, routing, and ducting activities.

· Install joint enclosures, splitter boxes, and fiber distribution units.

C. Testing \& Troubleshooting

· Conduct testing using OTDR, power meter, and light source.

· Identify and rectify fiber faults, breaks, and signal losses.

· Perform preventive maintenance and emergency restoration work.

· Maintain proper documentation of test results.

D. Maintenance \& Repair

· Respond promptly to service complaints and fiber cut issues.

· Repair damaged fiber cables and restore connectivity.

· Coordinate with technical teams during network outages.

E. Documentation \& Reporting

· Maintain daily work reports and job completion reports.

· Record splice loss readings and maintain fiber route details.

· Update inventory usage of fiber cables and materials.

F. Safety \& Compliance

· Follow company safety policies and use proper PPE.

· Ensure work is completed as per industry standards and company guidelines.

· Maintain tools and equipment in proper working condition.

3\. Required Skills \& Competencies

· Knowledge of fiber optic splicing and testing equipment.

· Ability to read fiber network diagrams and route maps.

· Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

· Basic knowledge of broadband and IPTV network infrastructure.

· Good communication and teamwork skills.

· Willingness to work in field conditions and extended hours if required.

4\. Educational Qualification

· ITI / Diploma in Electronics, Telecommunications, or relevant field.

· Certification in Fiber Optic Technology (Preferred).

5\. Experience

· 1–3 years of experience in fiber optic splicing (Preferred).

· Freshers with technical training may also apply.

6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

· Quality of splicing (minimum loss levels).

· Timely completion of assigned tasks.

· Quick fault resolution and restoration.

· Compliance with safety and reporting standards.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Strong understanding of Scaled Agile and Scrum practices
* Excellent Communication \& Stakeholder Facilitation
* Familiarity with Agile Tooling (JIRA) \& Reporting Practices


**Desirable Skills**
* Ability to Drive Agile Mindset \& Team Culture
* Understanding of Liquidity / Corporate Banking Domain
* Ability to Work Across Multi‑disciplinary, Distributed POD Structures


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Analyst Expectations**
 To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
   

  

 Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
   

  

 Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
   

  

 They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
   

  

 Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
   

  

**Partner With Other Functions And Business Areas.**
 Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
   

  

 Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
   

  

 Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
   

  

 Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
   

  

 Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
   

  

 Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
   

  

 Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
   

  

 Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
   

  

 Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Scrum Master based in India.**
 This is an opportunity to support technology teams in building stronger Agile practices and delivering work with greater consistency and predictability.
   

  

 You will facilitate Scrum ceremonies, maintain delivery discipline, remove impediments, and ensure teams remain focused on meaningful outcomes.
   

  

 The role is particularly suited to a Scrum Master who enjoys helping teams develop their Agile maturity and reducing process friction.
   

  

 You will use Jira to maintain healthy backlogs, track sprint progress, and provide stakeholders with accurate and timely delivery visibility.
   

  

 Your work will directly contribute to improving sprint predictability, resolving blockers, and creating sustainable delivery habits.
   

  

 You will collaborate with technology teams and stakeholders in an environment that values continuous improvement, transparency, and effective communication.
   

  

 You will also have the opportunity to use AI\-assisted productivity tools to streamline ceremony preparation, documentation, and reporting.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring ceremonies remain structured, time\-boxed, and focused on clear outcomes.
* Support team charters, kickoffs, working agreements, and delivery expectations for new or developing Agile teams.
* Document key decisions, action items, and commitments from Scrum ceremonies to ensure continuity between sprints.
* Coach and support teams that are still developing their Agile practices, helping them apply Scrum principles effectively in their day\-to\-day work.
* Identify impediments early, coordinate appropriate escalation, and follow through to help prevent blockers from affecting sprint commitments.
* Encourage open, constructive retrospectives and ensure agreed improvement actions are tracked through to completion.
* Maintain Jira boards, backlogs, sprint configurations, stories, and other delivery information for assigned teams.
* Monitor team\-level delivery metrics, including velocity, sprint completion, and open impediments, using Jira dashboards and established reporting practices.
* Provide concise, accurate, and timely delivery updates to stakeholders based on completed work and current team status.
* Use AI\-assisted tools to support ceremony preparation, meeting notes, documentation, and status reporting while reducing repetitive administrative work.
* Promote transparency, accountability, continuous improvement, and effective collaboration across technology teams.
* Help teams build consistent delivery habits that improve predictability and reduce day\-to\-day process friction.


**Requirements**
* 2\+ years of experience working as a Scrum Master or in an Agile delivery support role within a technology environment.
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum principles, ceremonies, roles, and Agile delivery practices.
* Hands\-on experience facilitating or co\-facilitating sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Practical experience using Jira for sprint tracking, story management, backlog administration, and basic dashboard configuration.
* Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to keep teams aligned and follow through on commitments.
* Proven ability to identify, manage, and escalate delivery impediments effectively.
* Comfortable supporting teams that are developing or strengthening their Agile practices, with the ability to adapt your approach as teams mature.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills and the ability to communicate delivery status clearly and concisely.
* Experience facilitating constructive retrospectives and translating feedback into actionable improvements.
* Ability to work collaboratively with Software Engineering, IT infrastructure, or enterprise technology teams.
* Scrum certification such as CSM, PSM I, or an equivalent qualification is preferred.
* Experience working within organizations with established Agile standards is an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI productivity tools or an interest in using automation to reduce repetitive administrative tasks is desirable.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced technology environment.
* Willingness to work 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM IST to support relevant team and business requirements.


**Benefits**
* Full\-time opportunity based in India with a remote working arrangement.
* Flexible\-first working environment designed to support productivity and work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to work with technology teams operating at significant enterprise scale.
* Exposure to AI\-powered technologies and modern AI\-assisted productivity tools.
* Opportunities for professional growth through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development, and education support.
* Collaborative environment focused on Agile maturity, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.
* Opportunity to develop deeper expertise in Scrum, Jira, Agile transformation, stakeholder management, and technology delivery.
* Well\-being resources and programs designed to support employees and their families.
* Paid volunteer time and additional employee\-focused initiatives.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to improving delivery predictability, team effectiveness, and technology outcomes.

title: Story writer
description:
**Role Overview**

PlotPix is building an AI native microdrama platform for mobile first, vertical storytelling. We create emotionally addictive, binge worthy fiction designed for short episode formats and fast audience payoff.

We are looking for a creative **Story Writer** who can create stories people feel compelled to continue. This is not a pure script formatting role. We already use AI heavily for speed and execution. What we need most is a strong creative mind with sharp instinct for storytelling, emotional progression, character build up, audience pull, narrative rhythm, and what makes a viewer care.

You should be someone who can take a rough idea and turn it into a compelling story engine. Someone who naturally thinks in terms of tension, reversals, chemistry, obsession, secrets, payoffs, emotional spikes, and binge flow.

This role is for people who are excited by new **storytelling formats, can adapt to new audiences quickly, and can use AI as a multiplier rather than as a crutch.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Create original microdrama story concepts with strong audience appeal
* Build lead characters viewers get emotionally invested in, root for, obsess over, hate, or can’t ignore
* Design high retention story arcs with clear emotional movement across episodes
* Shape narration flow, emotional flow, reveals, reversals, cliffhangers, and payoff moments
* Develop stories that feel highly bingeable in a short form vertical format
* Explore multiple creative directions for the same premise and identify the strongest one
* Adapt stories across genres, tones, and audience segments based on brief, platform need, or viewer response
* Work with AI tools to accelerate ideation, expansion, variation, and iteration
* Push past generic ideas and predictable beats to find fresher, sharper story turns
* Collaborate closely with directors, editors, and creative leads to refine stories from concept to final narrative
* Rewrite with intent, not just polish. Improve emotional impact, clarity, pace, and viewer pull
* Continuously learn what works for new formats, new markets, and changing audience tastes

**What We’re Really Looking For**

* Strong instinct for storytelling over scripting
* Strong sense of emotion over exposition
* Strong sense of viewer psychology over technical correctness
* Ability to create characters, conflict, tension, attraction, betrayal, longing, power shifts, and payoff
* Ability to judge whether a story feels flat, forced, repetitive, too safe, too slow, or not emotionally sticky
* High creative aptitude and fast pattern recognition
* Comfort with ambiguity, experimentation, and non traditional workflows
* Curiosity about what different audiences respond to and why
* Ability to use AI effectively while still bringing original taste and judgment

**Ideal Candidate** : 1\-2 years in MicroDrama

**What matters most is that you can:**

* Think of strong stories fast
* Build characters people care about
* Sustain emotional momentum
* Adapt to feedback without making the story bland
* Create for modern mobile audiences without sounding synthetic or derivative

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in short form fiction, web series, episodic storytelling, romance, thriller, drama, or youth content
* Understanding of Gen Z and young adult entertainment patterns
* Familiarity with cliffhanger design, binge loops, and retention driven storytelling
* Experience using AI tools for brainstorming, iteration, or story development
* Comfort working in a fast paced creative environment with frequent iteration

**What We Offer**

* Working with a highly skilled, motivated and passionate group of people.
* Exposure to the full product development process from ideation to launch.
* Our culture of experimentation and creativity allows everyone to explore new ideas and approaches and think outside the box.
* Building a product for the global audience.
* A full pantry of munchies.

For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.
   

  

**About The ETS Apprenticeship Program**
 ETS engages Apprentices under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) in compliance with the Apprenticeship Act. The goal is to provide practical training, foster skill development, and ensure compliance with the Apprenticeship Act, thereby enhancing employability and contributing to the organization's workforce development goals.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Talent Management
 **Apprentice** 
 who is eager to learn and build a strong foundation in Human Resources within a global organisation.
   

  

 As an Apprentice, you will gain hands\-on exposure to various HR processes and initiatives while working closely with HR professionals and business stakeholders. The role will provide opportunities to develop your skills in HR operations, employee engagement, talent management, learning and development, and other HR initiatives.
   

  

 The apprenticeship is designed to provide fresh graduates with practical corporate experience, professional skills, and a structured learning pathway. Depending on business and project requirements, the apprentice may also have the opportunity to gain exposure to different HR functions and projects. This is a contractual role of 1 year.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support the HR team in day\-to\-day HR activities and operational processes.
* Assist with employee engagement initiatives, HR communications, and internal events.
* Support HR projects and initiatives across different areas of Human Resources.
* Assist in preparing HR reports, presentations, trackers, and other relevant documentation.
* Work with HR teams and stakeholders to gather information and support project requirements.
* Maintain and update HR data and records with accuracy and confidentiality.
* Support the coordination of meetings, training sessions, and other HR activities.
* Assist with Learning \& Development initiatives and employee development programmes.
* Support the team with data analysis and reporting using tools such as Excel and PowerPoint.
* Explore and leverage AI tools and technology to improve HR processes and productivity.
* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders and respond to queries in a timely and professional manner.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and projects and complete them within agreed timelines.
* Demonstrate curiosity and willingness to learn new HR processes, tools, and technologies.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow all applicable ETS policies and processes.


**Required Qualifications**

* Candidates pursuing or having completed an MBA/PGDM in Human Resources will be preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Strong willingness to learn and develop a career in Human Resources.
* Ability to work independently with minimal guidance while collaborating effectively with the team.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior internship experience in Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Learning \& Development, or a related HR function.
* Exposure to HR processes or corporate environments.
* Basic understanding of HR practices and employee lifecycle processes.
* Familiarity with AI tools and their application in the workplace.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast\-paced environment.


**Key Competencies**
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with different stakeholders.
* Learning Agility: Demonstrates curiosity and the ability to quickly learn new concepts, processes, and tools.
* Ownership: Takes responsibility for assigned tasks and follows through to completion.
* Collaboration: Works effectively with team members and stakeholders.
* Adaptability: Comfortable working on varied projects and supporting changing business needs.
* Attention to Detail: Maintains accuracy while working with HR data and documentation.
* Technology Orientation: Willingness to learn and use technology and AI tools to enhance productivity.
* Initiative: Proactively seeks opportunities to learn, contribute, and improve processes.


**What You Will Gain**
 As an HR Apprentice at ETS, you will:
   

  

* Gain hands\-on experience in a global HR environment.
* Develop practical knowledge of HR processes and corporate practices.
* Gain exposure to multiple HR functions and projects based on business requirements.
* Develop skills in stakeholder management, communication, and professional collaboration.
* Build proficiency in tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, and AI\-enabled technologies.
* Work closely with experienced HR professionals and learn through mentoring and on\-the\-job experience.
* Develop a structured learning pathway aligned with your role and career interests.
* Gain exposure to real\-world HR projects and initiatives.
* Receive an apprenticeship completion certificate upon successful completion of the programme.
* Build a strong foundation for a future career in Human Resources.


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 We are looking for someone who is curious, trainable, proactive, and eager to learn. The ideal candidate may be a fresh graduate or an HR postgraduate who is looking to gain meaningful corporate exposure and build a career in Human Resources. Prior HR internship experience will be an advantage, but candidates with the right attitude, communication skills, and willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Your role**
**What You'll Be Doing**
**What We Need**
 Corpay is currently looking to hire a Human Resources Manager within our Human Resources department. This position is located in Nagpur, India. This position plays a critical role in driving operational excellence across the HR function by leading strategic HR operations initiatives, enhancing workforce analytics, and optimizing HR processes and systems. The ideal candidate is a data\-driven HR professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is passionate about improving the employee and manager experience through operational efficiency and continuous improvement.
   

  

**How We Work**
 As a Human Resource Manager, you will be expected to work in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment, partnering closely with HR Business Partners, business leaders, and Centers of Excellence. Depending on business needs, this role may operate in a hybrid or onsite work environment.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will:
   

  

* Lead enterprise\-wide HR operations initiatives focused on automation, process optimization, workforce data governance, and compliance.
* Provide strategic workforce insights and recommendations to HR Business Partners and business leaders through advanced HR analytics and data interpretation.
* Oversee the delivery of HR reporting, dashboards, workforce metrics, and workforce planning inputs that support business decision\-making.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across HR systems, workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve efficiency, scalability, and data accuracy.
* Partner with HR leadership on high\-impact organizational initiatives, including reorganizations, policy implementation, organizational design, and workforce planning.
* Establish and maintain governance processes that ensure HR data integrity, reporting accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
* Identify opportunities to leverage technology and automation to streamline HR operations and improve service delivery.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including HRIS, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, and IT to support enterprise HR initiatives.
* Develop executive\-ready reports and presentations that communicate workforce trends, operational performance, and strategic recommendations.
* Mentor and develop HR analysts while fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the HR organization.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Analytics, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred.
* 7\+ years of progressive HR Operations, HR Analytics, HRIS, or Human Resources experience.
* Experience leading HR operations, workforce analytics, or shared services functions in a complex, global organization.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate workforce data into actionable business insights.
* Experience developing executive dashboards, KPI reporting, and workforce planning models.
* Demonstrated knowledge of HR compliance, governance, and HR data management best practices.
* Experience driving process improvement, automation, and operational transformation initiatives.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Proven ability to build relationships across all levels of the organization and influence stakeholders.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting and analytics tools.
* Experience working with enterprise HRIS platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or UKG is preferred.


**Benefits \& Perks**
* Competitive salary package
* Career development opportunities in fintech
* Exposure to global clients and innovative payment solutions
* Health insurance and flexible work options


**About Corpay**
**About Corpay**
 Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.
   

  

 At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally.
   

  

 As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre\-employment screening conducted by an authorized third\-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law.
   

  

**Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:** 
 Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. title: Manager - Human Resources
description:
**Manager – Human Resources \& Contract Labour**
**About The Job**
 Own the end\-to\-end people agenda for the factory workforce (BC, WC and CL) by translating factory business needs into HR actions across hire\-to\-retire, ensuring continuity of operations and workforce stability. The incumbent acts as the single accountable HR owner for on\-ground people outcomes in partnership with the Factory HR Head, Factory leadership, and functional stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Workforce Planning, Staffing \& Onboarding (Permanent Employees – BC/WC)
* Lead workforce planning, staffing, and onboarding governance for BC, apprentices, temps/FTCs, and WC.
* Ensure joining readiness through documentation, statutory compliance, medical checks, orientation, and IT readiness.
* Drive timely closure of vacancies by coordinating with hiring managers and shared service partners.
* Contract Labour Deployment \& Shift Management
* Lead CL workforce planning in close collaboration with Supply Chain and Production Planning.
* Ensure timely requisitions and sufficient CL availability for production requirements.
* Manage daily deployment discipline, line allocation, and resolve shortages in real time with Operations, Production leaders, Factory Manager, and contractors to prevent production loss.
* Contract Labour Hiring, Onboarding \& Compliance Readiness
* Own sourcing, selection, joining formalities, legal and medical checks, and uniform/PPE availability for CL.
* Ensure periodic mandatory trainings (NCBP, COBC, POSH, Safety, QA) are completed and tracked.
* Own end\-to\-end readiness of the contract workforce before deployment.
* Contractor Ecosystem \& Principal Employer Compliance
* Govern adherence to applicable Labour Codes and Contract Labour statutes.
* Maintain statutory documentation, committee requirements, and drive audit readiness.
* Manage contractor registration, credential governance, and enforce obligations (wages, PF/ESIC/OT/LWF, working hours, compliance MIS).
* Manage SES, arrears/bonus settlements, and long\-term settlement impact assessments in coordination with ER, Finance, and Legal.
* Factory People Processes, Culture \& HR Operations
* Execute performance cycles: goal setting, mid\-year check\-ins, People Day / PDP closure.
* Manage probation confirmations and PIP actions.
* Drive capability building and mandatory training targets.
* Own engagement actions, employee listening, and grievance resolution.
* Ensure HRIS / position data hygiene and timely system actions for hiring, transfers, and exits through NBS interfaces.


**Experience \& Background Required**
* 2 years of relevant HR / HRBP / IR / CL management experience, preferably in a manufacturing / factory environment.
* Exposure to Labour Codes, Contract Labour compliance, and factory HR operations preferred.

title: Employee Relations Manager, Employee Experience and Relations (EXR)
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, we’re working to be the "Earth's Best Employer and Earth's Safest Place to Work." To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. If you would like to help us make history, here’s your chance to accelerate our growth and ability to serve our employees and associates by joining the India Operations Employee Relations (ER) Team.
   

  

 The India Operations ER team supports Field Operations organizations across fulfilment and logistics business lines. The central objective of our team is to ensure treatment of employees and associates that is fair, respectful, and consistent with our framework of our core business values and objectives. To support that objective, ER team’s responsibilities fall into proactive and reactive categories.
   

  

 INOPS ER team is part of the Global Employee Relations vertical within Amazon, and works closely with the Field People eXperience and Technology (PXT / HR) teams and Operations teams in advising and enabling them to provide a seamless employee and associate experience.
   

  

 As an Employee Relations Manager (ERM), you will drive positive employee relations and enable positive associate and employee experience in your region and line of business.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates with who possess communication and interpersonal skills that let them communicate with ease, across levels from shop floor employees to senior leaders. The role will set in motion and advance numerous programs that develop and nurture a positive work environment, and advancing our work towards being the earth’s best employer. This position requires an individual who has employee relations experience. Experience and exposure to Indian statutory labor compliance laws will be helpful. Successful candidate will be able to independently own and drive broad spectrum of employee relations programs and handle issues. This role requires considerable domestic travel.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The individual will be responsible for the following types of proactive work:
   

  

* Problem Solve: Work independently with minimal supervision, in ambiguous situations, and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions. Analyze, diagnose, design, and revise people programs, policies, and practices to sustain positive employee relations
* Communicate Effectively: Rapidly produce high\-quality written communications that concisely analyze problems and recommends solutions; design and deliver highly\-engaging training sessions. Partner to engage in continuous improvement in communication vehicles and practices
* Analyze and Interpret Data: Exercise analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations; demonstrated ability to define and measure success of programs. Design, collect, and analyze multiple levels of employee feedback
* Detect and Mitigate Risks: Apply employee and labor relations expertise to successfully identify trends, gaps, and challenges; execute solution\-focused strategies and programs to mitigate risks
* Project Management: Independently own large\-scale, network\-wide projects delivered on time that improve associate experience at a site and network level. Conduct and oversee employee relations vulnerability assessment programs


 The individual also will work on critical employee relations issues that are crisis oriented and typically can only be successfully completed with limited time while exercising judgment. Time management between proactive and reactive responsibilities is a critical component for success in the position.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 5\+ years of employee relations, labor relations, human resources, operations or related field experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources Management or a related field
* 6\+ years of relevant professional experience

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Description** 




**Position:** 
 HR Manager \- US Staffing Operations
 



**Company:** 
 UnivEdge Consulting Private Limited
 



**Location:** 
 Greater Noida West (On\-site)
 



**Department:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Shift:** 
 6:30 PM – 4:00 AM IST, Monday to Friday
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time, permanent
 



**Experience Required:** 
 6–10 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 UnivEdge Consulting is a founder\-led IT staffing and recruitment firm serving clients across the United States, Canada, and India. We place contract and full\-time technology talent — data engineering, AI/ML, cloud, and broader IT disciplines — with global consulting organisations and enterprise clients. Our delivery team operates from Greater Noida West on US\-aligned hours.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The HR Manager will own the human resources function end\-to\-end for UnivEdge's India operations, supporting a US staffing delivery business. This is a standalone role: there is no existing HR team, and no inherited playbook. The successful candidate will be responsible for building employment infrastructure from the ground up — documentation, statutory compliance, payroll coordination, onboarding, performance management, and exits — while partnering with leadership on the growth of the recruitment team.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of HR and staffing operations. Familiarity with the US staffing industry — recruiter productivity models, bench management, W\-2 and C2C engagement structures, and the operational rhythm of a US\-hours delivery team — is essential to being effective.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Statutory Compliance and Employment Law** 



* Own compliance with the Uttar Pradesh Shops and Establishments Act, the Indian labour codes, and all applicable central and state employment legislation
* Manage Provident Fund and ESI registration, contributions, and filings; liaise with consultants and authorities as required
* Constitute and administer the Internal Committee under the POSH Act, 2013, including appointment of the external member, member training, complaint handling, and annual reporting
* Ensure full compliance with night\-shift employment obligations, including consent, transportation, security, and working\-hour requirements for women employees
* Maintain statutory registers, records, and returns; ensure audit\-readiness at all times
* Monitor changes in employment law and advise leadership on operational impact



**2\. Employment Documentation and Contracting** 



* Draft, maintain, and version\-control all employment documentation: offer letters, appointment letters, employment agreements, confidentiality and restrictive covenant clauses, and annexures
* Build and maintain a leave policy, attendance policy, code of conduct, and employee handbook
* Draft exit documentation: acceptance letters, relieving letters, experience certificates, and full\-and\-final settlement statements
* Ensure absolute accuracy and internal consistency across all documents issued; establish a review and sign\-off process before any document leaves the company
* Maintain a controlled master template library with change history



**3\. Payroll, Compensation and Settlements** 



* Coordinate monthly payroll: attendance reconciliation, loss\-of\-pay computation, incentive and commission processing, and disbursement
* Manage TDS, professional tax where applicable, and statutory deductions in coordination with the finance function
* Compute and process full\-and\-final settlements within statutory timelines
* Conduct compensation benchmarking for recruitment roles in the NCR market and advise on salary bands
* Administer recruiter incentive and commission structures tied to placements



**4\. Talent Acquisition — Internal Hiring**

**6\. HR Operations and Systems** 



* Implement and maintain an attendance and leave management system producing defensible, auditable records
