 Vadodara, Gujarat
 



  





**About VikingCloud** 




  





 VikingCloud is the leading Predict\-to\-Prevent cybersecurity and compliance company, offering businesses a single, integrated solution to make informed, predictive, and cost\-effective risk mitigation decisions – faster. Powered by the Asgard Platform™, the industry’s largest repository of anonymized cybersecurity and compliance event data, we continuously monitor and analyze over 6\+ billion online events every day.
 



 VikingCloud is the one\-stop partner trusted by 4\+ million customers to provide the predictive intelligence and competitive edge they need to stay one step ahead of cybersecurity and compliance disruptions to their business. Our 1,000 dedicated cybersecurity and compliance expert advisors understand that it’s not just about technology. It’s about transacting business and delivering an exceptional customer experience every day, without fail. That’s the measurable value we deliver. And that’s what we call, Business Uninterrupted.
 



  





 This Position
 



 Firewall support Level 1 provides excellent customer service for a fast\-paced multitasking service desk environment that supports remote access internet VPN products, managed security and network services, Software as a Service Products (SaaS), with high first call resolution.
 



 Responsibilities
 


1. **Phone/Chat/Email Support**


* Apply handling processes consistently.
* Log and track all communications received into the ticketing system.
* Establish a quality working relationship with a variety of customers.
* Follow defined standards to resolve a specific set of problems.
* Follow defined standards to collect and follow up on escalated issues.
* Escalate issues within the defined standards.


1. **Level I Support**


* Research and resolve caller inquiries by utilizing established procedures, user manuals, accessing on\-line applications, or interacting with internal and external support groups.
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and communications issues by interacting with application end users, application engineers, system engineers and hardware / software vendors.



**3\. Continuous Improvement** 



* Meet individual metrics for Level 1 Support Engineer
* Identify and suggest process improvements as they arise.
* Participate in departmental training activities including training programs in support of new technologies, procedures, and customer service enhancements.


- 


**4\. Technical Skills** 



* Knowledge and experience with network protocols and concepts including SSH, FTP, ICMP, TCPIP (IPv4 \& IPv6\), Network Address Translation (NAT), SNMP, IPSec, GRE, QoS, and VLANs.
* Ability to interpret output from network traffic analysis tools such as Ethereal (Wireshark)
* Effective interpersonal and consulting skills to be used to align customer needs to tactical and strategic solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Meraki and Fortinet firewalls** 
 .
* Ability to effectively collaborate in a dynamic team environment.
* **Firewall Implementation and Support**
* Installing Managed Network Solutions including Fortinet firewalls.
* Making changes to firewalls in support of customer’s needs.
* Solving technical customer issues around firewalls, filtering, IP Networking, Routing, VPNs, and application connectivity.
* Respond to firewall/network issues on a rotating on\-call basis. This will, depending on the situation, may require work outside the traditional work hours, including weekends and holidays, and will require carrying and responding to a cell phone or other contact device, as determined by management.
* Monitor performance, capacity, and availability of the firewalls on an ongoing basis. Recommend improvements in technologies and practices to increase these metrics.
* Maintain awareness of and familiarity with trends and new developments in technologies used in, or appropriate for use in, firewall support and operating infrastructure.
* Work with other technical staff to develop firewall architectures, technologies, and quality assurance policies and procedures.
* Deliver better than agreed customer SLAs.
* Firewall and VPN Management
* Perform incident, problem, and change management process for firewalls according to ITIL standards.
* Improve customer satisfaction metric, through stable transparent service



  





**Qualifications** 



* Provide excellent first line customer service.
* Respond to all chats, emails, and phone calls consistently.
* Enter all relevant data from customer contact channels into tracking system.
* Assist with troubleshooting and resolution of all tickets that can be processed from start to finish by level 1 as defined by management.
* Great interpersonal skills; superior customer service skills; excellent multi\-channel communication skills.
* Works well under pressure with limited supervision while consistently displaying a professional demeanor.
* Ability to follow processes and escalate issues consistently.
* Resolve a variety of external technical requests including virtual private networks, protecting data integrity, and assisting the retail industry with the send/receive of proprietary data.
* Support the technical management team with call data analysis.
* Experienced in Windows operating systems.
* Familiar with TCP/IP and networking concepts.
* High level of ethics and integrity.
* Scheduling flexibility required.



  





 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer

RDE emphasizes a value\-driven mindset, where humans define objectives and ethical guardrails while AI agents handle scale, speed, and data\-driven execution The RDE Engineer – Agentic AI \& Integration will design, build, integrate, test and deploy AI\-native and Agentic AI solutions for Accenture Operations RDE PODs. The role supports the RDE POD model where engineers are expected to operate close to client problems, contribute across the delivery lifecycle, reduce handoffs, and accelerate client\-facing outcomes through compact, T\-shaped teams. * Agentic AI (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, RAG)

* Agentic AI Concepts \- Deep understanding of AI agent design, reasoning loops, orchestration patterns \& multi\-agent coordination architectures. Core differentiator; senior levels lead architecture design
* Agentic AI Concepts \- Tool calling, function routing, agent memory \& state management, autonomous decision\-making patterns. Applicable across levels; depth scales with seniority
* LLM \& Prompt Engineering \- Hands\-on with LLMs (GPT\-4, Claude, Gemini); prompt engineering, few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought \& structured output techniques. Focus on prompt craft
* LLM \& Prompt Engineering \- RAG pipeline design, vector database integration (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB) \& semantic search for enterprise grounding. RAG critical for enterprise\-grade AI accuracy
* AI Frameworks \- Exposure in LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or CrewAI for production\-grade agentic workflow development.
* Programming \& APIs \- Strong Python skills — async programming, OOP, data structures \& scripting for AI pipelines; Java/.NET acceptable. Python strongly preferred for AI workloads
* Programming \& APIs \- REST/GraphQL API development, microservices design \& enterprise application integration patterns \- Integration skills essential for enterprise deployment
* Skill Area
* Cloud \& DevOps \- Azure / AWS / GCP hands\-on experience; cloud\-native architecture, infrastructure provisioning \& managed AI services. AWS preferred for this engagement; cloud\-agnostic skills valued
* Cloud \& DevOps \- Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipeline setup, GitOps \& automated deployment practices. CI/CD mandatory
* Security \& Responsible AI \- Security principles, identity management (OAuth, Azure AD), AI guardrails, bias mitigation \& enterprise compliance
* Enterprise Integration \- Integrating with enterprise platforms: ServiceNow, Appian, SAP, Salesforce \& Microsoft ecosystem (M365, Teams, Power Platform). Platform experience maps directly to client landscape
* Testing \& Observability \- AI solution testing, LLM output evaluation, observability (tracing, monitoring), performance tuning \& cost optimization. Observability critical for production AI agents Secondary Skills
* Exposure to RAG, vector databases, LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel or CrewAI is preferred.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms, Docker, CI/CD, testing and observability concepts.
* Interest in responsible AI, AI guardrails, enterprise integration and production\-readiness practices. Roles and Responsibilities:
* Support development of Python\-led AI/ML components, scripts and AI pipeline utilities under guidance from senior engineers.

* Participate in API testing, integration validation, documentation, and defect resolution activities.
* Contribute to unit testing, AI output checks, data preparation, debugging, and deployment support.
* Build foundational understanding of Agentic AI workflows, tool calling, orchestration and enterprise integration patterns.

**Job Summary**
 As a Software Engineer / AI Engineer, you will design, develop, and deliver scalable software applications and AI\-enabled solutions that solve real\-world business problems. You will work across backend services, APIs, data platforms, cloud\-native systems, and modern AI technologies to build reliable, secure, and production\-ready applications.
   

  

 You will collaborate with Product Management, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Data Engineering, and other Engineering teams to develop enterprise\-grade solutions aligned with business requirements.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong software engineering fundamentals along with practical experience developing AI\-native and LLM\-powered applications. This includes working with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), orchestration frameworks, tool\-calling architectures, Model Context Protocol (MCP), vector databases, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and enterprise AI integration patterns.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

title: Agent Engineer
description:
The distance between an AI system that works and one that millions of people rely on every day is where the real engineering lives. Crossing it is what Agent Engineers at Sarvam do.
   

  

 The agents you build go into live operation at India's largest banks, insurers, NBFCs and government departments, and at some of the country's fastest\-growing companies, handling millions of real interactions, measured against outcomes the customer wants to drive.
   

  

 The hard part is not the first version. It is everything after: mapping the full space of what an agent has to handle so the scenarios that matter are covered by design rather than discovered in production, engineering for the failure modes instead of the happy path, and building the evals and instrumentation that make quality measurable, so drift surfaces in the data rather than in a customer escalation.
   

  

 We treat agents as code. Not prompts someone tweaks in a console, but engineered artifacts: versioned, reviewed, and held to a regression suite, where you can reason about what a change will do and roll it back if you are wrong. Anyone who has watched an AI system quietly decay because nobody could tell which change broke it understands why this matters.
   

  

 And then doing it again for the next customer, faster, because you built the first one to be repeatable.
   

  

**About Sarvam**
 Sarvam is India's leading full\-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose\-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice\-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top\-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.
   

  

****What this role promises you****
**Production, at real scale**
 Not prototypes, not demos. Systems in live operation at some of India's largest institutions, carrying real volume, measured against outcomes the customer has signed up to. You will see the consequences of your engineering decisions within days.
   

  

**You work at the source**
 Sarvam builds the whole stack: the foundational models, the infrastructure they run on, and the products on top of them. When a deployment needs something that does not exist yet, whether that is model behaviour, an infrastructure capability or a product change, you are not filing a ticket with a vendor and waiting on a roadmap. You are in a room with the people who built it. Anyone who has delivered AI on top of someone else's black box knows how much difference that makes.
   

  

**A genuinely broad surface**
 Sarvam's products span conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent document processing, and content, including dubbing and document translation. You will own a motion and go deep in it, and the depth you build travels well as products mature and new ones ship.
   

  

****What you'll do****
* Build production agents on the Sarvam stack: prompts, system design, workflows, tool integrations, and evals.
* Map the space the agent has to cover. Work out the scenarios that matter, how each should be handled, and where the edges are, so coverage is designed rather than discovered later.
* Build the proof of concept when a customer wants to see it work before committing at scale, and get to a convincing result fast.
* Integrate into systems that were never designed for this: core banking, CRM, ticketing, telephony, and whatever else the customer runs.
* Own quality end to end. Define what good means for the use case, build the evals that measure it, and close the gap until the numbers hold.
* Engineer agents like software. Version them, review them, and hold them to a regression suite, so quality does not depend on who last edited a prompt.
* Tune for the constraints that decide whether a system survives production: accuracy, cost, reliability, and performance under real load.
* Design for scale and consistency from the outset. Systems that behave the same on the hundred\-thousandth interaction as the first, and that are instrumented well enough for anyone to see when they are not.
* Take a proven pattern into a new customer and make it fit their environment, at pace and at quality.
* At senior levels, own the technical build playbooks and the technical quality bar for a motion, and bring partner engineers up to it.


****Who you are****
 We are hiring across levels, from 3\+ years of experience. What matters more than years is whether you have built something real users depended on and kept it working.
   

  

* You have shipped to production and owned it afterwards. Not just built it. Kept it running, fixed it at 11pm, and let real usage change your assumptions.
* You have worked with LLMs and agents seriously. Context engineering, tool use, structured outputs, memory, and the failure modes that only show up at scale. You have used agentic frameworks and both open and closed source models.
* You bring engineering discipline to AI. You think in versions, tests, regressions and reproducibility. You are uncomfortable when a system's behaviour depends on a prompt nobody can account for.
* You take evals seriously. You can define metrics that matter for a use case, build the pipeline, and tell the difference between a real signal and noise.
* Strong Python and range across the stack. Backend services, data pipelines, APIs, cloud infrastructure. When you meet an unfamiliar stack you pick it up in hours.
* You design for the long run. You build systems that hold their behaviour over months, not just on launch day: predictable under real load, instrumented so problems are visible, and structured so someone else can reason about them.
* You can sit with a customer's engineering team. Understand their constraints, explain yours, and get to a workable answer without either side losing patience.


*Sarvam is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of background, identity, or personal characteristics. We believe the best AI for India can only be built by a team that reflects India.*

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Job Description**
 We are building a ground\-up platform to turn physical industrial equipment into interactive, high\-fidelity digital models. You will be the architect of a new system that takes massive amounts of raw data and renders it into a "one\-stop shop" for 3D visualisation, heatmapping, and repair planning. This isn't just a dashboard; it's a high\-performance engine designed to handle millions of data points with instant speed. Responsibilities: \- 3D Visuals and Graphics: Use Three.js and React Three Fibre to create custom 3D models of assets like tanks and pipes. You should be able to "project" 2D data onto 3D surfaces so they wrap perfectly. \- Speed and Performance: Write code (GLSL Shaders) that lets the computer's graphics card (GPU) do the heavy lifting. This ensures users can filter data or change colours instantly without the app freezing. \- Mathematical Precision: Use Linear Algebra to make sure when a user draws a box or line on a curved 3D surface, it "hugs" the surface and stays exactly where it belongs. \- Cloud and Video Power: Set up AWS (S3 and Lambda) to store and process huge files, like high\-definition inspection videos and dense sensor data, so they load quickly for users anywhere. \- Smart Tools: Build interactive features where users can click on specific parts of a 3D model (like a valve or a weld) to see its data or edit its details. Company Summary We are an early stage start\-up with interest in maritime and defense. We do end to end design of state of the art robotic platforms. We want to disrupt the maritime industry, trying to solve the existing pain points with the most efficient solutions. We build disruptive knowledge\-based, modular aerial \& marine robotic platforms for maritime \& offshore industries. Why Join Us We are a closely Knit team of Dreamers and Doers, who are willing to take challenges, thinking the unconventional and trying to do, what rather seems uncommon. description:
Careers \> Navigation Path
   

  

 Robotics Engineer, Mechatronics \& Prototyping
   

  

 At the National Robotics Engineering Center (NREC), it is our engineers and technicians who drive the breakthroughs that define our success. Members of our technical staff collaborate closely with leadership and multidisciplinary teams to design, build, and deploy sophisticated robotic solutions that address complex challenges in industrial, commercial and government sectors. Each project benefits from their expertise, creativity, and hands\-on problem\-solving, fueling progress and innovation across the organization.
   

  

 As part of our dedicated team, you will work alongside world\-class robotics professionals committed to pushing the boundaries of technology and redefining ideas into solutions for real\-world applications. We foster a culture of professionalism, respect, and collaboration, offering a flexible and encouraging environment where you can sharpen your skills, lead impactful projects, and take control of your career development.
   

  

 We operate in the exciting space between pure academic research and full\-scale commercial production. As a lean, agile robotics applied research team, we don’t just assemble off\-the\-shelf parts\-we build bespoke, intelligent robotic systems from the ground up. Our core focus lies at the intersection of mechanical design, machine vision, computing, and deep sensor integration. Because we are a small operation, everyone here wears multiple hats. We value adaptability, curiosity, and a collaborative spirit just as much as technical prowess.
   

  

 We are seeking a versatile Mechatronics Engineer with a heavy emphasis on mechanical design, rapid prototyping, and hands\-on system integration. In this role, your job doesn’t end at the CAD screen. You will own the lifecycle of your designs – from initial brainstorming and modeling to physical assembly, wiring, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing. Many of our projects require deep exploration before a single part is machined. You will need to balance the need for speed with the appropriate level of engineering rigor, knowing when to build a “quick and dirty” proof\-of\-concept and when to design for high reliability.
   

  

* Bespoke Mechanical Design: Lead the mechanical architecture and detailed design of custom robotic systems, specialized end\-effectors, and unique enclosures.
* Rapid Prototyping \& Fabrication: Bring concepts to life quickly using 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, and traditional fabrication methods.
* Full Build Ownership (Assembly \& Wiring): Physically assemble your mechanical designs and handle the neat, reliable routing of electrical wiring and wire harnesses.
* Testing \& Electronics Debugging: Take a lead role in bring\-up and testing. Bring a working familiarity with basic electronics debugging (using multimeters, oscilloscopes, etc.) to isolate and resolve hardware issues.
* Scope \& Explore: Take ambiguous, high\-level requests, investigate the constraints, and communicate technical trade\-offs before diving into execution.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Mechatronics, Robotics, or related field) or equivalent experience
* 1\-3 years of engineering experience
* Open to a range of experience levels (from motivated junior engineers with the right mindset to seasoned veterans). What matters most is your approach to solving problems and your willingness to get your hands dirty
* Strong proficiency in 3D CAD modeling (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Onshape) paired with a portfolio of physical things you have actually built.
* Deep understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, and designing for custom fabrication over relying solely on commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) components.
* Practical experience with mechanical assembly, hand tools, and a solid understanding of structural fits and tolerances.
* Functional knowledge of electronics – comfort reading schematics, soldering, fabricating wiring harnesses, and diagnosing basic electrical faults.

 HARMAN Connected Services is a global leader in connected car technology, lifestyle audio innovations, design and analytics, cloud services, and IoT solutions. Our competitive benefits package includes comprehensive compensation, flexible work arrangements, and recognition programs. Join our dynamic, inclusive, and supportive work environment to shape the future of automotive technology.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The Senior Software Engineer (3\-6 years’ experience) will design, develop, and integrate Apple CarPlay features within Android\-based infotainment platforms. This role focuses on strong individual technical contribution, system\-level development, and mentoring junior engineers, while working under architectural guidance from technical leads.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
 Design, develop, and integrate Apple CarPlay functionality within Android Automotive OS–based infotainment systems. Implement and maintain CarPlay connection lifecycle features including connection, projection, audio playback, Alternate screen support, enhanced siri and error recovery. Implement and enhance Binder / AIDL\-based IPC for CarPlay projection services. Develop and maintain state machines and service lifecycle logic for reliable CarPlay operation. Work across Android framework, native components to support CarPlay projection flows. Perform system\-level debugging of crashes, ANRs, memory leaks, performance bottlenecks, and boot\-time issues. Use debugging and profiling tools such as ADB, logcat, Perfetto, and Android Studio Profiler. Apply JNI and native debugging skills to diagnose and fix cross\-layer issues. Support Apple CarPlay certification activities by analyzing validation failures and implementing corrective fixes. Collaborate with QA, certification, and platform teams to ensure CarPlay stability and compliance. Stay informed about updates to CarPlay specifications, iOS compatibility, and Android Automotive platform changes.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Experience:**
 Programming Skills: Kotlin, Java, C\+\+ Strong experience in Android system\-level development (AAOS or AOSP). Solid understanding of Android services, Binder / AIDL, and system service lifecycles. Experience with projection technologies (Apple CarPlay). Proficiency in JNI. Hands\-on experience debugging complex Android system issues. Familiarity with Apple CarPlay specifications and certification process is a strong plus. Understanding of Carplay communication plugin Knowledge of FACET testing. Proficiency in ATS log analysis. Strong experience in Audio related Carplay certification test cases.
   

  

**Preferred skill:**
* Knowledge of Bluetooth, USB, Wifi and other automotive connectivity protocols.
* Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git or SVN.

title: AMR Autonomy Engineer (Mid-Level)
description:
**About the Role** 




 Gamasome is looking for a mid\-level Autonomy Engineer to build and test the autonomy stack for an autonomous mobile robot (AMR), end to end — from sensor fusion and localisation through motion planning and control. This is a hands\-on, from\-the\-ground\-up robotics role: you'll be integrating open\-source libraries directly and writing performance\-critical code, not just configuring an existing framework.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Design and implement state estimation / sensor fusion pipelines (EKF/UKF) combining wheel odometry and IMU data, including filter tuning and consistency checks
* Build and maintain SLAM \& mapping capability — LiDAR SLAM, occupancy grids, loop closure
* Implement localisation against a prior map using scan matching techniques (ICP/NDT/AMCL\-style) at high pose rates
* Develop layered costmaps (static/dynamic/inflation) from LiDAR and depth sensor input
* Own motion planning across global (A\*/D\*) and local layers, including trajectory optimization and MPC
* Implement control for trajectory tracking and safe motion on a differential\-drive platform (stopping distances, safety zones, E\-Stop handling)
* Write and maintain sensor drivers / HAL wrappers for safety LiDAR, IMU, depth cameras, wheel encoders, and motor/drive controllers over fieldbus protocols (Modbus/CAN)
* Handle sensor calibration, extrinsics, and time synchronization across the robot's sensor rig
* Develop and validate in simulation first (Isaac Sim / MuJoCo) before sim\-to\-real transfer
* Run rigorous validation — trajectory error (ATE/RPE), drift, latency/jitter, and filter consistency checks
* Maintain reliability discipline: reproducible tests, long\-duration/soak testing, regression catching, and CI integration
* Write clean, production\-grade C\+\+ and Python code following high engineering standards (e.g., Google style guides), using CMake, Cython, Docker, Git, and CI pipelines
* Work with pub/sub middleware and protobuf (Zenoh, DDS, or similar) across multi\-process node systems
* Use logging and replay tools (e.g., MCAP) for debugging and evaluation.


- 


**Requirements** 



* Strong C\+\+ and Python skills, including C/C\+\+ for performance\-critical code
* Experience building autonomy stacks from the ground up — not solely reliant on ROS — with direct integration of open\-source libraries
* Real\-time / performance engineering experience, meeting rate and latency targets on constrained compute
* Solid foundation in linear algebra, estimation/probability, optimization, geometry \& transforms, and differential\-drive kinematics
* Demonstrated experience across state estimation, SLAM, localisation, costmaps, motion planning, and control
* Hands\-on experience with sensor drivers/HAL layers and hardware calibration
* Experience with simulation\-first development and rigorous validation practices
* Strong software engineering fundamentals — clean code, version control, CI/CD


- 


**Nice to Have** 



* Prior experience in the warehouse AMR/AGV domain



  





**Compensation will be competitive and in line with industry standards, based on the candidate's experience and expertise.**

 We’re hiring an Solution Engineer to Invent, design, and implement engineering solutions to complex material flow/transformation and human/machine efficiency problems throughout the India Amazon supply chain.
   

  

* Lead and coordinate design and innovation efforts to develop optimal solutions for the fulfillment and transportation network through equipment specification, material flow, process design, site layout, and intellectual property considerations.
* Collaboration with internal teams and external vendors to generate high quality, cost effective solutions in very short periods of time.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and coordinate concept and design development efforts for optimal solutions for the India fulfillment network through equipment specification, material flow, process design, ergonomics, associate experience, operational considerations and site layout
* Work closely with vendors, suppliers and other teams to create innovative solutions
* Conduct detailed design review after implementation in partnering with WHS and Operations
* Collaborate with the launch team to ensure every detail is thought through and documented using a layout, module or Standard Operating Procedure and change control
* Develop, document and update design standards in conjunction with worldwide design teams
* Build strong working relationships with key company partners such as IN Launch team, Worldwide Design team, IN Procurement, IT, Loss Prevention, RME, WHS, Change Management, IN Operations, IN ACES and IN Capacity Planning team.
* Willing to travel to different sites across India to interact with internal and external business and technical leaders


 A day in the life
   

  

* Lead the conception and execution of intricate material handling solutions.
* Collaborate with multiple teams, stakeholders, vendors, and suppliers to create innovative designs
* Conduct post\-implementation design reviews
* Collaborate with the pre\-construction and launch team for comprehensive documentation, and update design standards.
* Foster robust relationships with key internal teams and travel across sites spread across India for crucial interactions.


**About The Team**
 IN\-Engineering team is responsible for Layout Design \& Engineering of Amazon operated buildings in India. We do Solution Engineering, Design of MHE, Warehouse Automation, Storage \& 4M and Controls Engineering. We work on existing buildings to retrofits for capacity enhancement through structural changes to improve productivity, safety \& associate experience. We create future templates as per business requirements while introducing technology \& innovation in Operation process path.
   

  

 We create operation layouts with man \& material flow, storage \& processing, cafeteria, L\&D area, amenities block, dock, yard, MEP service utilities with vehicle and truck parking. We get the design signed off by stakeholders that include ACES, Operations, Safety, RME, SLP, HR, IT and WW Engineering team. We are responsible to release Shelving \& MHE Automation RFP and their design approval with IQ/OQ support. For new building launch, we provide the Processing 4M to project team. We do vendor evaluation to introduce new vendors for Shelving, Cart, Workstation and MHE.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Mechatronics \& Robotics Technician (MRT) experience
* 1\+ years of Microsoft Office applications experience
* Associate's degree, or 2\+ years of professional or military experience
* high school diploma or equivalent
* Knowledge of systems controls
* Knowledge of Basic Mathematics
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* Experience identifying, maintaining, and utilizing SCADA systems and KPI's
* Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays
* Can commute to the specified work site
* Can complete a 12\-week training program at a designated training provider
* Can commit to a 2\-year onsite apprenticeship following a 12\-week training period
* Experience with Ladder Logic and structure programming from Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, or Codesys PLCs


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Associate's degree in electronic technology or equivalent
* Experience in field service engineering
* Experience electrical, mechanical, or controls field
* Experience with PLC\-controlled automation and issue diagnosis in a continuous process or production environment
* Experience with robotics work cells and control systems
* Experience with electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment
* Experience interpreting, modifying, and developing mechanical and electrical drawings

title: Generalist Engineer - Rapid Prototyping & Automation
description:
**Location** 
  
 



 On\-site \- Noida, India 
 



  





**Employment Type** 
  
 



 Full\-time (6 working days) 
 



  





**Reporting To** 
  
 



 Founder 
 



  





**Experience Required** 




  
 



 Freshers with strong hands\-on aptitude  
 



 (This is a hands\-on mechanical/electrical infrastructure role (HVAC, electrical systems, fabrication) and not a software or desk\-based engineering position.) 
 



  





**Qualification** 
  
 



  





 B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related discipline preferred 
 



 Candidates with strong workshop/project experience will be prioritized
 



  





**About the Role** 
  
 



  





 We build whatever the company needs next.
 



 One month you might design a conveyor system, the next automate a warehouse workflow, build an inspection rig, prototype an internal device, train a vision model for quality inspection, or redesign an operational process using mechanical and electrical systems.
 



  
 



 We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving open\-ended problems by building real systems. You'll work across mechanics, electronics, automation, fabrication, software tools, sensors, CAD, and rapid prototyping to turn ideas into working solutions.
 



  
 



 This is not a maintenance or facilities role. It is a builder's role where curiosity, experimentation, and execution matter more than staying within one engineering discipline.
 



  





**We Value Engineers Who** 




  




* Love building things more than talking about them.
* Learn unfamiliar technologies quickly.
* Enjoy solving problems from first principles.
* Are comfortable working across mechanical, electrical and software domains.
* Prototype fast instead of waiting for perfect information.
* Can work with tools in the workshop as comfortably as CAD software.
* Are naturally curious about how things work.
* Take ownership from idea to execution.



  





**What You Will Work On** 




  




* Designing facility layouts and infrastructure systems using CAD tools (2D layouts, 3D models, system schematics)
* Building and optimizing systems involving:
* Heat transfer / thermal management
* Electrical systems and power distribution
* Mechanical motion and moving assemblies
* Creating custom\-built infrastructure, tools, and workstations tailored to operational needs
* Developing end\-to\-end engineering solutions, from idea to physical deployment
* Working on in\-house product and device development, including prototyping and testing
* Executing designs on\-site, including installation, integration, and performance tuning



  





**Key Responsibilities** 
  
 



  




* Translate operational problems into engineered solutions with clear CAD designs and execution plans
* Design floor layouts, system flows, and infrastructure models using tools like SolidWorks or similar
* Build and test systems involving electrical loads, thermal behavior, and mechanical movement
* Take complete ownership of projects from initial concept to final working system
* Work hands\-on with fabricators, vendors, and workshops to bring designs to life
* Ensure safety, compliance, and system reliability across all implementations
* Analyze and improve energy usage, system efficiency, and operational performance
* Continuously iterate and improve systems based on real\-world feedback
* Maintain structured documentation of designs, prototypes, and system changes



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 
  
 



  




* Strong foundation in electrical and mechanical engineering principles.
* Sound understanding of electrical systems, power distribution, load management, and safety standards.
* Knowledge of structural, mechanical, and system design fundamentals.
* Proficiency in engineering design and visualization using CAD tools (SolidWorks or similar)
* Practical understanding of how physical systems function in real\-world environments.
* Ability to translate ideas into workable engineering solutions.
* Comfort working in field environments and hands\-on settings.
* Awareness of safety, compliance, and engineering best practices.
* Problem\-solving mindset with a builder and creator approach.



  
 



**Learning and Growth Opportunity** 
  
 


* Opportunity to build real systems from scratch
* Exposure to diverse engineering challenges
* Direct involvement in research and practical innovation
* Fast learning curve with real responsibility
* Space to experiment and improve ideas



  





**About SayaCare** 
  
 



  





 SayaCare is a fast\-growing e\-health company dedicated to making healthcare and wellness simple, accessible, and personalized. Founded in 2021, we combine technology, care, and innovation to deliver reliable health solutions to our community. At SayaCare, we value collaboration, learning, and human\-focused solutions, and we are building a team that’s passionate, creative, and committed to improving lives.

title: QA and Triage Specialist
description:
**About the Team**
 DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last mile logistics in the long term. If you have a passion for applying robotics solutions in a service used by millions of people, we want to talk to you!
   

  

**About the Role**
 In this role, your main focus will be to work on a variety of QA and triage tasks to assist in the development of our autonomous delivery robot. A primary focus of the role will be to triage the logs of the daily testing runs of the robots conducted in the US. This includes replaying and analyzing specific events as annotated by the testing team, categorizing such events, and working with the software team to evaluate any required improvements. The role could also involve setting up various simulation scenarios for testing within our simulation environment as well as creating maps used by the autonomy stack for navigation.
   

  

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
* Analyze: Utilize proprietary diagnostic tools and techniques to triage and diagnose robot autonomy issues accurately and efficiently
* Execute: Take charge of ensuring the prompt analysis of issues, generating reports and data visualizations that effectively prioritize and summarize identified issues
* Build: Develop and construct diverse scenarios within a simulation environment to test and validate new autonomy features. Additionally, create and maintain a library of scenarios to support comprehensive regression testing
* Collaborate: Work cross\-functionally with Operations, Program Management, and Software Engineering teams to provide an effective feedback loop of identifying, routing, and monitoring key issues across various systems of the autonomy stack
* Optimize: Streamline and enhance QA processes and workflows
* Lead: Have opportunities to take end\-to\-end ownership of QA initiatives, encompassing process establishment, defining metrics, new team member training, execution, quality auditing, and reporting


**We're excited about you because...**
* Familiarity with autonomous vehicle systems
* A self\-starter. Thrives in fast\-paced, dynamic environments with a proactive, action\-oriented approach
* Adaptable; you exhibit the agility to swiftly grasp new concepts, adapt to evolving project requirements, and become a proficient specialist
* An innovator, actively seeking opportunities to enhance processes and drive improvements in quality and efficiency
* Exceptional attention to detail, enabling you to discern subtle visual differences in frame\-by\-frame comparisons


**Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related field, or equivalent work experience to 2\+ Years of industry experience as a QA Engineer or equivalent
* Proficiency in using Issue Tracking Software such as Jira
* Exceptional analytical skills
* Proven ability to collaborate and communicate effectively across different functional teams
* Track record of high quality deliverables with minimal supervision
* Must be located in Hyderabad, India

* Familiarity with Linux and command line interfaces
* Familiarity with version control tools such as Git and ability to run basic commands/workflows
* Experience with one or more data analytics and business intelligence tools, such as Sigma

title: Flight Control Engineer II
company: Big Bang Boom Solutions Private Limited
description:
**Company Description:** 




 Big Bang Boom Solutions (BBBS) is a Chennai\-based deep\-tech defence startup focused on developing indigenous defence and security technologies. It operates as a defence solutions integrator that builds advanced systems in areas such as artificial intelligence, UAS/drone technology, electronic warfare, material science, propulsion, communication systems, and data security, aiming to create intellectual property for national defence applications.
 



 BBBS develops products such as anti\-drone defence systems, see\-through armour interfaces, smart surveillance platforms, and other custom defence technologies. The company has participated in and won multiple iDEX challenges sponsored by the Indian Ministry of Defence, receiving government grants and contracts.
 




  





**Job Title: Flight Controls Engineer II** 




**Department: Aerospace Engineering / UAV Systems** 




**Location:** 
 Chennai
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience Level:** 
 Mid\-Level (3–5 years)
 



  





**Educational Qualification:** 



* B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Controls, Computer Science, or Aerospace Engineering.



  





**Job Summary:** 




 We are seeking a skilled Flight Controls Engineer to join our UAV and autonomous systems team. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in control theory and embedded systems, with hands\-on experience in flight control software, IOT, sensor fusion, and stability algorithms. This role involves developing, tuning, and validating flight control systems for drones and aerial platforms.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Control System Design:**
* Develop and implement flight control algorithms for stability, navigation, and manoeuvring.
* Apply principles of control theory to optimize system response and robustness.
* **Software Development:**
* Program flight control logic using C\+\+ and Embedded C and Arduino.
* Customize and extend open\-source flight stacks like PX4 and Ardupilot.
* Customisation of Mission planning Software.
* **Sensor Fusion \& Integration:**
* Integrate data from IMUs, GPS, LiDAR, and other sensors for accurate state estimation.
* Implement sensor fusion techniques for real\-time control and navigation.



  




* **Testing \& Validation:**
* Conduct Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) testing to validate control algorithms.
* Analyse flight data and refine control parameters for improved performance.
* **Collaboration \& Documentation:**
* Work closely with hardware, software, and systems teams to ensure seamless integration.
* Document control system architecture, tuning procedures, and test results.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 



* 3–5 years of experience in flight control systems development.
* Strong knowledge of control theory, C\+\+, and Embedded C.
* Experience with PX4, Ardupilot, and UAV flight dynamics.
* Proficiency in sensor fusion and real\-time embedded systems with IOT.
* Familiarity with flight stability algorithms and tuning techniques.
* Excellent analytical, debugging, and communication skills.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink for control system modelling.
* Exposure to safety\-critical systems and airworthiness standards.
* Hands\-on experience with drone piloting and flight testing.

title: Team Lead (Account Executive) - SSB
description:
**Recruiterflow** brings AI\-native intelligence and enterprise\-grade depth to executive search and recruiting businesses worldwide. Over 2,100 agencies and 6,000\+ recruiters across 90\+ countries trust us to power their operations—from candidate sourcing to deal closure. We’re led by second\-time founders who’ve spent 13 years at the forefront of AI. We’re bootstrapped and profitable—growing on revenue, not venture capital. Our customers fund our roadmap because what we build actually works. We’ve launched industry\-first capabilities repeatedly, and we’re not slowing down. We’re top 3 today. We’re building to be number one.We’re looking for a hands\-on **Team Lead \- Account Executive** to lead our **Super Small Business (SSB)** segment. This role is ideal for someone who has a strong track record of closing SaaS deals themselves and is excited to coach and mentor a small team of 4\-6 junior AEs.
What Matters to Us* Proven ability to hit and exceed revenue, win rate, and sales cycle KPIs through strong individual selling and team leadership.
* Strong AE fundamentals with a consultative \& value\-selling approach across the sales process (prospecting, discovery, demos, negotiation, closing, etc.).
* Ability to coach, mentor, and build strong sales fundamentals in junior/fresher AEs.
* Ability to build trust, create a positive team culture, and reinforce high performance through hands\-on coaching.
* Willing to collaborate with marketing, CS, and product on feedback loops and customer insights.
What You’ll Do* Own your team's quota and help close SSB deals to achieve organisation's revenue targets.
* Lead, coach, and manage a team of 4\-6 junior AEs selling to SSB recruitment agencies.
* Run weekly 1:1s, deal reviews, call reviews, skill coaching sessions, and performance discussions.
* Help junior AEs develop strong fundamentals across prospecting, discovery, demos, objection handling, negotiation, and closing.
* Step into deals yourself by joining and leading calls alongside AEs.
* Own CRM hygiene, forecast accuracy, pipeline reviews, and sales process discipline.
* Work alongside the Sales Manager and the Director of Sales to build SSB playbooks, sales processes, and GTM alignment.
* Share customer and market insights with Marketing, CS, and Product to continuously improve the sales motion.

Expected Outcomes Within 30\-60 Days* Run deals yourself end\-to\-end to deeply understand Recruiterflow’s sales motion, ICP, competitive landscape, market \& industry.
* Master the product, value proposition, pricing, and sales methodology.
* Build credibility with the AE team through active deal participation and visible coaching.
* Identify quick wins in sales process, forecasting, pipeline management, and AE coaching.
